Episode Seven: A Spartan Love Story, Part 1
Episode Eight: A Spartan Love Story, Part 2

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'll be back next week. You're okay here by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bye, Dad.
Mr. Kale leaves...
Ben has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Ben's dad shifts uncomfortably in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's... That's personal, son.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know... I'm just not sure what to do about...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: To be straight with you... I'm not sure I'll ever get over your mother...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I guess I hadn't thought about it much, but I'm working more than ever now because...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Because whenever I'm `not` working, I think about her...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because whenever I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] working, I think about her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Dad.
Ben's dad stands up quickly...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Her name was Jenny Weathers... And it wasn't easy...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Wait... Is this about Denni?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We broke up... I feel horrible, and I don't know what to do about it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: The best remedy for heartache, son, is a hard pill to swallow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Time and separation.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You have to endure the heartache for as much time as it takes to heal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: But the real hard part is the separation...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: If you try to talk to Denni, it'll just reset all the time you spent getting over her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds awful.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: It is.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Speaking of time, I'm out of it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `But` there's something that `I` have to tell `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But[/i][/color] there's something that [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] have to tell [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... I... I kind of thought you `did` break up with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I... I kind of thought you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? Oh Ben, I'm so sorry. I should be locked up for being such a horrible person!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know the feeling...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let me make it up to you somehow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait. That... That isn't `all` of what I have to tell you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait. That... That isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of what I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After our fight, I kind of... I kind of... Whew! This is really hard to say!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just say it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I kissed Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I... Kissed her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought you had broken up with me, and I saw you with Colt, and it just... Happened!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you `saw` me with Colt? Did you see me sticking my tongue down his `throat?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you [color=#3b78e2][i]saw[/i][/color] me with Colt? Did you see me sticking my tongue down his [color=#3b78e2][i]throat?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I didn't stick around for the show!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We weren't fooling around... He was comforting me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it `comforting` to have his arm around you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it [color=#e23b3b][i]comforting[/i][/color] to have his arm around you?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, it is! That's what `friends` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it is! That's what [color=#3b78e2][i]friends[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know what they `don't` do? Kiss each other!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what they [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] do? Kiss each other!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just can't believe you did that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah, it's so hard for `you` to believe.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, it's so hard for [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] to believe.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what's `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what's [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `You` know.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] know.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, kissing Colt when he was with Sam was a mistake... But the difference is `I` wasn't the one in a relationship at the time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, kissing Colt when he was with Sam was a mistake... But the difference is [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wasn't the one in a relationship at the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you, I thought you'd broken up with me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you even hear me that night? I said '`Maybe` we shouldn't be together'... `Maybe!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you even hear me that night? I said '[color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe[/i][/color] we shouldn't be together'... [color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How am I supposed to know that that's girl-code for 'We're still together, I just won't be returning any of your calls!'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was mad at you! At least for the stupid Perfume Incident I could...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I could forgive you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But this... This is unforgivable, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm saying we weren't broken up before... But we are now...
Denni hangs up the phone before Ben can respond...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She broke up with me... Again... On Christmas...
Ben once again buries his head in his arms...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no 'but'. I... I love you. I just phrased that weird.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't scare me like that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I promise not to do it again!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I'll see you when I get back from vacation!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm looking forward to it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Bye, Ben!
Denni hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I got away with that... I am an `incredible` liar!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I got away with that... I am an [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible[/i][/color] liar!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can get away with `anything!
That night, Ben's sitting in a hot tub at a college party!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You're so young-looking for a college student!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have a disease that always makes me look a little bit younger than I actually am.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's called `Awesome-itis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Awesome-itis![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: That sounds... Awesome!
A week later, when class resumes...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You won't be turning in your homework because...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As you can see, the Supreme Court has ruled in my favor in the case of `Kale vs. The Board of Education.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As you can see, the Supreme Court has ruled in my favor in the case of [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale vs. The Board of Education.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: This is highly suspect, Ben... But for some reason, I trust you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I knew you would...
The next weekend, Ben strolls into a bank and approaches the bank manager.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello! I would like to withdraw all the money from my account.

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: I see... And who are you, sir?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am deeply offended that you do not recognize me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: Oh... I'm... I'm confused. I thought Tom Prince looked... Blonder.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're telling me you `don't` know how I, `the` Tom Prince, looks? Fetch me your manager!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're telling me you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] know how I, [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] Tom Prince, looks? Fetch me your manager!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: But I am the manager!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you were the manager, I'd never keep my fortune in such an institution of incompetence!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Surely someone manages `you...` You can't even wear a suit right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Surely someone manages [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color] You can't even wear a suit right!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're a short in a regular, you've buttoned your bottom button, and your Windsor is an eyesore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now get me your superior!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: That won't be necessary... I'll just bring up your file and verify the photo ID...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...My what?
A year later, Ben slumps in a cell in a Maximum Security prison...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If only I hadn't lied to my girlfriend!
A powerful lesson for boyfriends everywhere... Lie to your girlfriend, go to jail!
That might not be quite how it works all the time, but I think Ben's learned his lesson...
Try again and see what happens when Ben confesses his kiss with Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, Ben, just... Let me talk, okay? I'm going to explode if I can't vent everything I've been thinking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I don't think either of us want you to explode...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go ahead. I'm listening...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've... I've been agonizing so much about the fight we had that night...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At first, I was really angry with you. I couldn't believe how much you were trivializing the... The Perfume Incident.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But after I calmed down, I realized that I don't care about who was right and who was wrong...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I love you, Ben, and I hate to even think about how it would feel `if we ever broke up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you, Ben, and I hate to even think about how it would feel [color=#3b78e2][i]if we ever broke up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `If` we ever broke up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If[/i][/color] we ever broke up?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni thinks we're still together!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Denni... I love you, too. I really do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do I feel like there's a 'but' coming here?
Three important messages for Surviving High School fans...
You can buy the On Demand episode `Christmas Exchange` early!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can buy the On Demand episode [b]Christmas Exchange[/b] early!

nodes.text: Follow $ZOE and Howard, Paige, and Amanda in our premium holiday content, `Holiday Short Stories!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Follow $ZOE and Howard, Paige, and Amanda in our premium holiday content, [b]Holiday Short Stories![/b]

nodes.text: And `three...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [b]three...[/b]

nodes.text: It's the biggest Surviving High School event... `Ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the biggest Surviving High School event... [b]Ever![/b]

nodes.text: Surviving High School has gone `SUPER!` Check out `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surviving High School has gone [b]SUPER![/b] Check out [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: All of it's available in our store `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All of it's available in our store [b]right now![/b]

nodes.text: Also, stick around at the end of the episode for an exclusive sneak peek at both `Holiday Short Stories` and `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, stick around at the end of the episode for an exclusive sneak peek at both [b]Holiday Short Stories[/b] and [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: And now...
On Christmas morning, Ben sits in his house at a long dining table, his head buried in his arms...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe Denni and I broke up... And that Jessica and I kissed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did I kiss her?! I don't feel for her the way I do for Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I should be locked up for being such a horrible person...
Ben's phone buzzes. He checks the caller ID.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is she calling?!
Ben takes a deep breath and answers the call.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Ben, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. Um...
Ben steps into the circle!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! `Another` high schooler?! Are you going to defend your girlfriend now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] high schooler?! Are you going to defend your girlfriend now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's not my girlfriend, but she is my friend!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ha! Right... You just think she's hot, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not it at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just broke up with my girlfriend, and Jessica's been kind-hearted enough to try and help me get over it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You might be jealous, but she `is` a good person.
nodes.text_bbcode: You might be jealous, but she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good person.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you should think first before leveling accusations at someone...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, well, whatever...
Tina turns away...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben... That was really kind of you.
Ben hesitates!
Amanda steps into the circle!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, she's my friend!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! `Another` high schooler?! Are you here to steal all the guys away too?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] high schooler?! Are you here to steal all the guys away too?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Stealing is wrong!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I really like your hair!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And you're pretty! We should go dance!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I made a friend! Come on, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think I'll pass...
Ben walks up to Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm just glad Amanda was there to diffuse things...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: To be honest, I kind of thought you might be the one to step in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry... I froze up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for listening...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Man... You're kind of depressing, kid.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yeah. Ever since you got here, I've been feeling down.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No offense, but you're too depressing... Even for `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, but you're too depressing... Even for [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I failed Jessica's challenge... I feel miserable.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All I can think about is Denni, and now I have to return to Jessica with my tail between my legs...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it wasn't romantic or anything. It was for a Secret Santa program at school.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's really nice.
Dinah winks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And I'm sure there wasn't anything romantic about it at all!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh... Is she your girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... She was my girlfriend. We broke up last week.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Aww, I'm so sorry to hear that!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You should try writing out your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would, but that's not going to bring her back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You made perfume for a girl, and you can't remember her name?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I made perfume for two girls...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One of them is now my ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You should try writing out your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would, but that's not going to bring her back.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh... Where'd you get those weird pants?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This store called `Jeaneology...`
nodes.text_bbcode: This store called [color=#e23b3b][i]Jeaneology...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or at least I knew someone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, I still know her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... You have such a palpable sadness.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: His name's Spencer. He's a linebacker!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's a position, right?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Heh. That is. I was a quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice. I `know` that's definitely a position.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] that's definitely a position.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I forgot... Sorry... I've been dealing with something personal...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sure. Crap happens...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: You go to Centerscore High, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I used to play football there... Before I got into writing poetry. Writing really saved me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Cool! You know, I'm close with someone who's a...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: What? No... Who is sappy enough to count kisses?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No one... I just heard that, uh, smart people did that in... Spain.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We were talking about poetry.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess Denni and I are the only ones sappy enough to count kisses...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah! How'd you guess?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You guys talk like poets...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee. You're pretty smart!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Counting what?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay, kid. You don't have to be nervous around us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not nervous!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just feeling off...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We were talking about syllables for a haiku Adam and I were co-writing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, have fun, man!
Ben steps into the house...
A camera-phone flashes in his eyes as the girls walk up to him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shoot! I thought I might get a smile if I took a super candid shot of you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't this an awesome party?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... What are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Having fun... Duh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I mean, what does this party have to do with... My problem?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've gotten rid of all things Denni...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now you just have to prove that she's out of your mind...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?
Jessica gestures to the party...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get out there.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Socialize. Mingle. Your challenge is to talk to other people `without` mentioning her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Socialize. Mingle. Your challenge is to talk to other people [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] mentioning her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You up for it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I think so...
Jessica points to a group of college students on a nearby couch...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There's your target... Good luck.
Ben takes a deep breath, walks over to the couch, and squeezes in...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: So then what happened?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Well, I wanted to just have five... For rhythm, you know...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But we couldn't help ourselves and went all the way to ten!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you guys talking about counting...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just got out of a relationship...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica's been nice to me... She's really been helping me through my problems lately.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah, everybody at MAN really loves her. She's so fun!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, she's been `really` nice to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, she's been [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] nice to me.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Not your type?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: So then you're `not` into fun, hot chicks?
nodes.text_bbcode: So then you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] into fun, hot chicks?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I'm more into the cute and sarcastic type...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sure you are...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now come on. It's time to do something `a lot` more fun...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now come on. It's time to do something [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] more fun...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's more fun than this?!
That night, Ben and the girls show up on the doorstep of a MAN frat party.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Jessica! Nicole! Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is it cool if my other friends come in too?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Toga! Toga!
The girls go in. Ben follows, but Chuck stops him.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Ben, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's me.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: You're the dude who's been throwing all those killer parties for Centerscore High, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right again.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Awesome, man!
Chuck leans down to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, on the down low, bro...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I've heard Jessica talking about you... I think she might be into you, you know?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: You into her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica?! No... She's...
Ben holds back his tears as he tosses the pumpkin into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Goodbye, Denni.
Jessica puts her arm around him.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was the hardest thing I ever had to do...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I can't do it!
Ben hugs the pumpkin to his chest. Jessica sighs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were so close...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're sure you're going to keep it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure. But I'm not going to obsess over it... I promise.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You shouldn't be making promises you can't keep.
Jessica walks back into the house...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All that's left is the stuff in your jacket pockets.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sheesh. Nothing gets by you...
Ben reaches into his pockets and takes out the gifts Denni got him for Secret Santa...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This beaker... Is from when we first met...
Ben tosses it into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These are spoons that she got as replacements for two that I gave to the twins.
Ben tosses them into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This lugnut is from the van where we pretended to kiss...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In the same parking lot where minutes later we had our first real kiss...
Ben hesitates a few seconds before tossing it into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that it?
Ben glances guiltily at a plastic pumpkin on the back porch... Jessica raises an eyebrow.
Ben gets the pumpkin and returns.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And this... This plastic pumpkin symbolizes when we finally became a couple... On Halloween night...
Ben stares at the pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We made a pumpkin, and then we found a diamond bracelet inside of it... The one I gave to her.
Ben holds the pumpkin out toward the fire...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, Ben... This is the last thing you'll have to destroy, I promise.

nodes.prompt: What should you do with the pumpkin?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What should you do with the pumpkin?

nodes.text: Ben sets the pile on fire!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! I'll go get the s'mores!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good... That wasn't easy. I'm really proud of you, Ben.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel so... Empty.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know it's hard to believe, but that's right where you want to be.
Jessica takes Ben's hand and gives it a squeeze.
Ben hesitates, the flame inches away from the pile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's too hard, isn't it? You're still attached to her even though she dumped you on Christmas, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you want help?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
Jessica stands close to Ben and holds his hand, the one with the lighter in it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
Gently, she and Ben ease the flame into the pile and set it alight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There... It's done.
After Ben deletes all the pictures of him and Denni...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... And to get started on a new collection of pictures... Smile!
Jessica snaps another picture.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... We'll get a good one by the end of the day, I'm sure!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now gather up all the things in your room that remind you of her...
The girls start grabbing up all the Ben-Denni stuff...
Ticket stubs, pictures, stuffed animals, and boxes of memorable knick-knacks.
Ben takes the gifts Denni got him for Secret Santa and puts them in his jacket pockets.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are we going to do with all this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see... Let's take it all outside.
Ben and the girls step into the backyard with all of the things that remind Ben of Denni.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Here... This trash-can will do the trick!
Jessica, Nicole, and Amanda stuff everything into the trash-can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's it?
Jessica hands Ben a lighter.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Almost. Now you just have to burn it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Burn it? I don't know if I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on, Ben. It'll be good for you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Trust me. It `has` to be done.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me. It [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] to be done.

nodes.text: Ben sparks the lighter and holds it over the pile...
Ben types in his new password...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, that looked a lot like your `old` password.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, that looked a lot like your [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] password.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, this one is I Love `Lenni!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, this one is I Love [color=#e23b3b][i]Lenni![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` my Uncle Lenny too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] my Uncle Lenny too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come `on,` Ben! If you're going to get over her, you've got to actually try!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come [color=#3b78e2][i]on,[/i][/color] Ben! If you're going to get over her, you've got to actually try!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a password...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, it starts there, then it's just a picture you keep, just a ticket from a movie you guys saw together...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Soon, it's `just` a phone call. `Just` a visit! And before you know it, you're a creepy ex-boyfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] a phone call. [color=#3b78e2][i]Just[/i][/color] a visit! And before you know it, you're a creepy ex-boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate creepy ex-boyfriends...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. I'll change it later, okay? Let's just delete some pictures...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine.
Ben types in his new password...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I changed it to `JessicaIsMyFriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I changed it to [color=#e23b3b][i]JessicaIsMyFriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, that is `so` sweet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, that is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sweet!

nodes.text: Jessica gives Ben a kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now you'll think of me whenever you do your smart-guy computer stuff!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And whenever you type this in, you'll remember how strong you were.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... It's not easy to erase someone from your memory...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Jessica is `my` friend too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] friend too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's deal with these pictures now!
Ben types in his new password...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I changed it to something innocuous...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good! No one will be able to spell that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I meant...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait... What did you change it to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a random phrase... `ParkingLot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just a random phrase... [color=#e23b3b][i]ParkingLot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That `isn't` random, Ben. You guys had your first kiss in a parking lot!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] random, Ben. You guys had your first kiss in a parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I guess we did. You don't think I picked that phrase subconsciously, do you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is exactly why we're here, Ben. You've got `her` stuck in your mind in ways `you` don't even see.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is exactly why we're here, Ben. You've got [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] stuck in your mind in ways [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] don't even see.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, Jessica... I don't think I realized just how much I'd made her a part of my life...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I'll change my password again...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's okay, you can do it later. But we'll get rid of those pictures now.
Ben takes out his wallet to pay, but as he opens it, a wad of pictures falls out onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are these?!
Jessica picks up the pictures...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pictures of you and `her?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Pictures of you and [color=#3b78e2][i]her?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... Are you telling me you haven't gotten rid of all the junk from your relationship?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Is that something I'm supposed to do?
Jessica dumps the pictures in a trash-can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, those are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! My! Gosh! Ben! Buy your pants, then take us to your house!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We need to clean out all the junk that reminds you of `her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We need to clean out all the junk that reminds you of [color=#3b78e2][i]her![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Field trip! Whoop!
Twenty minutes later, Ben and the girls walk into Ben's room...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do we have to toss out?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Everything` that reminds you of her!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything[/i][/color] that reminds you of her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everything?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! Seeing something that reminds you of her is `worse` than actually talking to her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Yeah! Seeing something that reminds you of her is [color=#3b78e2][i]worse[/i][/color] than actually talking to her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Every time you see it, you end up thinking she's, like, perfect or something!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww... Look at Ben's screensaver!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's a bunch of pictures of him, and the girl whose name we're not allowed to say...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know, Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll start with all these pictures on your computer!
Jessica sits Ben down in front of his computer, and he types in his password.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... Is your password something lame like 'I love Denni'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Incidentally, that password's not `that` lame, is it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Incidentally, that password's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] lame, is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It is, Ben. It's super lame.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've got to change it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine...
Ben navigates to the Change Password screen. A prompt for his new password appears...
Ben changes in a dressing room. A few minutes later, he steps out...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoa! Those are hot, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now `I` want jeans!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want jeans!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel good.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't take this the wrong way, but you look, like, super hot!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `so` glad you listened to me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glad you listened to me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I figured my way of doing things hasn't been helping me much...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And if you're going to be my guide, I should probably listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Besides, you're my friend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww, Ben. That makes me way happy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is a really good step in getting over... You know...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She Who Must Not Be Named?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Haha!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it me?
Ben changes in a dressing room. A few minutes later, he steps out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They're ugly... But they remind me of Denni... She would have loved these jeans...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I love Denni! How am I ever going to be without her?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. This is exactly why I was advising you against them!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just buy the other ones like I said in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I'm buying my Denni jeans! If I can't have her, at least I can have these!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! But you're acting pathetic!
Twenty minutes later...
Ben enters the mall and finds Jessica standing near the entrance, flanked by Nicole and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, girls.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hi, Ben! Ready to `shop till you drop?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi, Ben! Ready to [color=#e23b3b][i]shop till you drop?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did that once! But it was okay 'cause I landed on my head!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...
Hey, Blue Eyes! Say cheese!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?
Jessica takes a picture of Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, you weren't smiling... We'll get a better pic later! But now, it's shopping time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! That's my favorite time!
Ben follows the girls into a clothing store called `Jeaneology.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben follows the girls into a clothing store called [b]Jeaneology.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't understand... How does shopping help me get over Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! As long as you're under my guidance, we don't mention her name, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, you've already taken the first step! You got out of your house!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Being cooped up like that doesn't help!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I get out plenty...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please. When was the last time you were in a naturally-lit place like the mall?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought so! You're exhibiting all the classic depressed-guy symptoms, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The best way to feel good about yourself is to get out of those scratchy nerd-pants and step into some comfortable jeans.
Jessica hands Ben a nice pair of jeans.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These `do` feel nice...
nodes.text_bbcode: These [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] feel nice...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or you could wear tighter ones!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess you `could.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... I guess you [color=#3b78e2][i]could.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Amanda hands Ben some tight-fitting jeans.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `One` leg at a time. Trust me.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]One[/i][/color] leg at a time. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'll try on...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm the new transfer at Centerscore. I just arrived this morning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you thought you'd come and see $ZOE first.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have not talked with her in a long time. I imagine a lot of things have changed since the last time we saw each other.
Matteo feels the small gift box for $ZOE in his jacket pocket.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I want another chance to tell $ZOE how I feel about her...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've come all this way, $ZOE. Is it possible for us to hang out this afternoon and catch up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Howard.` Don't be rude.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard.[/i][/color] Don't be rude.

nodes.text: $ZOE turns to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We made plans to hike around Centerscore today.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, what if we all travel together? Erik is my host, and he has graciously offered to take me on his wonderful Star Tour of Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think that's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, he's come all this way. We can all hang out together. Just for old time's sake, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, if Erik's coming... Sure.
Matteo darts in and closes the door quickly just as Howard enters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, I heard voices. Is Sam home?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Sam has swim practice all day today.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then who...
Howard turns to the closet door as it creaks back open, revealing Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Surprise?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what's going on? Why is Matteo hiding in there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going to have to ask him that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I must look so foolish...
Matteo steps out and stands in front of Howard and $ZOE.
Matteo resists the urge to hide, just as Howard enters the room and spots him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you remember Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I was in the area.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a likely story. It's not like Paris is the next town over.
For an instant, Matteo panics. He looks around the room for an escape and sees the open pantry.
Matteo pulls himself up to $ZOE's window and gives Erik a cheerful wave.
Erik gives him a thumbs-up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're like Captain Quarch, scrambling up the balcony to warn General Kataya of the alien army's impending invasion!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't mention it! Go save the Imperial Fleet!
Matteo nods, turns back to the window, and knocks on it.
The window opens, revealing a surprised $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Matteo?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Matteo?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... You're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you outside my window?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No wait. Get off the ledge and then answer that.
$ZOE steps aside to let Matteo into her room.
Matteo lands in the rose bushes just outside the house!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: `Aaaahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Matteo, don't move... I know CPR!
Matteo bursts out of the roses and fights his way past the thorny underbrush.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just so you know... I'm an expert on spleen injuries...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is all right, my friend. I will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know Captain Quarch used the balcony of General Kataya's bedroom to quickly warn her of the alien army invasion that was coming...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But maybe you should try the door this time.
From above them, a window opens... And $ZOE pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on out here?
$ZOE looks at Matteo, and her eyes widen. She shuts her window, and a minute later, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it's really you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Did you just fall into our rose bushes?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, yes, unfortunately. I did not mean for you to see me like this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why don't you just come in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Erik too.
$ZOE steps aside to let them both inside.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, it is good to see you! It has been a long time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'm glad to see you too, but... I didn't know you were in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you visiting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, it is more than just a visit. I'm the new exchange student at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I could say that I was here only to experience America, to live a different life, to learn to love your version of football...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But in truth, signorina, I came to be near you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... That's very sweet of you. And I'm flattered you'd transfer just for me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm with Howard now, and I don't think anything is going to change that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Perhaps not, but you should listen to what I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This wasn't how I thought it would go... I'm starting to think that coming here was all a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really should go. Howard's here right now, and if he sees you...
Just then, Matteo hears the sound of footsteps coming down the hall.
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo steels himself and climbs up the last few feet!
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo lets go, and he falls back!
Matteo grabs the pipe tightly and keeps climbing!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This house is high! My arms are getting tired!
Matteo lets go, and he falls back!
Matteo pulls himself up with enough force to free his leg!
He climbs until his grip slips on a wet piece of pipe!
Matteo fumbles and slips down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, does $ZOE know you're coming?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have not told her. I was afraid she would reject me or think I was crazy...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Plus, surprises are always best for this kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you think she'll say?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She will run to me. She must. We had a spark. I am confident she has been thinking of me too.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will walk up to her, tell her how I feel, and give her this necklace that represents my love!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you're going to do that, we'd better go to her house right away!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I appreciate your spirit, my friend. Let us go!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: ...But how is it we are getting there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I got a side car attachment for my bike this Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Erik-Mobile can now seat one person comfortably and one person uncomfortably!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am happy to see my home, Italia, and this country are not so different.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In Italy, I also have a sidecar for my motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They're the same!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Except for that 'motor' part...
And an hour later, Erik bikes his way up to $ZOE's house.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Here we are!
Matteo jumps out of the sidecar.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Fantastico! Your energy is truly boundless.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... I'm a little tired. Who knew two people would be twice as heavy as one?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah, you are amusing, my funny friend! Thank you for the ride.
Matteo turns to the house and sees pink, ruffled curtains through one of the windows. From the window, Matteo can hear $ZOE humming to herself.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's time, Erik. If you will excuse me, I am going to climb up to her window...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're climbing up?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is the only way to confess your feelings. In one romantic gesture!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What if she doesn't want you scaling her house?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
Matteo looks at the house, spies the water pipe, and starts to climb it.
He gets halfway up when his pant leg catches on a string of Christmas lights!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh no! It is dragging me down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've missed her for half a year, and you're only going to say 'hi'?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I liked a girl, I'd tell her right away...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I admit that might be a less passionate approach than I am used to.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You believe I should be more open?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But the last time we talked, she did choose another guy over me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I used to date a girl who wouldn't tell me if we were even dating!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I believe you should always be honest in relationships.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are right. I should be more upfront with my love! Explosive, even!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How romantic!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do you think she loves you back?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I... I am not entirely certain. When we were in Paris, it seemed she could have loved me. But now that we have been apart...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is hard to tell.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But she must know how I feel about her! I cannot give up on our love!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I tell the girl I like that I like her all the time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Exactly. Men like us are men of action.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That makes me sound so cool!

nodes.title: Christmas Exchange
nodes.subtitle: There's a new arrival in town!

nodes.text: It's a couple days after Christmas... And Centerscore is getting ready for a new arrival!
At $ZOE's house, $ZOE and Howard are preparing for an afternoon hike when she receives a text message!
$ZOE glances at the caller ID and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never thought I'd hear from `him` again...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought I'd hear from [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'It is hard to talk when one is half a world away...' What does this text mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, do you know where I put my sunglasses? I just had them...
$ZOE hastily tucks her phone in her pocket.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nope. Haven't seen them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never mind. They're... On my head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.
At the Ericson household, Erik strings up macaroni streamers and attaches red, green, and white posters to the wall in preparation...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy, oh boy! His plane landed half an hour ago! That means he's coming here now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm so eager to meet him! I've decorated his room and everything!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope he likes pasta...
Just then... The doorbell rings.
Erik runs downstairs. He flings the door open to reveal...
The handsome, Italian soccer-player `Matteo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The handsome, Italian soccer-player [b]Matteo![/b]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello Centerscore! I am here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Welcome to America! I'm Erik Ericson, Astrid's brother.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah yes! Hello, Erik! Astrid sends you many warm holiday greetings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I believe she wants you to 'cling to Christmas joy like a starving octopus to a luscious starfish'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She talks about sea creatures a lot...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: As I have noticed. I also come bearing gifts. Here is a late holiday gift to thank you for hosting me.
Matteo hands Erik a present. Erik opens it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Socks! My feet thank you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is nothing. But I have one more gift to deliver today... Quick, we have somewhere to be!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know! We have an exciting day ahead of us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In anticipation of your arrival, I've planned the amazing, the illustrious, the incredibly safe `Star Tour of Centerscore!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In anticipation of your arrival, I've planned the amazing, the illustrious, the incredibly safe [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour of Centerscore![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a way for you to get to know the famous people in this town by visiting our exciting historical sites!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where do you want to begin? The Concrete Sidewalk of Stardom? The School Hall of Fame?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Erik, all those places sound amazing, but there is something I must do before that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The reason I transferred to Centerscore High is to be near $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE? You mean, Howard's $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not quite think of her that way... But, yes, I talk of that $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We parted just half a year ago when she decided to live in Centerscore, and I have not forgotten her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have tried. I dated a few girls... They were beautiful, charming, and nice...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I did not feel for any of them the way I feel for $ZOE. There was never the same spark.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Each relationship only proved even more that $ZOE was the only one in my heart.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I had one serious girlfriend. We dated for a month, and I thought maybe she would be someone I could fall for.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I could not love her. I could not stop thinking of $ZOE, wondering what might have been.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This has never happened to me before. I broke up with my girlfriend, and that is when I knew I had to come to Centerscore to see $ZOE again.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am just lucky the exchange program let me transfer in at the semester break. I thought I might have to wait an entire year!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So now that I have the chance to see her, I'm going to her house to...

nodes.prompt: I'm going to her house to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I'm going to her house to...

nodes.prompt: There's a new arrival in town!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I'm done with my meal. Everyone ready to go?
They walk out of the restaurant into the outdoor courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that concludes the `Star Tour of Centerscore!` I hope everyone had a good time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that concludes the [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour of Centerscore![/i][/color] I hope everyone had a good time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you'd like to file any compliments or complaints, leave them at Centerscore High, Locker 267!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though it was a tour of our school and Howard's neighborhood, I really enjoyed myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who knew the Mad Egger of Maple Street still lurks around every Halloween, waiting for his opportunity to strike?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, Erik. It was a surprisingly informative tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm ready to head back home now...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hey, before our evening ends, and we part until school starts up...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Would you two mind if $ZOE and I get a moment alone to talk? I promise it will only take a minute.
Erik excuses himself to head to Howard's car, but Howard hesitates and turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Will you be all right?
$ZOE kisses Howard on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll meet you at the car soon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right...
Howard follows Erik.
Alone in the garden, Matteo takes $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, today has been wonderful. It has made me so happy to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's been nice to see you as well.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I brought you something from Italy. It is a late holiday gift...
Matteo holds out the gift to $ZOE. She opens it and draws out an amethyst, teardrop pendant on a thin, silver chain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is beautiful... Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am happy you like it. But that is not the reason I wanted to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?
Matteo takes in a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know that you are with Howard, but what I am asking is for you to answer one question for me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If you can honestly tell me that you do not have any feelings for me...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will give up.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Tell me I am alone in this, and I will go home and force myself to forget everything we had.
$ZOE bites her lip.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was really magical?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE, we visited Rhodes. It looks exactly like a medieval city!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It even has cobblestone streets.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You can walk anywhere, and it feels like you are a knight on patrol hundreds of years ago.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And the ocean we visited was blue as the sky and so clear that you could see straight through to the bottom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That does sound amazing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The ocean starts to look the same after awhile, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In Greece, the ocean is unforgettable.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I wished you had been there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do too... It sounds wonderful. Traveling with you would be so fun!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We woke up early every morning, ran on trails, and climbed up mountains until the late afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ate dinner as if wolves were upon us...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And fell asleep as soon as our heads hit our pillows...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It was a wonderful experience. We did so much in every day!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, I wish you had been there. You would have been able to keep pace with the best of us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if I would have liked waking up too early. That vacation sounds almost too stressful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It seems I'm more of a homebody these days.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I like to have relaxing evenings in front of the TV, eating popcorn, and watching the twins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I can imagine you must have had a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes, I did...
They eat the rest of their meal, while having a pleasant conversation.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, Matteo, what is Europe like? Do all the waiters and waitresses there hurl coffee like how Cupid shoots arrows?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not know where you are getting your information, my friend, but no, that is not the case.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: At least, not where I've traveled.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course, I have never been to Norway! All the places I have visited in Europe are very different.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's your favorite city?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I would have to say Paris. It is the city I love most above all others.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of my best memories were made there.
Matteo catches $ZOE's eye, and she looks down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... What's fun to do in Europe? I'll admit, last time we went, I didn't do a lot of sightseeing...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is great fun to get into the culture and experience life the way other people do.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Before I came here, I went to Greece with my parents.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Was it really hot?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you meet a Medusala?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you have fun?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: 'Yes' to Howard. A definite 'no' to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And, $ZOE... I had so much fun. You would have loved it.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Our trip was...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I tried spicy once, and I hated it.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sometimes you should take a second chance on something you've already tried.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Besides, there are different kinds of spicy. You might find you enjoy this kind.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not me! Spicy things make my mouth feel like a party only adults go to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just tastes like fire to me. But I'll give it a shot.
The group places their order, and twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Open up! Penne arrabiata...
$ZOE takes a tentative bite... And starts coughing!
Her eyes start watering up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Water... Water...
Howard hands her a glass, and $ZOE downs it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, take a bite of something non-spicy like our salad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some things are worth trying... And some are definitely not...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am sorry, $ZOE. Perhaps you will never become accustomed to spicy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Trying something new was probably good, so thanks for that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Otherwise, I never would have known that food could hurt so much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, that sounds... I don't even know how that sounds!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Squids use that stuff to repel other animals. Why would you `eat` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Squids use that stuff to repel other animals. Why would you [color=#e23b3b][i]eat[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It will be fun... What is the worst that can happen?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Death by squid...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My parents tried to get me to eat a seafood pasta one time, but I just couldn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is an opportunity then! When life gives you a second chance, you should take it!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Maybe you will `love` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you will [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay. I'll try it.
The group places their order, and twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, the noodles are jet black...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Open up! Squid ink pasta...
$ZOE takes a tentative bite...
Chews thoughtfully...
And smiles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ... Whoa. This is really good!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you should try this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, come on, Howard. Don't tell me you're scared.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... Just grossed out. I don't think pasta should be that color...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, fine. Maybe I'll just share Matteo's dish with him...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Have as much as you like. See? What'd I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right... Trying new things is great!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I will tell her... I'll tell her right after the tour!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You can go now! Don't let us stand in the way of your love...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I can't. A tour guide never leaves his tourists! It's the sacred code!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I'm going to talk to Sara about her feelings for me... What are you going to do about $ZOE?
Matteo looks over to where $ZOE and Howard are holding hands.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Later on, I plan to ask if she still cares for me the way she did in Paris.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But for now... I just have to be the good friend $ZOE expects me to be.
$ZOE and Howard wander back.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is everyone ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How much longer does the tour go on?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: After a quick jaunt past Festival Drive to see the house belonging to the illustrious Party Man Hector Hector Alonzo...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We stop for dinner! It's included! Now come!
Half an hour later, they arrive at the hostess station of a nice, Italian restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here we are! I chose this restaurant because it's where the stars eat. All three and a half of them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Three and a half?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think he's talking about the rating.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I also hear this is the spot where everyone is getting New Year's Eve dinner. In fact, `I'm` coming here right before my Ogres and Elves New Year's Party!
nodes.text_bbcode: I also hear this is the spot where everyone is getting New Year's Eve dinner. In fact, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] coming here right before my Ogres and Elves New Year's Party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE and I have been here before...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Exactly! And that table over there is where Hector and Amanda first fought as a couple!
A waitress approaches the group.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Erik Ericson! You brought another tour around for us. We're getting quite busy off your customers.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I was worried after the way your last tour group argued.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, that was fine. Christina and Sarah are great now! They were just really eager to see the place where Colt and Denni kissed for the second time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm kind of glad we skipped over that on our tour.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'll go see about your table.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Who is this Denni and Colt? Are they some kind of couple?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh they wish!
The waitress comes back over.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Erik, we're a little busy tonight, but you'll get your table in a few minutes. Please sit and relax.
They settle in for a short wait.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, Matteo... Have a new girlfriend yet?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, not at the moment. I dated a few girls... Ten or fifteen or so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fifteen?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I could not find happiness with any of them. They just simply did not compare. I dated a girl seriously for a month.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But we broke up a couple weeks ago. I... I was not into it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, a guy like you will have good luck here in Centerscore. Lots of girls. `Single girls.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, a guy like you will have good luck here in Centerscore. Lots of girls. [color=#e23b3b][i]Single girls.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Somehow I think I will run into the same problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...So, you dated how many girls?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've upset her by telling her... But she doesn't know I dated so many to forget her!
At that moment, three Monarch Prep girls enter the area.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And then I told the salesgirl, 'Hello! These gold shoes aren't going to gild themselves!'

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's awesome, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I'm a little confused... Why get gold shoes if you can get them in platinum?
Howard smiles at Paige and waves her over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Since we were talking about girls... I thought I'd wave one over.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Howard... Did you decide to ditch Sam's lame cousin and start dating me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but I have someone else here you might be interested in. Matteo, this is Paige. Paige, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey there, handsome.
Paige puts a hand on Matteo's arm.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, hello, American girl.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can call me Paige. I have to say... I `love` your Italian accent...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can call me Paige. I have to say... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your Italian accent...

nodes.text: Matteo backs into a wall.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I need to get this girl away from me before $ZOE gets the wrong idea.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Thank you for your interest, beautiful girl...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You think I'm beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Er... How could I not?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What'd I say?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I cannot stop flirting!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't want to be rude, but I need to let her down easy!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Push Paige away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what I love about the Italians?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I cannot even begin to guess.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your country. I'd love to hear where you're from. Do you want to tell me all the details over dinner?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I can only give you my regrets...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am sorry. You are very beautiful, but I cannot have dinner with you.
Matteo gestures to $ZOE.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: My friends are with me, and I could not abandon them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, fine. But if you ever find yourself on your own, call me.
Paige takes a pen and writes her number on his hand. She walks off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You sure took care of her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She is not my type.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, okay. You know, if you're free, you should come to the New Year's Party at Jessica's house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There will be a lot of single girls there. Maybe one of them will be your type.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what I love about the Italians?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Our great sense of style, humor, or... Just sense?
Paige laughs.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh no... I'm being funny!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooh, all of the above. But I `love` your country...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, all of the above. But I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your country...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We do have a beautiful country. Especially in the rural town where I am from.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh? What town is that? Are all the men there as handsome as you are?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No one is nearly as good looking...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What am I `saying?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What am I [color=#e23b3b][i]saying?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know my parents have a villa in Tuscany. Maybe we could meet out there some day...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you want to give me all the details of where you're from? Maybe over dinner?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is hard to say 'no'...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should not have said that.
Matteo looks at $ZOE helplessly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, he's busy tonight. We're part of a tour.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Right. Well, don't let me keep you.
Paige turns back to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe next time your babysitter isn't here, you can give me a call?
Paige takes a pen and writes her number on his hand. She walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew you could get back into the dating game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, you should come to the New Year's Party at Jessica's house. There will be a lot of single girls there.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will think about it.
At that moment, the waitress comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Excuse me, Ericson, party of four? Right this way.
At their table, everyone props their menus open.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is my first time in an `American` Italian restaurant. Is there anything I should get?
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my first time in an [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] Italian restaurant. Is there anything I should get?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I recommend a pizza. It's former President $Scott's favorite food!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what do you think, $ZOE? Should we get the usual?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The usual? You come here often?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but we always get the same thing in Italian restaurants.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pasta Bolognese and a large Caesar salad.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You guys order that every time?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Something wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, it is just... Don't you get tired of it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's more like we know what we like.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But if you never try something new, how can you be sure that is your favorite thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't want to risk my entire meal on getting something I don't like.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We know we'll always enjoy that same meal...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE, why don't you try some of my food? I am positive you will enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Please, I insist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you getting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am going to order the...

nodes.prompt: I am going to order the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I am going to order the...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We both have girls who are devoted to someone or something else.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unsure of whether they'd consider accepting us into their lives or not...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's a sad way to live...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If I thought like that all the time, I would never have had the courage to come all this way.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Although the more I talk about it, the more it seems like a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even if it's hopeless, I like to have hope...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like being contrary!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, at least you know $ZOE likes you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And how do I know that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You had Paris.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She did feel something for me in Paris. Maybe she can remember it again if I remind her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But Erik, are you ever going to tell Sara how you feel?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are unsure of Sara's feelings for you, so you cannot know whether or not she likes you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Whereas I know that $ZOE used to have feelings for me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Before Howard, we were a good match. We were happy together.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have high hopes of rekindling that with $ZOE, given the right chance...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If you want to create something special with Sara, you need to figure out if she returns your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And that means telling her how you feel.
They walk forward to catch up with Erik.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't even know the school was open during winter break.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Luckily for us, it's open for athletes and clubs, so they can meet! Now if you will turn through here and look through this door...
Erik leads them into the library where Justin is studying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here is the library where the current President, Justin, goes about his daily business!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: From reading budget forms to vetoing student ideas, Justin is truly an inspiration!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: An honor, as always, Erik. But I'm simply a humble public servant...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: More than that! There's wide speculation that Justin is also, in fact, Santa during the holiday season! Isn't he great?
Erik leads them out of the library and into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This gym is where the athletic elites play! From basketball players to cheerleaders, this gym is where Centerscore's all-stars really shine!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In fact, you can see some cheerleaders. They're probably poring over their Christmas cheer routines right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey Jessica... Maria... Nicole. Was there practice today or something?
Jessica tears down a poster hanging on the wall. $ZOE can see the phrase 'Relationships Vs. Rebounds' before Jessica crumples it completely.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'd be `invited` if it were cheerleading practice, $ZOE. This is just a personal matter we're discussing.
nodes.text_bbcode: You'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]invited[/i][/color] if it were cheerleading practice, $ZOE. This is just a personal matter we're discussing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing for you to worry about. Just go and make out with Howard somewhere. You two are `so cute.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing for you to worry about. Just go and make out with Howard somewhere. You two are [color=#3b78e2][i]so cute.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE seems to have an entire life here with Howard, with cheerleading... Without me...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We're moving along now! Speaking of incredible athletes...
Erik leads them to a neighborhood pool where the swim team is practicing under the direction of Coach Kessler!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Jane, Sam, I want to see a more streamlined stroke. Your arms are the oars of your boat, girls!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is the pool where Centerscore's best swimmers practice! And...
Erik points to a pretty brown-haired girl lapping her teammates on the far side of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! Don't look now, but `there` is the sweet mermaid of the water, the shining pearl of the sea, the wriggling sea snake of the deep...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh boy! Don't look now, but [color=#e23b3b][i]there[/i][/color] is the sweet mermaid of the water, the shining pearl of the sea, the wriggling sea snake of the deep...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are definitely related to Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are we even talking about?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sara Kessler! Who knew we'd actually see a `star` on this `Star Tour?!`
