nodes.text_bbcode: Sara Kessler! Who knew we'd actually see a [color=#e23b3b][i]star[/i][/color] on this [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what about me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're `my` brightest star, Howard.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] brightest star, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you're mine.
Howard gives $ZOE a quick kiss.
On the other side of the pool, Coach Kessler blows a whistle.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, girls. Take a break! I expect to see you back here in ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to say 'hi' to Sam. Is that going to be all right, Tour Guide Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure. The tour is here to serve you! Just meet back here when you're ready!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll go with you, $ZOE.
$ZOE and Howard walk away while Matteo turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So who is this Sara Kessler?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just as I said, she's the sweet mermaid of the...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I heard that. But who is she to you? You light up when you talk of her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sara is... Awesome! She's a great swimmer! And she's shy but nice! I like her a lot...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I may even love her!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But why the long face?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I don't think she likes me the way I like her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You know this for a fact?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a feeling I get. She would never talk about me the way she talks about swimming.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I shouldn't like her at all, but I can't help it. I mean, you know what it's like...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do. Of course, our situations are...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am having fun.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is the first time I am seeing Centerscore. It's kind of exciting to explore my new school.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And it is wonderful to see it through Erik's eyes. He has a very... Colorful vision.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That he does.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I'm enjoying myself too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you were the one who suggested stopping...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I only wanted to stop if everyone else was bored, but since both Matteo and I like it, I think we should go on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, it seems to make Erik really happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, let's go on then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? But this is the first time you're seeing Centerscore! It's your new school!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: True, but I have a feeling I will be seeing all these sights during my stay here.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is fine. We can do something else. Is there somewhere else you wanted to go, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually... I'm kind of enjoying the tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're the one who mentioned stopping.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't want to be the only one who wanted to stay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And besides... Erik looks so overjoyed touring us around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it'll make you happy, let's stick around. It's been an entire week since I've seen the school. I'm starting to miss it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! But only if Matteo doesn't mind.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, I would be happy to go on.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should have just told her how I really felt about the tour...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And these are the houses around Centerscore High. If we take this street, we'll go down scenic Maple Drive...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where star wide receiver Howard lives! He's amazing! He's caught at least one touchdown pass in every game he's played!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, I'm on board with this tour.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is impressive...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee, I didn't realize I was dating a celebrity.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now, if you will be so good as to park here, we can continue our journey on foot!
Erik holds a plaid umbrella high in the sky!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Follow me! This way! Chop chop!
As Erik moves blithely forward, Howard, $ZOE, and Matteo hang back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are we really going to tour our entire school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like Erik, but we're going to stop at all the places I see every day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we don't have to keep touring around the school if we don't want to... We could tell him we want to go somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, what do you think of the tour?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is fun to see the sights... But I do not want to bore $ZOE.

nodes.prompt: What do you think of the tour?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you think of the tour?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The city! When $ZOE came to visit, she told me of all the wonderful things she used to do here in Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm surprised you remember. That was a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course. I'd never forget all the time we spent talking in France together. It was the most fun I've had.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I remember the Louvre, the city gardens, the opera house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember how we pretended the opera house was haunted?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah, signorina, the opera house `is` haunted.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah, signorina, the opera house [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] haunted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's certainly what that poor tourist thought when you jumped out from behind a curtain.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The city is sure to remind $ZOE of everything we used to do in Paris.
Up front, Howard grips the steering wheel tighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, let's just head out.
And so for the next hour, Erik takes them on a tour of the city and surrounding areas...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's start with all the important sites of the city!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This parking lot is where the brave soul Paul Revere was shot in the Freedom Festival Water Fight...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Did he make it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, he went on to live a good and dry life.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now moving on towards Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The park! I believe you and Howard wanted to hike.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What better place to do it than outside?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I agree. Hey, that's the park where we went for our Valentine's picnic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember how much it rained? We had to run into the trees just to stay dry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Our food was so soggy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the grove we ended up in was really beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sounds like you had many good times in the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, we have a lot of shared memories there...
So for the next hour, Erik takes them on a tour of the park and surrounding areas...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's start with Lake Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And this is where former President $Scott ran from the law after being unjustly committed to Boot Camp during Principal Dyre's reign...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: How dastardly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now moving on towards Centerscore High...
A few minutes later, all four of them pile into Howard's car and take off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Many appreciations for the use of your car, Howard! My bike only safely seats one passenger, and safety is important!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You don't have to keep thanking me. It's really not a problem, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Star Tour thanks you for your support.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As for our tour... I've mapped out two real special routes for our newest Centerscorian, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, he doesn't need to know his way around that well.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nonsense, Howard. Introducing Matteo to the terrain is the crucial first step in being a good host!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Where to first?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I want Matteo to choose where we start! It's his tour after all!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Shall we go on to the downtown city square or to the park?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Which would mean more to $ZOE? She enjoyed the city of Paris while we were there, but she must enjoy nature if she was going hiking with Howard...

nodes.prompt: Which route would you like to take?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which route would you like to take?

nodes.text: Brendan turns to Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New...
...But Taylor is headed for the front door.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Year?
As the rest of the nerds whoop and holler for the New Year, Brendan stops Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, wait! Where are you going?
Taylor turns to face him...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This party is exactly what I didn't want to go to!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know it hasn't gone perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's been a total disaster!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just wanted you to feel like we cared!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, instead I feel like I don't belong!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Goodbye, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica's party! I'm going to grovel my way back onto the cheer team!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll serve Jessica, but at least I'll be popular again!
Taylor storms off... Brendan trudges back to the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's gone...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, at least I still have you guys...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Look at this nerd! He's all sad 'cause he doesn't have a girl to kiss!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That is `so` funny! My nerd alert is going to run out of batteries!
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] funny! My nerd alert is going to run out of batteries!

nodes.text: Ashley hops to the side a few feet...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Heh. Nerd alert. Bweeooop!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You guys... That isn't funny... It's mean.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I tend to agree with Brendan here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andrew? Who's Andrew?! You must be talking about Chaz Wentworth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What happened? Why are you guys still in character?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We decided it was too much fun to L.A.R.P. as cool people than to actually `be` nerds.
nodes.text_bbcode: We decided it was too much fun to L.A.R.P. as cool people than to actually [color=#e23b3b][i]be[/i][/color] nerds.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But what about Ogres 'N' Elves?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! More like `No`gres 'N'... `Not` Elves!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! More like [color=#e23b3b][i]No[/i][/color]gres 'N'... [color=#e23b3b][i]Not[/i][/color] Elves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That isn't even clever!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I think we're done with nerd games, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait... We?
Dex extends an oatmeal cookie to Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Say it ain't so, Dex...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The name is $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urrb...
No more Taylor?! No more Ogres 'N' Elves?! This can't be what Brendan wanted for his New Year's party!
Oh, well. The nerd party didn't go well...
`Happy New Year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Happy New Year![/b]

nodes.text: Everyone hugs in front of the T.V!
Brendan gives Taylor a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Thanks, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Could I talk to you outside?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure...
As the nerds celebrate, Taylor takes Brendan by the hand and leads him outside...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it?
When Taylor turns around, her eyes are filled with tears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong? Are you... Are you breaking up with me?
Taylor shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tonight...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was the best New Year's Party I've ever been to!
Taylor throws herself into Brendan's arms!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did all this for me, and... And...
Taylor wipes away her tears...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one's ever been this nice to me! It's a lot for a mean girl to handle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd better get used to it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I hate to break it to you... But you're not a mean girl anymore.
Brendan pulls Taylor close and kisses her!
After a long while, Taylor pulls away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What am I then? If I'm not a mean girl?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One of us... Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there an initiation ceremony or something?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure there is. We could get Erik to yell at you as Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pass. I think that might be too traumatic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you just went through all that drama with her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for `Erik.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Poor guy. I think acting as Jessica any longer would put him into a pimple coma...
A firework goes off in the distance...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I love you, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I love you too...
They stay there in each other's arms as the first minutes of the New Year pass...
Looks like it's a good start to the year for Brendan and Taylor!
You helped Brendan give Taylor exactly what she wanted... A party to remember!
But that's not the only party going on in Centerscore! Let's check out Jessica's party!
Can you help $ZOE make it to the New Year?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nothing. I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's the prank?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Oh, I know! Tell her that you're a radio show host and that she's won a `big` prize!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Oh, I know! Tell her that you're a radio show host and that she's won a [color=#e23b3b][i]big[/i][/color] prize!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But she has to answer trivia questions in order to win!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: When she can't answer them, you call her an idiot and hang up!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Diabolical, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! I like it!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Use my phone so she won't recognize the caller ID!
Ashley hands Taylor her phone, and Taylor calls up Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hi! This is, uh, Fun Fiona with 93.7, the only station that rocks every hour of the day!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you, Jessica Blair, have won a new car!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All you have to do is answer these three trivia questions...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't hear you over the sound of all this fun! Who is this again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, this is Fun Fiona!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes sorry! I'm at a party and...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Girl flip!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whooo!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now I'm upside down! Zach! Put me down, I'm on the phone!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is `so` much fun! Gotta go!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much fun! Gotta go!

nodes.text: Jessica ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She couldn't hear me over the noise of her party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You guys... Look! It's almost midnight!
Erik turns on the TV, and everyone gathers around to watch the countdown to the New Year...
Five...
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In my underwear?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Scared?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... What pool?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's a community center next door. They always leave the gate to the pool unlocked!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unless of course, you're scared?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I said I'd do it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, everyone!
A few minutes later, Taylor pushes open the gate into the community center pool area...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They don't have any guard dogs, do they, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... Just a security guard with an itchy trigger finger...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm kidding!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Haha! Very funny!
Taylor walks nervously out to the edge of the pool and strips down to her underwear.
Brendan covers Erik's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've already seen too much!
She dips a toe into the water.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Oh my gosh!` It's like ice! I can't do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oh my gosh![/i][/color] It's like ice! I can't do it!

nodes.text: Brendan pushes open the gate and stands out on the edge with Taylor. He starts stripping down to his underwear.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan? What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Offering support!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So are we!
Dex and Erik join Brendan and Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Might as well...
Ashley joins them. Soon, everyone is standing at the pool's edge in their underwear!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: On three, we jump!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One! Two! `Three!`
nodes.text_bbcode: One! Two! [color=#e23b3b][i]Three![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone leaps into the pool!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `YAAAH! ARCTIC WATER!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAH! ARCTIC WATER![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `BRRRR!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]BRRRR![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `WOOOOOH! SO COLD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WOOOOOH! SO COLD![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `MY TOES ARE FROZEN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]MY TOES ARE FROZEN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Twenty minutes later, everyone gets warm in front of the fire in Brendan's house...
Brendan and Taylor share a smile...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good dare?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good dare, Brendan. Thanks for jumping in with me...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You guys... Look! It's almost midnight!
Erik turns on the TV, and everyone gathers around to watch the countdown to the New Year...
Five...
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This story, I'm afraid, is a complete mess!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it's all Brendan's fault!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was just trying to help!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, you couldn't have done any worse! We should be playing Ogres 'N' Elves!
Andrew marches off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This really isn't a very cool party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I can make it up to you... `Next year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I can make it up to you... [color=#e23b3b][i]Next year![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I doubt it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... It's a joke. You know, `next year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... It's a joke. You know, [color=#e23b3b][i]next year![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Because... It's about to be next year... Really soon... And...
Taylor flops down onto a couch.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why would I `want` to be reminded of her death, Brendan?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would I [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to be reminded of her death, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know! I thought that's where you were going!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That is really dark!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's precisely why!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I always encounter a couple like you two...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And I'm reminded of the love that she and I had.
Brendan puts his arm around Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: To be reminded of what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stuff?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I tried to save her on the snowmobile, but I crashed.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I crawled through mountains of endless snow to reach her, but by the time I got there...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did she...?
Andrew nods...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It happened on New Year's, and every New Year's I attend a soiree like this one...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You must come to a party like this to be reminded...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: How could I be alive if I lost my heart?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's gross, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This sucks so much!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Please, allow me to continue my tragic tale...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! Just get to an ending... Quick!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I was talking about the woman I once loved...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She was `very` special... An extraordinary woman and a tenacious ski instructor!
nodes.text_bbcode: She was [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] special... An extraordinary woman and a tenacious ski instructor!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She was beautiful, and she had the kindest heart of anyone I've ever met...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We were engaged to be married...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But something happened?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I just told you that I lost my leg!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, right... You did.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This sucks so much!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Please, allow me to continue my tragic tale...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! Just get to an ending... Quick!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I was talking about the woman I once loved...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Something.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're a real help to the scene!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So... What are you doing at this party, Chaz?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Recovering. Life hasn't been the same since the snowmobile accident...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's how I lost my leg. I'm able to perambulate via this prosthetic.
Andrew raps on his leg and makes a hollow knocking sound.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But I'm afraid there are no prosthetics for a broken heart...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That sounds sad... You must have lost...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Wentworth! Pay attention, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's Chaz! Chaz!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is kind of lame, guys...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forgive Brendan, he's always got his nose buried in his books.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I apologize.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not at all. I'm a man of many faces.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Many know me as a world-class skier...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Wentworth! Pay attention, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's Chaz! Chaz!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is kind of lame, guys...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forgive Brendan, he's always got his nose buried in his books.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Wentworth! Pay attention, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's Chaz! Chaz!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is kind of lame, guys...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forgive Brendan, he's always got his nose buried in his books.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Wentworth! Pay attention, Brendan!
For the next half hour, Brendan and the nerds work on the new party...
Soon, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, everyone, that's Taylor... Get to your places!
The nerds scramble into position. Brendan opens the door for Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perfect timing! Are you prepared to be transported into the realm of popularity?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure... But this seems lame...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Trust me...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: May I take your coat?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Here.
Taylor hands Brendan her coat and steps in.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We may not have a bunch of `real` cheerleaders or football players at this party, but we have the next best thing...
nodes.text_bbcode: We may not have a bunch of [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] cheerleaders or football players at this party, but we have the next best thing...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nerds with acting skills!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! I really don't think I can handle Dextrous Shadowguard right now...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No Ogres 'N' Elves here! In fact, there are two 'cheerleaders' right over there!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look!
Near the couch, Erik looms over Dex.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously? That's just goofy Dex and goofier Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Silence! I'm Jessica! I'm insane with power! $ZOE, make a pyramid all by yourself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And if you don't, well, I'm super sorry, but you're off the cheer team!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh... I'm $ZOE! I baked these cookies! Even if you like them, I'll understand if you still want to punish me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hold on... I can't imagine being nice to someone this mean! Brendan, am I playing $ZOE right?
Earlier that day, in the kitchen of $ZOE's house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just finished the cookies! Now it's time to get started on the cupcakes! I hope Jessica likes them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even if she doesn't...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Well, that's okay!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think it's pretty accurate.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay... Here, Jessica, take this +2 Cookie of Insipid Groveling!
Dex offers an oatmeal cookie to Erik...
Erik smacks the cookie out of Dex's hand!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you trying to tempt me off my diet?! Just for that you have to wash my car and... Uh... Buy me shoes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gosh, I am really uncomfortable with how mean I am!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! Jessica's the worst!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And how about over here? Why, it's Hannah `and` Zach!
nodes.text_bbcode: And how about over here? Why, it's Hannah [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Zach!

nodes.text: Brendan points to the snack table, where Ashley is standing by herself...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm Hannah. This night would be so much better if Colt were here...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'd totally make out with him on his motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know what you mean. Colt `is` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know what you mean. Colt [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey!
Ashley hops a few feet to the left...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Sup, I'm Zach. This party rocks. Am I right, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's growing on me...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Too bad these cookies suck! No one likes raisins!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... Uh... Shoes shoes shoes!
As Brendan escorts Taylor toward Andrew, she whispers to him...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, Ashley's so much more interesting when she's not Ashley!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Apparently...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, and here's my very good friend, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, I'm afraid you have me mistaken with someone else, sir.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's a common misconception... I have one of those chameleonic visages.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Chaz. Chaz Wentworth.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Andrew's ad-libbing! I'd better pay attention if I'm going to keep this charade up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right, how could I not recognize you, Mr...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Taylor?! What about us?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It does beg the question... Why make one girl happy at the inconvenience of many?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If we don't play Ogres 'N' Elves, my `ogre`meal cookies will become `oat`meal cookies...
nodes.text_bbcode: If we don't play Ogres 'N' Elves, my [color=#e23b3b][i]ogre[/i][/color]meal cookies will become [color=#e23b3b][i]oat[/i][/color]meal cookies...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Oat` doesn't sound nearly as dangerous...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oat[/i][/color] doesn't sound nearly as dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know this `seems` less fun, but it will cheer Taylor up... And that's good, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know this [color=#e23b3b][i]seems[/i][/color] less fun, but it will cheer Taylor up... And that's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll give you all of my loot the next time we play Ogres 'N' Elves!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Deal. And it'd better be Legendary loot!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You owe us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right... I owe you...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You mean...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `L`ive-`A`ction `R`ole-`P`laying? We get to ring in the New Year by LARPing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]L[/i][/color]ive-[color=#e23b3b][i]A[/i][/color]ction [color=#e23b3b][i]R[/i][/color]ole-[color=#e23b3b][i]P[/i][/color]laying? We get to ring in the New Year by LARPing?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm game!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What's LARPing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a lot like acting...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, that could be fun!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Andrew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The possibilities for character development `are` enticing!
nodes.text_bbcode: The possibilities for character development [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] enticing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Anything with an acronym is cool in my book! That's why I love the DMV!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right! Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you must know... Every year, the cheer captain hosts this fantastic New Year's party. Anybody who's anybody goes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Except this year, I'm not cheer captain... Jessica is.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh. I don't think anyone here has ever even `heard` of that party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh. I don't think anyone here has ever even [color=#e23b3b][i]heard[/i][/color] of that party!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, no offense, Brendan, but the people at your party are all nobodies.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: None taken...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, never tell anyone I said this... I have fun playing Ogres 'N' Elves.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But New Year's is the time for a `real` party! I just don't think I'll be happy playing nerd games...
nodes.text_bbcode: But New Year's is the time for a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] party! I just don't think I'll be happy playing nerd games...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not while I'm thinking about how much fun everyone's having at Jessica's party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... What if I told you we're `not playing` Ogres 'N' Elves tonight?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... What if I told you we're [color=#e23b3b][i]not playing[/i][/color] Ogres 'N' Elves tonight?

nodes.text: The nerds gasp!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sacrilege!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What are we supposed to do on New Year's? Socialize?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Socializing gives me goose pimples!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Shh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In fact, I just had a great idea! Come over here in thirty minutes! Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... I'll be there... But it better not be for something lame!
Taylor hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did I hear you right? Did you say we're `not playing` Ogres 'N' Elves?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I hear you right? Did you say we're [color=#e23b3b][i]not playing[/i][/color] Ogres 'N' Elves?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's correct! Instead, we're going to throw Taylor a `cool` party...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's correct! Instead, we're going to throw Taylor a [color=#e23b3b][i]cool[/i][/color] party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll act just like the popular kids!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhh! Now my goose pimples have goose pimples! It's a pimple tower!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But Ogres 'N' Elves is tradition!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Last night, `at three a.m.` I was crafting a perfect story arc with a complicated five-act structure!
nodes.text_bbcode: Last night, [color=#e23b3b][i]at three a.m.[/i][/color] I was crafting a perfect story arc with a complicated five-act structure!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys, please? It will...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The 'old Taylor'?! What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... You know, now you're the improved Taylor. Taylor 2.0.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stop referring to me like I'm a software upgrade!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Remember? You're trying to be a better, more well-rounded person!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, it's so annoying when you say that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because it works!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! I'll step out of my stupid shell!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now come on... Tell me what's really going on.
Brendan and the rest of the nerds are at Brendan's house, preparing for their New Year's party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How's it coming, guys?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Excellent! We're ready to quest into 2012! The map of Ogres 'N' Elves is laid out, the twenty-sided dice are all polished...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...And thanks to Erik, we shouldn't have any trouble with pesky breaks for `meals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And thanks to Erik, we shouldn't have any trouble with pesky breaks for [color=#e23b3b][i]meals![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I made raisin-`ogre`meal cookies! They're the perfect snack!
nodes.text_bbcode: I made raisin-[color=#e23b3b][i]ogre[/i][/color]meal cookies! They're the perfect snack!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But don't worry... They only `sort of` taste like ogres!
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't worry... They only [color=#e23b3b][i]sort of[/i][/color] taste like ogres!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You adventurers are in for the most epic questing of your lives! I was up all night conceptualizing the perfect story...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm looking forward to it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Jeausych!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The Elvish word for 'Thanks?' Just be careful you don't confuse it with the `other` word.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Elvish word for 'Thanks?' Just be careful you don't confuse it with the [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] word.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, you don't want to accidentally summon... The Destroyer!
Brendan notices Ashley, sitting by herself on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ashley, you're going to play with us tonight, right?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh, I don't know... I'll probably just watch... I'm not really into Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's okay. Just as long as you have fun doing... Whatever it is you do.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Is Taylor coming?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... Actually, she should be here by now...
Brendan's phone rings, and he answers it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Brendan, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you on the way?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm running late.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry. I don't really want to go to your party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't want to hang out with your nerdy friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on...

options.label: Don't revert to the old Taylor!

nodes.text: This New Year's, there are two big parties going on in Centerscore: Brendan's nerd party and Jessica's cool party!
Let's kick things off by following Brendan at the nerd party...
Just then, Jessica yells from the gazebo out across the park.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's almost New Year's, everybody! Grab your partner and go to the edge of the park to see the fireworks over the city!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm going to give it a try! This could really work...
Ryan starts to run off, but turns back at the last moment.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You know, you're not as bad as the rumors say.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, Ryan. That's really sweet.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Would you... Do you want to make out some time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay, okay... It was just a question. Sheesh.
$ZOE and Ryan wander back to the party.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Are you sure? I feel I'm a pretty honest guy already.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good! Then we're playing up a strength that girls really like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, let's practice. Pretend we just started talking.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hi $ZOE... You know, your hair really...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Makes your face look kind of chubby!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, maybe you shouldn't be that honest.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, no, you're right. This is a great idea! I'm good at this! I can do this without getting nervous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, Ryan... You seem eager to get a girl to like you. All you have to do is talk to them a little before making a move on them.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why would I want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because girls want connection. They want to know you're making out with them because you know they're special.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But they're already special if they're making out with me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ryan...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ryan...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fine. I guess you might be right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! Try having a conversation first!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: About anything. I don't recommend talking about 'making out' before proposing 'making out'.
$ZOE storms over, knocking interested girls out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE?! Stop! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Move over, girls! I saw him first!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's the one that `I` want!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's the one that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get out of the way, Howard. I don't care if I have to tackle you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Matteo's mine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Matteo's mine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is what I have been waiting to hear, signorina!
$ZOE jumps on Matteo, and they go crashing to the ground in a hailstorm of kisses!
Oh no! $ZOE lost control over herself and made out with Matteo, in front of Howard and everyone else!
This is not how $ZOE would have wanted her New Year to begin! Try again and see if you can get a better end for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you excuse me, Sam... I just need some air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But we're outside...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to be away from people right now.
$ZOE is about to rush away when Jessica strides angrily up to them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On a break.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about the food? And the Elvish?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, Jessica. She'll be back in a minute... Your party will live.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing `here`, Sam?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color], Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talking to the people I love, which you probably have no concept of.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev. Don't you have a pool to jump in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot tub, actually. At my own swim team party. I was just dropping by.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Then get out! In fact, I'll take you out myself...
While Sam distracts Jessica, $ZOE slips away from the party to a more quiet space.
$ZOE slips away, to a wooden area by some picnic tables...
Where she finds Ryan, sitting on a rock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... Ryan. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why does everyone ask me that?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Jessica `invited` me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica [color=#e23b3b][i]invited[/i][/color] me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I kind of meant... Why are you all the way out here and not over at the party with everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's kind of crowded back there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like something else is bothering you. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I can't tell you. Not after what you did to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hear you don't keep secrets very well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I keep secrets just fine!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to see if you're okay.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey... Is that an invitation to make out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, it's been a long time since a girl has checked up on me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like you need someone to talk to, and I hate to see anyone this miserable.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay... You know what happens at midnight, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It turns into the New Year, full of the hope and promise of the future?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, it turns into the hour you get to make out with whoever you want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not... Technically accurate...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I've been having a hard time, $ZOE. You know I broke up with Robot Girlfriend again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You broke up twice?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Megan tried to revive her, but she shorted out after two dates!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever since then, I've had some problems scoring girls.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No matter how many gifts or compliments I try to give, none of them fall for it! I'm cursed!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If I don't kiss a girl at midnight, I won't get to kiss anyone all year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ryan, that's ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is it? Last New Year's, I didn't kiss anyone, and the entire school year, I haven't had any action at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about your Robot Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever tried making out with a robot?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Unless you count this one weird dream I had...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's impossible without getting your tongue fried a few times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ewww...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I can help.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `You're` going to make out with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to make out with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! We're just going to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! We're just going to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awwww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, when you talk to girls, what do you say exactly?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I say, 'Hey, want to make out?'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...That's pretty much it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sometimes I say 'tongue wrestle', sometimes I say 'swap spit'. Once I offered to give a girl a tonsillectomy, that didn't go well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I see the problem. Maybe you should try something new like...
$ZOE manages to restrain herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's hard to see Matteo talk with other girls...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm not his girlfriend... And I don't want to be!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure you're okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm fine. I want Matteo to get the chance to meet new people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean I want to watch this.
$ZOE looks on, as Matteo attracts more girls.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I haven't seen you around before... Are you into motorcycles? Because you'd look really hot on one...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't own a motorcycle, but I do have a motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They both have motors... I don't judge. What are you doing on Friday night?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know a few places we could motor to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grrrr....
$ZOE controls herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I'll just stand here and relax...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't even think that much about Jill... Flirting with Matteo...
$ZOE watches the cheerleaders talk to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: So... Have you ever heard of a French twist?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's a special cheerleading move that requires a lot of flexibility...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I can show you all the moves I can do...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grrrr....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad I didn't go over there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It should get easier from here on out, right?
Thirty minutes later, $ZOE empties her cookie tray and sits down for a break.
Howard comes over to her, bringing Sam.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look who I found...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! You're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Are you allowed to be here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't sweat, cuz. I was just passing through and thought I'd say 'hi'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How's my favorite elf?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tired! I thought I was supposed to get a break after the Christmas rush.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But `Jessiclause` has other ideas...
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessiclause[/i][/color] has other ideas...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I just want to slap her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anything I can do to help? I haven't really been able to see you since you've been serving.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't help, but you're sweet.
$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm starting to wish we just had a quiet, uneventful night in...
At that moment, Matteo arrives and catches $ZOE's eye.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, is that Matteo?! I forgot how hot he was...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't talked to Matteo since he asked me how I felt about him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I still have some feelings for him... But I'm with Howard. I have to ignore them and forget about Matteo... That's the right thing to do.
Matteo makes his way over to $ZOE. Many of the girls stop and stare as he walks by.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, $ZOE. I did not realize we had to dress up for the party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, you're talking about my elf hat...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, you didn't have to dress up. No one's supposed to look this silly.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I think it is cute.
Matteo gently taps the tip of her elf hat, and $ZOE blushes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Ahem.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahem.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Howard... It was nice of you to invite me here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You arrived just in time... There's an American tradition where you're supposed to kiss a girl at midnight of the New Year.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Any girl I want?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Any `available` girl. You don't have much time to find one. Let me introduce you to some that I know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Any [color=#e23b3b][i]available[/i][/color] girl. You don't have much time to find one. Let me introduce you to some that I know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Uh... One moment...
$ZOE grabs Howard and pulls him aside.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, why are you trying to get Matteo some action? It's kind of weird...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh! Well, I just figured, you know, the sooner that guy gets a girlfriend, the sooner he'll leave you alone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're okay with that, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Of course!
Howard steers Matteo over to the cheerleaders. Maria, Nicole and Jill smile at him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey... This is Matteo. Matteo, cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hi, cutie.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey... You are super hot...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm kind of dating someone... But he's not here...
$ZOE crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, if one of my exes had a bunch of girls flirting with him, I'd be pretty bothered.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not really my ex, and... Besides, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you won't get upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm `fine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Matteo `does` look awfully cozy... Maybe I `should` go over there...
nodes.text_bbcode: But Matteo [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] look awfully cozy... Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] go over there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tvurulo!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will! Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And might I say, your Elvish is pretty good!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jeausych!
Jessica comes over to $ZOE and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica. You managed to find yourself a bona fide elf. She speaks Elvish and everything!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Told you I'd find one.
Jessica steps next to $ZOE and lowers her voice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like you're not completely awful. Keep up the work, and I might even think you're useful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...
Jessica takes Ben's arm and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Told you there'd be elves. Want to see an ogre?
They walk off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay. I'm guessing Elvish isn't your first language.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha, no, it's definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just be going now...
Jessica storms over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did you just mess up in front of the one person who could understand you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! I can't trust you with anything!
Jessica glares at $ZOE for a second before turning to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Ben... Wait up! It's so hard to find good Elvish help these days...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! I messed that up, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant to offer the cookie to you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay. I'm guessing Elvish isn't your first language.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha, no, it's definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just be going now...
Jessica storms over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did you just mess up in front of the one person who could understand you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! I can't trust you with anything!
Jessica glares at $ZOE for a second before turning to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Ben... Wait up! It's so hard to find good Elvish help these days...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Jeasyxs!
Ben chokes on his cookie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You really shouldn't say that word...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't want to go around summoning the Destroyer now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay. I'm guessing Elvish isn't your first language.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha, no, it's definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll just be going now...
Jessica storms over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did you just mess up in front of the one person who could understand you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! I can't trust you with anything!
Jessica glares at $ZOE for a second before turning to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Ben... Wait up! It's so hard to find good Elvish help these days...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why does it matter? It's not like she'd even understand what I was saying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't care. Now go out there and just keep speaking Elvish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tvurulo is 'Take that'. Jeausych is 'Thank you'!
$ZOE and Amanda make the rounds, asking people to take cookies and thanking them.
$ZOE is just about to sit down when she runs into Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh! I'd better say the right thing. Ben would actually know what I'm talking about...
$ZOE offers the plate out to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the phrase for 'Take that' again?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh... Okay... Whatever.
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wrong! Wrong! Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're supposed to say `Jeausych!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're supposed to say [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeausych![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh... Okay... Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means 'thank you'!
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh... Okay... Whatever.
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing? That was just gibberish!
Later, Howard and $ZOE arrive at the park near Jessica's house for her party.
As $ZOE puts her cupcakes on the snack table...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did Jessica ever tell you why you had to wear the elf costume?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I don't even know why I listened to her. She didn't make anyone else dress up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Amanda's wearing the same costume.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm an elf!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...
Suddenly Jessica comes up and grabs $ZOE's arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard. I need to talk to $ZOE and Amanda for a second.
Jessica takes $ZOE over to Amanda and brings them aside.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've asked you two to come dressed up for a very special purpose...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is the Easter Bunny coming? Are we going to help him have his babies?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. Also weird.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Rabbit babies have little feet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ahem. You're going to be servers! You're going to serve snacks to the guests!
Jessica pushes dessert trays into Amanda and $ZOE's hands.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Before you go associating with anybody, you have to know two very important things!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 'A' is for Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No`.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You two have to speak Elvish.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that anything like Spanish? Spanish gives me a rash...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course I am!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, how do you even `know` Elvish?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica, how do you even [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] Elvish?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hired Andrew to pronounce everything for me in exchange for listening to one of his stupid bard songs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's worse than listening to house music!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But back to my point... Elvish. You speak it. When you're circling around, offering the tray, you say `Tvurulo.` That means 'Take that!'
nodes.text_bbcode: But back to my point... Elvish. You speak it. When you're circling around, offering the tray, you say [color=#3b78e2][i]Tvurulo.[/i][/color] That means 'Take that!'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And when people take food from you, say `Jeausych.` That means 'Thank you.'
nodes.text_bbcode: And when people take food from you, say [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeausych.[/i][/color] That means 'Thank you.'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Got that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure...
At that moment, Hannah and Zach come near...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This night would be so much better if Colt were here...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'd totally make out with that guy on his motorcycle!
Jessica makes a motion for $ZOE to serve them. $ZOE offers her plate out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Tvurulo cookie?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There are cookies at this party! This party rocks!
Hannah and Zach take cookies off the tray.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But too bad these cookies suck! No one likes raisins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ahem.` Aren't you going to say anything, $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahem.[/i][/color] Aren't you going to say anything, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you say 'Thank you' again?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: A prank? What kind of prank?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We love pranks!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What do you do with the confetti? Are you going to dump glue on someone's head and then fan confetti on them?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We call that the 'disco ball'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! That's not the plan at all!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Or are you going to stuff the confetti in their car's air vents and put the air on full blast?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We call that the 'snow storm'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Where are you coming up with this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just going to cut stars out and put them in a bag.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That sounds so unfun! In `what way` is that a prank?
nodes.text_bbcode: That sounds so unfun! In [color=#3b78e2][i]what way[/i][/color] is that a prank?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now it just sounds like work again! And I don't want to do work!
The twins get up and run around.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want more cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not more work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll just have to do this all by myself.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can help you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard...
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I've only done a few hundred pieces... How are you doing?
No answer.
$ZOE looks over to see Howard, slumped over, napping on a small pile of confetti.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll take over the rest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There goes that nap I wanted to take before the party...
As the day wears on, $ZOE cuts out more and more stars...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stupid... Five-pointed... Stars...
Until finally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Done! Done! Done!
$ZOE packs everything up and wakes Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? What happened? How many more stars do we need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I finished it up, Howard. We're done. Now I'm going home to change.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'll pick you up at 8.
$ZOE packs up and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm exhausted! But tonight's the real challenge. How am I ever going to survive Jessica's New Year's party?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The game is whoever makes the most star confetti wins!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I bet I can make way more than Kel!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I bet I can make a ton more than Kay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we can both make a bajillion more than Howard!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the way to think about it!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, do we get something after we've cut everything out?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, if we help you, what do we win?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The most awesome thing in the world! A sense of accomplishment!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just kidding! I promise you I'll make you something extra nice.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What's extra nice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A cookie in the shape of your faces!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay!
A couple hours later... $ZOE, Howard, and the twins finish all the confetti!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I never want to see another star again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah really!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who won?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we all did! I'll bake your cookies next weekend, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now... I have to go home... And take a nap so I can survive tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Bye bye, $ZOE!
$ZOE packs up all her things and heads out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm all ready for this party! I can do this!

nodes.title: The Popular Party
nodes.subtitle: How the other half lives it up!

nodes.text: It's morning on the day of Jessica's New Year's party, and $ZOE is hard at work, baking at Howard's house!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whew! I just finished hand-frosting all the cupcakes... They all have fireworks frosting for New Year's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do they taste?
Howard takes one of them, inspects it, and shoves it in his mouth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mmmrph!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Delicious, right? And after this last batch of cookies, I'll be all ready for tonight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jessica's making you doing an awful lot for her party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, she didn't ask me to do this... I decided to do it on my own.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ever since Jessica used me to become Head Cheerleader, no one likes me. I have to try to be nicer than ever now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you `are` nice. Just be yourself, and people will figure it out.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] nice. Just be yourself, and people will figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. But it's not that easy... I just don't know how I'm going to survive a new year like this...
At that moment, $ZOE's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, I have a few last minute party things that need to be taken care of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, Jessica! What do you need me to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The theme of the party changed. Remember all that confetti I made you get?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had me cut all the letters in your name out of shiny paper. Two hundred times. By hand! I never want to see another 'S' again!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! That means you can toss all that crap out! We need stars! I need you to cut stars by hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that'll take me all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! Also I need you to dress up as an elf...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: An elf! With the little hat and everything! Got that? See you tonight, Confetti Elf Girl!
Jessica hangs up, and $ZOE stares into the phone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. I can help you with whatever she's tasked you with.
Kay and Kel scamper into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: $ZOE! Do you have cupcakes for us?! We've been real good!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We haven't stolen anything from Howard all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's only nine in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I said what I said.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess I can reward you two for that. One each.
The twins eat their cupcakes happily. $ZOE looks from her roll of shiny confetti paper to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, twins... What are you doing today?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Nothing. Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One of my friends wants me to make confetti by cutting stars out of shiny paper, and you two look like just the girls to help me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you say? It's something we can all do together!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I don't know... That sounds like work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not work...

nodes.prompt: How the other half lives it up!

nodes.text: We hope you had fun at both parties!
Here's hoping your New Year's Eve is every bit as fun as ours were!
Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there is one `other` alternative...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there is one [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] alternative...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `I` can teach you how to be a Spartan.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can teach you how to be a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You? Wait...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man, is this going to involve 'bonding?'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just take my offer before I take it back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, relax. I take your offer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good. The next polo match is in two days... We'll need to have you ready by then.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why then?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because those guys are going to come at you again, `hard.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because those guys are going to come at you again, [color=#e23b3b][i]hard.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If you're not more Spartan by then, they'll provoke you into fighting, and you'll be expelled!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. Can you turn me into a Spartan in two days?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know... We'll have to get started tonight.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Meet me at `The Windsor Knot` in your nicest clothes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Meet me at [color=#e23b3b][i]The Windsor Knot[/i][/color] in your nicest clothes.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And shower beforehand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: With soap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And `'lather, rinse, repeat'` means...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]'lather, rinse, repeat'[/i][/color] means...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, `Mom!` I get it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]Mom![/i][/color] I get it!

nodes.text: Colt has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look... All I know is that if you can't beat 'em... Or run from 'em...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's time to join 'em.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All I have to do is talk funny, figure out how you guys use those fencing swords...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And tell everyone that my dad is the President of England!
Colt starts to march off the field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... Not so fast there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even if you were to correct your shockingly erroneous grasp of foreign governments, `becoming a Spartan` is more than just a cheap con.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if you were to correct your shockingly erroneous grasp of foreign governments, [color=#e23b3b][i]becoming a Spartan[/i][/color] is more than just a cheap con.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: English, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It won't work. Those guys will see right through you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what, then? I'm doomed no matter what I do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've just gotta keep out of their way, you know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Quit this polo thing... Duck out of classes...
Tom reaches down from his horse and slaps Colt across the face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hiding is just another way of running from your problems, you Neanderthal!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't see what else I can do...
Colt shoves Tom aside, strides forward, and clocks Chad in the face, knocking him down!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You fool! Was it worth it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course! When is punching a slimy, rich guy `not` worth it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! When is punching a slimy, rich guy [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] worth it?

nodes.text: Tom looks over at the approaching headmaster...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, how about... Now?
A few days later, Colt carries his things out of the pearl-encrusted gates of Spartan Academy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you going to do now that you've been expelled?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not sure. There's no way to appeal the decision, is there?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After your punch on the polo field... Doubtful.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And after your comment about the Headmaster's mother... Never!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. `Rotund` is such a funny word.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. [color=#e23b3b][i]Rotund[/i][/color] is such a funny word.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, I can't believe I ever stood up for you. Good riddance!
Tom storms away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, wait!
Tom doesn't turn back...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ah! Who needs this crummy school anyway?! I'm sure another school will take me!
A few hours later, on the steps of Monarch Prep, the prep school `for girls...`
nodes.text_bbcode: A few hours later, on the steps of Monarch Prep, the prep school [b]for girls...[/b]

nodes.text: Colt talks to Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm not `technically` a girl, but I feel I can really enhance the experience here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]technically[/i][/color] a girl, but I feel I can really enhance the experience here...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Get off the steps of my school, or I will use this broom to sweep you off!
Principal Whitford lunges forward, hitting Colt in the shoulder with her broom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow! Seriously? That hurt!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I said begone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait! Please! Just hear me out!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Fine! You have ten seconds...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ten seconds?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Nine! Eight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay! I'm charming! I'm handsome, obviously... Oh! And I already know the campus like the back of my hand so...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me? How could you possibly know this campus?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Guess I'm out of time, right?
Principal Whitford charges at Colt, sweeping at him with her broom!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Get off my steps, you scoundrel!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Looks like Colt's punch `wasn't` worth it, considering he can't find a school to take him in!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like Colt's punch [b]wasn't[/b] worth it, considering he can't find a school to take him in!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can keep your cool... And find your place at Spartan Academy!
Colt keeps his cool...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're good?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm good...
Just then, an older Spartan on a huge horse trots forward, eyeing Colt. After several moments of inspection...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And what, pray tell, is going on here?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We're just giving the new kid a bit of a hassle, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And do you honestly think that's worth your time? I'm disappointed in you, Chad. Let's go.
Percy turns his horse away. The others follow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who was `that` guy?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That was Percy, aka Percival Von Guttentag. He's the crown prince of Ichstenborg.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bless you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a tiny little European nation that just so happens to have one of the wealthiest monarchies on the planet. The truth is, his family puts mine to shame.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ever since he was sent to Spartan, he's taken over the place. Everyone thinks he's just so cool and perfect...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bitter much?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, you're not exactly helping things are you? I can't believe you embarrassed yourself like that!
Bucking him into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He swings, connecting with the ball and sending it flying forward!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Nailed it! Is there `nothing` I'm not the best at?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Nailed it! Is there [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] I'm not the best at?!

nodes.text: Colt leans back triumphantly on his horse... Which causes it to rear onto its back legs...
He loses his balance!
Colt's horse neighs, rearing onto its back legs...
He hesitates!
Colt's horse neighs, rearing onto its back legs...

nodes.title: This is Spartan!
nodes.subtitle: Can Colt become a true Spartan?

nodes.text: As morning shines on the extravagant campus of Spartan Academy, Colt and Tom approach the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of `gold.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of [color=#3b78e2][i]gold.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: These days, that's only partially true, but, you know... The economy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And yes, I'm sure. After we battled together against Hawk Gunner, it's the least I could do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If `the least` you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#e23b3b][i]the least[/i][/color] you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.

nodes.text: Tom groans...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd forgotten that we're going to be roommates together... Please tell me that you know how to keep things clean.

nodes.speaker: Colt
