nodes.text: Sure. When the dishes get moldy, you just eat your food right out of the plastic container.
Tom groans again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look... This gift of yours means a lot to me. Not only are you paying through the nose, but you're also giving me a chance to start fresh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway, uh, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... Are you being modest?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, seriously, `don't` mention it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, seriously, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] mention it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not exactly top dog around here anymore. If word got out that I'd used my money for... Charity... Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even Chad, my confidant, my right-hand man, my espresso fetcher, has forsaken me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tough life...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That reminds me... What `do` you guys do for kicks around here?
nodes.text_bbcode: That reminds me... What [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] you guys do for kicks around here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come with me.
Twenty minutes later...
On the polo grounds, several horse-mounted Spartans vie for control of a wooden ball...
Meanwhile, at the opposite end of the grounds...
Colt is sitting atop a horse that isn't moving at all!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Lazy! The ball's way over there! Mush!
The horse snorts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't give me attitude!
Tom rides up on his own horse.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not sure if someone with your upbringing is aware of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But riding a horse should be a `faster` mode of transport than walking.
nodes.text_bbcode: But riding a horse should be a [color=#e23b3b][i]faster[/i][/color] mode of transport than walking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Professor Obvious, good tip!
Colt grabs his horse's ear and twists it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on you stupid thing! `Rev!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on you stupid thing! [color=#e23b3b][i]Rev![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The horse shakes off Colt's grip, annoyed.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It isn't a motorcycle, you imbecile!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it didn't come with a manual!
Suddenly the ball comes their way. Colt's horse stirs...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right! Finally! Lazy's got some life in him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now if I could just get close enough to knock out one of the other riders with this mallet thing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... That's not supposed to be used as a weapon!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm kidding, Richie! Relax!
Nearby, Chad hits the ball with his mallet...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...Knocking it right to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got this!
Colt pulls his mallet back, poised for a mighty swing...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe... But at least I've got my youth.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Youth? Ha! I wouldn't trade one moment of my life for one year of yours!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, um, `I` wouldn't trade one moment of my life for a hundred years as a `butler!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, um, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] wouldn't trade one moment of my life for a hundred years as a [color=#e23b3b][i]butler![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I would much prefer to be a butler than a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your problem, Jeeves, is that you don't realize that a butler `is` a nobody.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your problem, Jeeves, is that you don't realize that a butler [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I've served kings and noblemen! Who have you rubbed elbows with? Criminals and low-lifes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Try beautiful girls who want to make out with me.
Jeeves pauses for the slightest moment...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I could not argue with that.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nicely done, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Indeed. That was well-played, sir. And you kept your emotions out of the conversation...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had good coaching...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You'll do just fine... Farewell.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, dummy! Take that back!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No! And of the two of us, it is abundantly clear who `the dummy` is!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! And of the two of us, it is abundantly clear who [color=#e23b3b][i]the dummy[/i][/color] is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You only prove my point further.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up! You... You suck, Jeeves!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No... You are talking to one of the few remaining agents of Her Highness, the Queen.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I've put assassins twice your size into unbreakable chokeholds.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `I` do not suck.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] do not suck.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!
Colt's fists clench. Tom steps in between Colt and Jeeves.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Calm down, Colt. Fighting Jeeves would be like trying to punch a sword!
Colt unclenches his fists...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Jeeves... I'm just... Disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I found this exercise equally disappointing, sir. You let your emotions cloud your judgment.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And before things get any worse, I must take my leave of you...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you `trying` to waste my time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]trying[/i][/color] to waste my time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, it sure appears that way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe you're just a bad teacher! Did you ever think of that?
Tom pauses and takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, we're both upset because this didn't go as well as either of us had hoped...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's just move on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's cool. As long as I don't have to spend any more time in Horsecrap Village.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That was `absolutely` atrocious.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#e23b3b][i]absolutely[/i][/color] atrocious.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why would anyone even want to ride horses when there are motorcycles?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't see anyone flying on falcons anymore! You know why? Airplanes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please just stop talking, and let's get inside!
Tom rides up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop! Stop! Stop!
The horse does not obey, running right over a particular muddy patch of the field...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't you dare! `Don't you dare!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Don't you dare! [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't you dare![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt's grip on the saddle weakens...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And he splashes down, coating himself in a wave of mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate this sport!
Colt's horse comes to an immediate halt...
And Colt manages to hang on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No mud for Colt! Good horse! Good $Horse!
It neighs happily.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't you dare! `Don't you dare!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Don't you dare! [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't you dare![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt's grip on the saddle weakens...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And he splashes down, coating himself in a wave of mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate this sport!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh...
As Colt struggles to find the right word, his horse runs right over a particular muddy patch of the field...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't you dare! `Don't you dare!`
Colt's grip on the saddle weakens...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
And he splashes down, coating himself in a wave of mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate this sport!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ready for the last part of your lesson?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ready as I'll ever be...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good!
Tom gives Colt's horse a gentle whack on its hindquarters...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hyah!
The horse starts streaking down the field at a breakneck pace!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yaaaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt begins to slip in the saddle...
The grass whirs by in a blur!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop, you stupid horse...
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his left leg...
Immediately, the horse turns to the right, keeping pace with Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excellent!
Ten incredibly frustrating minutes later...
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his right leg...
And the horse veers off to the left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Wrong way, $Horse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you know your right from your left?!
Tom calls from across the field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't you know your right from your left?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!
Ten incredibly frustrating minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My... Arms?
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his arms!
The horse neighs, but doesn't change direction!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're supposed to steer it, not give it a massage!
Ten incredibly frustrating minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Time to turn! Follow me!
Tom turns his horse to the right!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I need to apply pressure with my...
Colt squeezes the horse with his thighs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow. That is not comfortable.
The horse neighs angrily.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not comfortable for you either, huh?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Wait, I think I'm supposed to squeeze with my calves...
Colt squeezes the horse with his calves, and it immediately trots forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry about the mix-up there, $Horse.
After a while, Colt catches up to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never mind.
Colt squeezes the horse with his calves, and it immediately trots forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, $Horse!
Soon, Colt catches up to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Wait, I think I'm supposed to squeeze with my calves...
Colt squeezes the horse with his calves, and it immediately trots forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry about the mix-up there, $Horse.
After a while, Colt catches up to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With my... My...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't remember... Was it my arms?
Colt squeezes the horse's neck with his arms.
The horse responds with an angry snort.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry! Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Wait, I think I'm supposed to squeeze with my calves...
Colt squeezes the horse with his calves, and it immediately trots forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry about the mix-up there, $Horse.
After a while, Colt catches up to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now I'm going to ride around the field. You follow me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Easy.
Tom gallops off...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Let's see, $Horse. How do I make you go again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I squeeze with my...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Got it...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good. You're actually paying attention.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm serious about this, Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is it too much to ask that you pay attention?! I should have known you would take this lightly!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sitting on top of a horse, asking `you` for help!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sitting on top of a horse, asking [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] for help!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm `not` taking it lightly! I just need you to repeat it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] taking it lightly! I just need you to repeat it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Squeeze the horse with your `calves` to go forward!
nodes.text_bbcode: Squeeze the horse with your [color=#e23b3b][i]calves[/i][/color] to go forward!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Turn the horse by applying pressure with the leg that is `opposite` the direction you want to go.
nodes.text_bbcode: Turn the horse by applying pressure with the leg that is [color=#e23b3b][i]opposite[/i][/color] the direction you want to go.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And stop the horse by saying, 'Whoa!'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you get all that? Or shall I just keep repeating these instructions all day?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got it! I got it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whatever. Meet me on the field...
A few minutes later, Colt leads his horse out onto the field.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's way too early for this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, now we see if you've chosen the right one... Mount up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's got 'killer' in it, so you can't go wrong there.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I call Ben 'Tweed', so, it'll make me laugh every time I say my horse's name.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's got 'captain' in it, and I am a natural leader.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, I'm always running away... That kinda fits...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What says 'Spartan' more than 'High and Mighty', right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going to go with 'Autumn'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Autumn makes me think of leaves changing colors, and well, I'm trying to turn over a new leaf, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's... Surprisingly insightful.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is this what insight is? I was always curious...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I'm going to stick with 'Grampy' here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: On what basis?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I learned from a cop in SF about following my gut...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And my gut says 'Grampy' is the horse for me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If 'Grampy' is your gut's choice, then I'm certain you're actually following indigestion...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think the salesman was offended by your behavior!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're wearing a lei!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I knew he was lying when he told me this was the `new` double-breasted sport coat!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew he was lying when he told me this was the [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] double-breasted sport coat!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's no surprise! What's wrong with you? You couldn't be nice to him for one second?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you hear what he called me? He's lucky I didn't cave his face in!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I should have known you couldn't be polite! Change back and meet me out front!
Colt meets Tom out in front of the store...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Glad to be done with that place.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is not a promising start...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I think I might be able to find an outfit suitable for someone as... Unrefined as this.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Come with me... But please, keep your distance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got it, bub.
The salesman directs Colt to a fitting room.
After a few minutes, Colt emerges...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He is?

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course! I mean, look at what I'm wearing!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `I` can't even forgive it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can't even forgive it!

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: A-ha-ha!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: See? He's not so bad! Now can you help us?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a `lot` of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Well!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you oblivious to nudging?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I said what I meant. Deal with it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a `lot` of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Completely what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I lost my train of thought...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Well, stop wasting my time!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a `lot` of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I'm afraid you'll have to forgive my friend and his attire...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And I'm afraid that his attire is `unforgivable,` Mr. Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm afraid that his attire is [color=#e23b3b][i]unforgivable,[/i][/color] Mr. Prince.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! You're...
Tom nudges Colt with his elbow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That is... What I meant to say... Is that you're completely...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: 'Har har'? I don't understand... Is that some kind of fish sauce?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it's me letting you know that your joke isn't funny!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Thank you! I did think it was rather clever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Is your friend all right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... He's just making a joke, you know? Doing his best rabies impression! Ha ha, Colt! Classical!

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I find your friend's brand of humor rather tasteless!
The salesman turns to Tom.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: How can I help `you,` Mr. Prince?
nodes.text_bbcode: How can I help [color=#e23b3b][i]you,[/i][/color] Mr. Prince?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We'd like to get Colt fitted for something formal...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And has he gotten all his shots?

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't know about the dress code... Otherwise, I would have worn something nicer.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I dare not imagine...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He said... Why don't you `soak` on a `ring?` It's something poor people do for good luck! How silly and superstitious they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: He said... Why don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]soak[/i][/color] on a [color=#e23b3b][i]ring?[/i][/color] It's something poor people do for good luck! How silly and superstitious they are!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Hmmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Why don't I `what?`

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing.
After the longest shower of his life, Colt meets Tom outside of `The Windsor Knot,` a high-end clothing store for men.
nodes.text_bbcode: After the longest shower of his life, Colt meets Tom outside of [b]The Windsor Knot,[/b] a high-end clothing store for men.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hey, Richie.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What on earth are you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You said to wear my nicest outfit!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then why are you wearing the same raggedy clothes I always see you in?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Did you not notice this?
Colt lifts up his tank top, exposing a belt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you insane? Do you think you'll be allowed into `The Windsor Knot` dressed like an escaped convict?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you insane? Do you think you'll be allowed into [color=#e23b3b][i]The Windsor Knot[/i][/color] dressed like an escaped convict?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Do you see any orange on me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, they're not going to let you in like `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, they're not going to let you in like [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold up... You're telling me that in order to buy fancy pants at this fancy-pants store, I have to already `own` a pair of fancy pants?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold up... You're telling me that in order to buy fancy pants at this fancy-pants store, I have to already [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] a pair of fancy pants?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! It's called a dress code!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going to have fun here...
Colt starts to barge into the store, but Tom stops him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa! Look, I `might` be able to get the staff to turn a blind eye to your appearance...
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Look, I [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] be able to get the staff to turn a blind eye to your appearance...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But if we go in there, you have to abide by `my` rules.
nodes.text_bbcode: But if we go in there, you have to abide by [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] rules.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am `not` going to blow-dry my hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going to blow-dry my hair!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Do you want my aid or not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Depends. What are your rules?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There's only one for now... You have to be polite to the sales staff!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Polite? Wait, wait... I thought you Spartan guys got your kicks talking `down` to 'commoners?'
nodes.text_bbcode: Polite? Wait, wait... I thought you Spartan guys got your kicks talking [color=#e23b3b][i]down[/i][/color] to 'commoners?'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Absolutely! It is our duty to remind everyone of our superior status! But the salesmen here are `not` commoners.
nodes.text_bbcode: Absolutely! It is our duty to remind everyone of our superior status! But the salesmen here are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] commoners.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They are like royal artists. And their art is matching worthy men with perfect suits.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If they're going to help us, we'll need to be in their good graces.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why don't we just go to some `other` dumb store for rich people?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't we just go to some [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] dumb store for rich people?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because... There is only `one Windsor Knot.` If you want to become a true Spartan, this is where you shop. `Nowhere` else.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because... There is only [color=#e23b3b][i]one Windsor Knot.[/i][/color] If you want to become a true Spartan, this is where you shop. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nowhere[/i][/color] else.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Got it. You're nuts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Remind me again, why do we have to be nice to these guys? I mean, isn't it their `job` to help us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Remind me again, why do we have to be nice to these guys? I mean, isn't it their [color=#e23b3b][i]job[/i][/color] to help us?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It is their job to help people who look like me. `You,` on the other hand, look like the bottom of a dumpster.
nodes.text_bbcode: It is their job to help people who look like me. [color=#e23b3b][i]You,[/i][/color] on the other hand, look like the bottom of a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'll be lucky if they even speak to you, so be polite! Or whatever your impression of polite looks like...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine.
Colt and Tom step into `The Windsor Knot`. Within a few seconds, a finely-dressed man approaches.
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt and Tom step into [b]The Windsor Knot[/b]. Within a few seconds, a finely-dressed man approaches.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Mr. Prince, how delightful!
The salesman eyes Colt with repugnance.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And I see you brought... Something.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is my friend and roommate, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: A fitting name, indeed. I thought I smelled something... Equinal.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Well, Mr. Colt, I'm gleefully afraid we don't allow violators of our dress code in here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, why don't you...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Still no uniform?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I think I liked you better when your clothes were caked in mud. Less offensive to the eye.
Chad happily rides off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate that guy.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Then I'll be Poseidon, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: What does that leave me, Hephaestus? Wasn't he way ugly?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hot wife though.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh, word.
Percy clears his throat and steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Gentlemen! You have taken your first step towards becoming initiated into The Immortals... A step that may well be the most significant and meaningful of your lives!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You will face three trials tonight. Trials that will test you to the very limits of your being!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like what? Eating a whole carton of eggs? Because let me tell you, this wouldn't be the first time...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: While I'd `love` to hear that delightful tale, I'm afraid the challenges are a little more... Rigorous.
nodes.text_bbcode: While I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] to hear that delightful tale, I'm afraid the challenges are a little more... Rigorous.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So like... A bucket of eggs?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...For the solo trial, you will be forced to recreate a famous act from Greek mythology! Each of you will be briefed by one Immortal.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And remember... Though all of you will try... Though all of you will struggle... In the end, there can be only one!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Seriously, Zeus, could you be more of a ham?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Just for that wisecrack, `Dionysus`, you're paired with Hades here. Why don't you go tell him what he's going to do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Just for that wisecrack, [color=#e23b3b][i]Dionysus[/i][/color], you're paired with Hades here. Why don't you go tell him what he's going to do?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not like I have anything better to do...
Carson signals to Colt, and the two of them walk off together.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Believe me... Nowhere you'll like...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Hades? The God of the Underworld?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, why not? That dude's awesome! He's got that bone dragon and that huge scythe, and when he gets mad, he's all like, 'I shall `destroy` you!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, why not? That dude's awesome! He's got that bone dragon and that huge scythe, and when he gets mad, he's all like, 'I shall [color=#e23b3b][i]destroy[/i][/color] you!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, his girlfriend is `ridiculously` hot, and she wears this tiny fur bikini...
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, his girlfriend is [color=#e23b3b][i]ridiculously[/i][/color] hot, and she wears this tiny fur bikini...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Is your entire knowledge of Greek mythology based around the 1972 cult film 'Battle for Olympus'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that not what we're talking about?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's actually an awesome movie.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yeah, it's really underrated!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ahem! Hades it is!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Hestia.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hestia! That's a God, right?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: It's a `Goddess.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a [color=#e23b3b][i]Goddess.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The virgin Goddess of the hearth and domesticity.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oh.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is she cute at least?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, if he wants to be Hestia, let him be Hestia! He can cook us dinners and clean our clothes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a `male` deity.
nodes.text_bbcode: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a [color=#e23b3b][i]male[/i][/color] deity.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How about Hades? He's certainly `killing` the mood.
nodes.text_bbcode: How about Hades? He's certainly [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] the mood.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hades! I'll be that guy!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Fine. Hades it is.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Herplop.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You want to be known as the Greek deity 'Herplop.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! You know, good ol' Herplop.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He was... Uh... This big dude... With... Uh... Horns? I think he had horns...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And pray tell, what was Herplop the God of?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Cows?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, if he wants to be the God of Cows, I think we should let him!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a `real` deity.
nodes.text_bbcode: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] deity.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How about Hades? He's certainly `killing` the mood.
nodes.text_bbcode: How about Hades? He's certainly [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] the mood.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hades! I'll be that guy!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Fine. Hades it is.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, if you really want in, why don't you just take my spot in the initiation? I'm really not that into it...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's not that simple, Colt. For starters, you aren't in yet. First, you have to pass their initiation challenges!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, so why don't I ask them if you can take the challenges or whatever with me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's a nice gesture, but that's not how it works...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: At least... I don't `think` that's how it works...
nodes.text_bbcode: At least... I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] that's how it works...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have no idea, do you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, it `is` a secret society! It wouldn't be very secret if I knew all their policies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a secret society! It wouldn't be very secret if I knew all their policies!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So you don't know. Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They want me to meet them in the math classroom at midnight, right? That's in ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'll both go there, and then we'll see what they have to say!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'd do that? For me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt. I really appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, don't get all touchy-feely. Just get your shoes on and let's go.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure! Give me just a moment to get ready!
`Forty-five` minutes later, Colt and Tom walk to the math classroom...
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Forty-five[/b] minutes later, Colt and Tom walk to the math classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously dude! What is wrong with you? You take longer to get dressed than any girl I've ever dated!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That says much more about the floozies you date than it does about me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!
The two of them reach the math classroom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... Here goes...
Colt throws open the door. The two step in... To a completely empty room.
Algebra facts are written on little posters on the walls. The teacher's desk is covered with math-related objects: a compass, a ruler, and an abacus.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. We missed it. Was the moisturizing really worth it, Tom? Was it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good skincare is always worth it... And besides, I'm not so sure we did miss it. Look.
Tom points to the whiteboard where a lightning bolt has been drawn. Underneath it is some text...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'To enter our lair in the gloom...'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'First find the monarch of this room!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a riddle!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The first step of the initiation ritual is solving a riddle? What's next? Peekaboo? Hide-and-seek? Maybe we can play duck-duck-goose!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is no time to fantasize about hunting fowl!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now think... What could the 'monarch of the room' refer to?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, well, there's two dudes here, and `I'm` pretty obviously the monarch. I mean, I do rule...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, well, there's two dudes here, and [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] pretty obviously the monarch. I mean, I do rule...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You the monarch? Please. My name is Tom `Prince.` Your name is Colt `Chimneysweep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You the monarch? Please. My name is Tom [color=#e23b3b][i]Prince.[/i][/color] Your name is Colt [color=#e23b3b][i]Chimneysweep![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Colt `Warren!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's Colt [color=#e23b3b][i]Warren![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Reasonable guess. Besides, the riddle probably doesn't refer to a person but an object...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I think I know this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're looking for a...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Think again, Colt... It's an object in this `math` classroom... An object that could be described as a monarch...
nodes.text_bbcode: Think again, Colt... It's an object in this [color=#e23b3b][i]math[/i][/color] classroom... An object that could be described as a monarch...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay... Now I got it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're looking for a...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That makes even `less` sense!
nodes.text_bbcode: That makes even [color=#e23b3b][i]less[/i][/color] sense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Made sense in my head...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's see... These riddles are usually a play on words... So what's a synonym for monarch?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: King... Queen... Emperor... Empress...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ruler...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Lady Ruler?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure I just made up 'Lady Ruler'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, just ruler! That's the answer! We're in a math classroom... We should be looking for a ruler!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, that's lame...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A ruler is another name for a monarch, and we're in a math classroom! We must be looking for a ruler!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, Colt, that's actually... Very clever of you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, when you've got a little sister, you get pretty good at riddles...
Tom walks across the room to the teacher's desk and picks up a prominent, solid-gold ruler.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmmm... That doesn't seem to have done anyth...
A rumbling roar cuts Tom off! The whiteboard swings aside, revealing a hidden passage and a flight of stone stairs leading down into darkness!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I'll admit it, `that` was pretty cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I'll admit it, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not to mention it demonstrated remarkable craftsmanship... I'd `love` to know who they contracted this to!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention it demonstrated remarkable craftsmanship... I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] to know who they contracted this to!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I mean, do you have any idea how hard it is to set up a good secret passage?
Tom and Colt descend down the stairs...
Into a lovely and well-furnished den!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh... Not what I was expecting...
A curtain at the far end of the room swings aside, revealing Percy, Carson, Chad and Preston!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Welcome... To the `Den of The Immortals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome... To the [color=#e23b3b][i]Den of The Immortals![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As soon as Chad sees Colt, he lunges forward!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You son-of-a...
Percy grabs Chad and hurls him across the room!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Stay your hand!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But... `That` guy? He punched me out!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] guy? He punched me out!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which is precisely why I invited him. Believe me, you had it coming.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I don't, however, recall inviting Thomas here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... You see... Colt actually invited me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is an initiation test, isn't it? I just figured, if I get a shot, Tom should too. May the best man win, right?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Unbelievable! He hasn't even been in the room two minutes, and he's already trying to upend the rules of our society!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm telling you, Percy, letting him in would be a terrible idea...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Your opinion has been duly noted... Though if you really cared about the rules of our society, you might consider addressing me by my proper name.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Right. Sorry, `Zeus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. Sorry, [color=#e23b3b][i]Zeus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then... What do the rest of you think of it?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I think we should let them both try out. Pitting friend against friend? Now `that's` a challenge!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think we should let them both try out. Pitting friend against friend? Now [color=#e23b3b][i]that's[/i][/color] a challenge!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not to mention it might actually make this whole thing `not` totally boring. I say we do it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention it might actually make this whole thing [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] totally boring. I say we do it.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then it's decided! This year's Immortals Initiation Challenges will be undertaken by Colt... Tom...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Lee and Mark!
Colt and Tom glance to the side of the room, where Lee and Mark are sitting quietly on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... Hey guys.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yo.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Alright, let's just get this goofshow started, shall we? What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The first step in joining The Immortals is choosing which deity you will embody. I, as the leader of this society, am `Zeus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The first step in joining The Immortals is choosing which deity you will embody. I, as the leader of this society, am [color=#e23b3b][i]Zeus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're doing this? Really? We're actually doing this?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm Ares, because I will `mess. You. Up!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm Ares, because I will [color=#e23b3b][i]mess. You. Up![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm Dionysus. Who doesn't love a good party, right?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: And I'm Hermes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd like to be Apollo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'd like to be...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, maybe they just thought I'm a better fit.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In what way are you a better fit than me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, let's see. For starters, I'm way better at fighting than you are...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's negligible...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm better-looking...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Debatable...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm better at kissing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How would you even measure that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tom... You're a spoiled, snobbish rich brat who's never had to work a day in his life, and I'm a cool, rebellious bad boy who drives a motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's really a no-brainer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe, if we were talking about membership in the International Order of Highwaymen!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Immortals don't care how you fight, and they certainly don't care what you drive. They're composed of this school's brightest, savviest, and most ambitious.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I mean, do you even know what a hedge fund is?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's like a fancy garden, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Who doesn't like me? I'm so charming!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, dude, I hate to break it to you, but you rich people have more enemies than my Uncle Bo, and he used to introduce himself to people by headbutting them.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your family really puts the class in 'lower class', don't they?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, all I'm saying is, isn't it possible that some of the guys in this secret society see you as a rival?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmm... You know, you might be right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm always right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There `are` plenty of miscreants at this school who are consumed with jealousy over my fortune...
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] plenty of miscreants at this school who are consumed with jealousy over my fortune...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's actually not what I said...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They hate that I'm so wealthy... So charming... So devilishly handsome...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's `definitely` not what I said...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] not what I said...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, they probably invited you just to spite me! Those hateful little goblins!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you even hearing me at this point?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If only there was some way I could force them to let me in...
Late one night, at Spartan High, a letter slides under the door to Tom and Colt's room!
Colt walks over and holds it up...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Some kind of letter. It's got this weird seal on it, like a lightning bolt...
Tom's face goes white. His eyes open wide with disbelief.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... My...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you just say... A `lightning bolt?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say... A [color=#e23b3b][i]lightning bolt?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, jeez, calm down. It's not like it's made out of gold...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, with you Spartan guys, it might be...
Tom scrambles over, pawing at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Give it to me! Give me the letter!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Calm down, Silver Spoon, it's addressed to me!
Colt rips open the letter. A fancy parchment tumbles out. He picks it up and reads it, while Tom frantically peeks over his shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's see here... Dear Colt, blah blah... Secret society, blah, blah... Initiation ritual, meet in the math class at midnight, yawn....

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boring!
Colt tosses the letter towards the trash. Tom dives, catches it mid-air, and smacks into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong with `me?` You're the dude that just lunged head-first into a wall!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's wrong with [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color] You're the dude that just lunged head-first into a wall!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This letter is from The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The 80s cover band?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! The Immortals is Spartan Academy's elite and powerful secret society!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do I care? I hate secrets, and I hate societies.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You've got tons of secrets!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but I don't `like` them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] them.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Listen to me, Colt. You've just been given a chance to be initiated into The Immortals! This is huge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, man. It sounds kind of lame. All I'm picturing is a bunch of lame, rich guys standing around in togas and admiring each other's muscles.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: First of all, if that's the first thing you picture, you should probably consider seeing a psychiatrist...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And second, The Immortals are a lot more than just some preppy club house.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not only do they basically run this school out of their inner sanctum, the `Den of The Immortals...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only do they basically run this school out of their inner sanctum, the [color=#e23b3b][i]Den of The Immortals...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Their members always go on to be incredibly wealthy and powerful members of society! Senators... Movie stars... Even hedge fund managers!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... Will I have to wear a toga?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And `I'm` the one who should see a psychiatrist?
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who should see a psychiatrist?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, Colt, this is the opportunity of a lifetime. It's a huge honor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You said you wanted to be a better man, right? That's why you're here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, The Immortals are the `best of the best,` Colt. If you want to put your criminal ways behind you and succeed in this world... This is the shot of a lifetime.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, The Immortals are the [color=#e23b3b][i]best of the best,[/i][/color] Colt. If you want to put your criminal ways behind you and succeed in this world... This is the shot of a lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah. Really.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, I... I don't really understand why `you` got it... I mean, I always wanted to be a member, I just figured it was a matter of time...
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, I... I don't really understand why [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] got it... I mean, I always wanted to be a member, I just figured it was a matter of time...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why would they invite you and not me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gee, I don't know, Tom. Maybe it's because...
Colt holds his breath and sprays, frantically blasting the room with water!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, come on!
Manure sprays away, but it's not enough! Horses neigh and whinny!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't take much more of this...
The smell starts to become overwhelming! Colt's hands tremble and shake!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't fail `now...` I mean, I was on fire for the previous trials...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't fail [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color] I mean, I was on fire for the previous trials...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... `On fire...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... [color=#e23b3b][i]On fire...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt glances up at the ceiling where several fire sprinklers jut out of the woodwork...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope this works...
Colt grabs the side of a stall, pulls himself up with one hand, and jams his lighter under a smoke detector!
With a hiss, the sprinklers burst to life, spraying the room with water and washing away the manure!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A-ha!
You jump down and rush out of the stables, proudly wiping your hands clean.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stables... Cleaned!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: And horses terrified, but I suppose I didn't specify anything about that.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I have to give you credit... I didn't think you'd be able to pull this off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is there anything fire `can't` fix?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is there anything fire [color=#e23b3b][i]can't[/i][/color] fix?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha!
Carson pats Colt on the back, and the two head back to the hidden lair.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I gotta say, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I think things around here are going to be a lot less boring with you around...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: After great consideration, we have decided that the newest member of The Immortals will be...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hephaestus!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yes! This is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is crap!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Actually, it's totally logical. He was `way` better than the rest of you guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it's totally logical. He was [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] better than the rest of you guys.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! He's way better than losers like you!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Except Mark. He's okay.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Can we appeal?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I'm sorry, dear Thomas, but all decisions are final and permanent.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now please do us all a favor and get out of here. We Immortals have business to conduct...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Secret` business.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Secret[/i][/color] business.

nodes.text: Back in their room, Colt and Tom pace around, angrily...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, this sucks! All that, and we `still` didn't get in?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, this sucks! All that, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] didn't get in?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know! I think it was rigged from the start!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Those jerks! I bet their secret society sucks anyway! What do they know about having a good time?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nothing! You and I could have a way better time without them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Tom... I just had a crazy idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That it's really a good time to divest my shares in Swiss pork bellies?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! We should totally form our own secret society! We could put theirs to shame!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah! That's a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could call ourselves 'The Even More Immortals!'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Let's just table the name for now.
Later that day, in the Spartan cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Attention one and all! We'd like to announce the formation of a `new` secret society!
nodes.text_bbcode: Attention one and all! We'd like to announce the formation of a [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] secret society!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! And it'll be way better than those crappy Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If you'd like to join, please meet us in the Quad at midnight!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, hey guys. Quick question...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's up, Captain Emo?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If this is a `secret` society, why are you shouting about it in the cafeteria?
nodes.text_bbcode: If this is a [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society, why are you shouting about it in the cafeteria?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... Is an excellent point.
And later that night...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well? How'd your recruitment go?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Terribly!` No one wanted to join our secret society! Plus the headmaster wrote me up for soliciting, and I don't even know what that means!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Terribly![/i][/color] No one wanted to join our secret society! Plus the headmaster wrote me up for soliciting, and I don't even know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How about you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I did find one recruit...
Tom steps aside, revealing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hola! Mi nombre es Erik!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a secret clubhouse, right? I figured we'd all be talking in code!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is your code just speaking in Spanish?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho ho! Aren't you some Clever Cathies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now then! What's on the agenda? Board games? Lemonade? Silly wigs?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Because let me tell you, I have `quite` the silly wig collection...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because let me tell you, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]quite[/i][/color] the silly wig collection...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ergggggh.
A secret society like that is no secret society at all! This can't be the way it ends!
Try again, and see if you can do a better job!
Colt has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Colt delivers a devastating punch to Tom's side!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ooooof!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ouch...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Brutal!
Tom stumbles weakly, trying to regain his footing...
And Colt shoves him in the chest as hard as he can, sending him tumbling backwards over the coffee table! Tom hits the ground hard and lies there...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... Really... Hurt...!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boom! What a rush! I'd forgotten how fun a good fight could be!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, that was unexpectedly fast and efficient!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Kind of boring too...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I'm excited to announce that the newest member of our order will be... Hades!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heck yeah it will!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then... The first item on our agenda is...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, hold your horses there, Poofball. I'm not done fighting yet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I challenge... Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait, what? You can't challenge me!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Actually... According to the bylaws of The Immortals... He can.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Volume 3, Article 7. Any member of The Immortals may challenge a superior member for status via either a bout of hand-to-hand combat, or a vigorous game of hide-and-go-seek.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's right! Hand-to-hand combat! Now come on, Meathead... Get over here!
A few minutes later, Chad lies unconscious on top of Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Unf! Yeah! That is how we do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now get over here, Chuckles! You're next!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sigh. Let's just get this over with...
And a few minutes after that, only Percy and Colt are left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Shaggalicious, let's do the man-dance!
Percy assumes a terse, combative stance...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You overzealous buffoon, I'll have you know that I've been trained in jiu jitsu and tae kwan do!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? You know what I'm trained in? A little bit of the ol' kick-yo-butt!
Colt swings his foot in a low sweep, kicking Percy's feet out from under him! He tumbles back, smacks into the coffee table, and rolls onto the pile of unconscious guys!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Who's number one? Who's `number one?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah! Who's number one? Who's [color=#e23b3b][i]number one?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's me, in case you were wondering. `I'm` number one.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's me, in case you were wondering. [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] number one.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugggggh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now then! As leader of The Immortals, I'm changing my name from Hades to Dragonsaurus Rex!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm also changing the point of the club! From now on, it's all about fighting! Fighting all the time!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: In fact, from now on... It shall be known as `Fist Club!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, from now on... It shall be known as [color=#e23b3b][i]Fist Club![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa... Weird... Why did I just have a sudden urge to watch wrestling and call up Sam?
Colt turning into Spencer? That's `definitely` not right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt turning into Spencer? That's [b]definitely[/b] not right!

nodes.text: The truth is...
At the other end of the field, Colt jogs over to the Spartan guys and tosses Tom the empty salt bag.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What was all that about? Who's the girl?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you worry your rich, little head. Let's just get out of here.
A little while later, in the Den of The Immortals...
The four initiates sit on the couch. The Immortals convene at the far end of the room.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You okay, Colt? You look a little down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's nothing, man, don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ahem! The Council of Immortals has reached their verdict!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that what this is? Some dumb school pride thing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe... I mean, that's one way of looking at it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't understand... You `never` cared about that kind of thing when you were at Centerscore...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand... You [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] cared about that kind of thing when you were at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Suddenly you go to Spartan, and you're, what, this big conformist?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it's not like that. There are these trials I have to do, you know... To get in with The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, what are you `talking` about?
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, what are you [color=#3b78e2][i]talking[/i][/color] about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't have an easy answer for you, okay? I said `it's complicated!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have an easy answer for you, okay? I said [color=#e23b3b][i]it's complicated![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine then! If this is the kind of guy you want to be, then go right ahead.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just... I thought you were better than this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess you don't know me that well, do you, Princess?
Colt turns and rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... Wait...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And you're doing that by... Ruining our football field?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When you put it like that, it does sound kind of crazy... But I promise you it makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How, Colt? How does it make sense? Because right now, I'm seriously worried about your mental health!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I... It's not like that. I promise you, my mental health is `fine.` This is just a thing I have to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I... It's not like that. I promise you, my mental health is [color=#e23b3b][i]fine.[/i][/color] This is just a thing I have to do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But why? This just doesn't seem like you at all...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, maybe I don't `want` to seem like me, okay?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to seem like me, okay?!

nodes.text: Colt sighs deeply.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Princess. The Colt you know... The Colt you `think` you know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Princess. The Colt you know... The Colt you [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] you know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's not a good guy, okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's `not` true.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] true.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It `is` true. I'm reckless, and I'm selfish, and I hurt the people I care about. You of all people should know that.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] true. I'm reckless, and I'm selfish, and I hurt the people I care about. You of all people should know that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right now, I'm trying as hard as I can to become a better guy. And you know what? I don't really know how.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm trying, okay? And honestly, sometimes, that might mean I make mistakes or do things I'm not really sure about...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like... Pouring salt all over the football field?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly. So do me a favor, and don't judge me too much, okay? Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not judging you, Colt... I care about you...
Behind Colt, from the wooden horse, several guys shout...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come on, Colt! We gotta get back to Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! The Immortals are waiting!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What part of `secret` society don't you get, Mark? Seriously!
nodes.text_bbcode: What part of [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society don't you get, Mark? Seriously!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are they talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. Don't worry about it. I... I gotta get going.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right.
Colt pats Denni awkwardly on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See you 'round, Tiny Hipster.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...You too.
Denni sadly watches him go...
A few minutes later, Colt paces onto the football field. It's been completely devastated by the wooden horse, torn up with huge, deep rifts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, they're all gone.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, and the field's all ruined, no thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Pushing a giant horse is `seriously` not easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: Pushing a giant horse is [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] not easy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, neither is betraying a bunch of people you used to call friends. Can we just go back to Spartan now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not yet. We've razed the field... But we still have to salt it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought that was just a metaphor. You know, like, 'stop, drop, and roll'?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You don't know what a metaphor is, do you?
Tom leans into the horse and pulls out a heavy bag of salt. He tosses it to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well? Salt away!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Because you took forever to distract the cheerleaders, dude! Now go do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, this blows...
Colt pulls open the bag and runs around the field, frantically dumping salt everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't even know... Why ancient warriors did this... It's not like they were gonna... Taste the dirt...
Just as he's about to dump the last of the salt, he hears a familiar voice...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Colt?!
Colt spins around to see Denni standing behind him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tiny Hipster! Hey! What... What are you doing here so early?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Inside?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I couldn't help but overhear your conversation... And it sounds like you're having some problems with the routine...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're telling me! These lazy butts are acting like they barely even care!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just.... So tired...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, see, whenever I'm really having trouble getting motivated with something, I like to change up where and how I'm doing it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like, if I was stuck on a problem in my math homework, I'd go outside, get some fresh air, and try again!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You do your math homework?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I said 'if.'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if we tried this idea... Where would we practice?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How about in a classroom? That could be crazy, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Colt, that sounds a little risky...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If $ZOE thinks it's risky, that means it's probably totes fun! Let's do it!
And so, a few minutes later, the cheerleaders have gathered in a classroom, and are standing on desks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, girls! The challenge is to practice our routine without falling down!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Heh... This is actually kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! Everything's more fun when it's `dangerous!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Everything's more fun when it's [color=#3b78e2][i]dangerous![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I really worry about you girls sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, has anyone seen Amanda?
The door swings open, and Amanda rushes in.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There's a giant wooden horse spinning around on the football field!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure there is, Manda-Panda. Sure there is.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt! I think you really helped Centerscore out today!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess I did...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A stroll?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you know... A nice, happy stroll around the campus... Hear the sights, see the sounds... A real trip down memory lane!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why would we possibly want to take a trip down memory lane? We still go here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, uh, maybe we should, you know, see if anything's going on... Crazy things are always happening on this campus, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Uh, no they aren't... Not at `5:30` in the morning!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no they aren't... Not at [color=#3b78e2][i]5:30[/i][/color] in the morning!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is this some kind of an elaborate ruse to make out with us? Because that's the only thing I'd be interested in.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not interested either way...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Seriously though, the sooner this is done, the sooner I can take a nap. So if you're just trying to make small talk, can you just leave us alone?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Right.
Colt wanders back to the campus...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, when did I get so bad at this? I used to be really good at hustling people...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... When in doubt...
Colt leans over and pulls the fire alarm! A blaring alarm blasts through the school!
A few minutes later, the cheerleaders come running by...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: A fire alarm? `Again?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A fire alarm? [color=#3b78e2][i]Again?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It wasn't me this time! I swear! I don't even `have` any more candles!
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't me this time! I swear! I don't even [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] any more candles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, lazies! We'll just have to practice in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough distraction! Remove the handcuffs!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...
Carson walks over and removes the handcuffs from all the guys.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, third and final challenge time. What have you got?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The final challenge will be a `Group` Trial! All of you will be in it together.
nodes.text_bbcode: The final challenge will be a [color=#e23b3b][i]Group[/i][/color] Trial! All of you will be in it together.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Saw that coming...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And what exactly will we be doing?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You have been tested in myth... You have seasoned the great wilds... And finally, you must master that most ancient and Spartan of pursuits...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Warfare.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man, is this all some kind of elaborate recruitment drive? Because I am `not` joining the Army...
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw man, is this all some kind of elaborate recruitment drive? Because I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] joining the Army...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: In times of war, the Spartans would decimate their enemies' villages, and then salt the ruins so that nothing would ever grow there.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Tonight, you will do the same!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You will infiltrate the campus of our greatest rival, Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then, you will devastate their football field and salt the ruined earth!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How are we supposed to ruin the field in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: By plowing it with a giant wooden horse!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why did I even ask...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You can find the giant horse outside. Complete this challenge... And become worthy of being Immortal!
Most of the other guys file out. Colt stays behind with Tom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey... Hold on a moment, Fancypants.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's wrong? Let's go get this stupid thing over with.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, man, messing with Centerscore? That doesn't feel right...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why not? Because it's your old school?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, yeah, dude. It might not be my school anymore, but I had some pretty good times there. It feels weird to suddenly be trying to ruin their field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt, you're a Spartan now. That makes Centerscore your biggest `rival.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, you're a Spartan now. That makes Centerscore your biggest [color=#e23b3b][i]rival.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, but still... You're just cool with it? Doesn't `your` girlfriend go to Centerscore?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, but still... You're just cool with it? Doesn't [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] girlfriend go to Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Barely. She spends most of her time in that bakery, and it's not like she cares about football.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, she'd probably think it was funny.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ehhh... It just seems wrong to me, man...
Tom steps forward and puts his hand on Colt's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, Colt, I get it. It's your past, and you're not ready to give up on it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But you're the one who wanted to turn over a new leaf. You wanted to become a new man. A better man.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that means messing up a football field?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It means committing to who you are. And that means being a Spartan... An Immortal.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now come on. Let's do this thing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Right.
A little while later, the four guys push a giant wooden horse up to the Centerscore football field. The first rays of sunrise drift over the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're gonna have to do this quickly, gents... Morning's coming fast!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah... And that's not our only problem!
Lee points across the field where a bunch of Centerscore cheerleaders are practicing!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! It's 5:30 in the morning! What are they doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Centerscore cheerleaders, man... It's all `kinds` of crazy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Centerscore cheerleaders, man... It's all [color=#e23b3b][i]kinds[/i][/color] of crazy.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Well, we're not going to be able to mess up this field while they're on it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt! You have an in with them! Go distract them so we don't get caught!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm on it...
Colt walks across the field to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, girls! Let's see some lunges! And this time, put some `spirit` into it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, girls! Let's see some lunges! And this time, put some [color=#3b78e2][i]spirit[/i][/color] into it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Jessica, I'm just really tired...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Me too... We've been doing this all night!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. All night practice! Why didn't you just sleep during the day?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were in class...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not following.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there, ladies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm, uh, just, you know, hanging out, seeing the old alma mater...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your grandma lives here?
Behind the cheerleaders, on the outskirts of school, the other Spartan guys gesture angrily...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, listen, why don't we...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the Spartan way, right? Fight! With, you know, honor!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fight? Fight how?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, punch them?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `You` punch them!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] punch them!

nodes.text: One of the badgers lunges forward, snapping its jaws!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Does that thing have three rows of teeth?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggggh!
Colt lunges forward, kicking at a badger! It ducks effortlessly under his foot, and he tumbles down, dragging Tom with him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!
The badger lumbers forward and rears up. Tom desperately raises his hand to block it...
And a blast of shaving cream shoots out of his watch, nailing the badger in the face!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hsssss!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! That worked!
Tom waves his hand around, shooting shaving cream like confetti. The badgers snarl and retreat, vanishing into the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude... Next time I rag on one of your stupid rich guy gadgets, feel free to slug me in the face.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it was your bright idea to fight, wasn't it?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh... I guess it was!
Five minutes later, Colt and Tom come strolling back into The Immortals' den...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey guys! How's it going? Wondering who just `aced` your second test?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey guys! How's it going? Wondering who just [color=#e23b3b][i]aced[/i][/color] your second test?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, that's right! It was us! Tom and Colt!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Apollo and Hades.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right, right.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, I must say, I'm impressed. You two may have just set a new Immortals record...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hrmph... Beginner's luck...
Just then, the door to the room swings open, and Mark and Lee stagger in. Their clothes are torn, and they're all scratched up.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Did you know there's a bunch of pissed-off honey badgers covered in shaving cream out there?
