nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We... Uh... Might know a thing or two about that, yes...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Go! Run! `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Go! Run! [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt and Tom bolt as fast as they can...
But Colt goes right and Tom goes left! The handcuff binding them pulls taut, and the two go crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Agggh!
One of the badgers rears up on its hind legs, and makes a high-pitched cackling noise...

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hhhh hhh hhh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did that badger just laugh at us?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's some kind of demon, man! Go! `Go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's some kind of demon, man! Go! [color=#e23b3b][i]Go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt frantically scampers forward, dragging Tom after him. The two push through the bushes...
And burst out of the foliage, right off a tall, steep ledge overlooking the raging stream!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aaaaaieeeeeee!
Thirty painful minutes later, Tom and Colt walk into the Den of The Immortals. They're soaking wet, bruised, and battered.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hfff... Hff... We made it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your initiations suck!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmmm, perhaps it is you that sucks, Hades? Seeing as how you arrived nearly an hour `after` the other team?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mmmm, perhaps it is you that sucks, Hades? Seeing as how you arrived nearly an hour [color=#e23b3b][i]after[/i][/color] the other team?!

nodes.text: Colt looks over to the couch, where Mark and Lee are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey dude.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: We ordered pizza.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Any left?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: One slice of pineapple.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awww... I `hate` pineapple...
nodes.text_bbcode: Awww... I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] pineapple...

nodes.text: Tom and Colt approach a tall ridge...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt! Look! I can see the lights of the school down below! We must be getting close!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh! Looks like you're right! Except...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Except?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except if those are the lights of the school... Then what are `those` lights in the bushes?
nodes.text_bbcode: Except if those are the lights of the school... Then what are [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] lights in the bushes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The ones... Slowly moving... Towards us...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt... Those aren't lights...
The bushes near the two guys rustle and part...
Revealing several enormous badgers!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hsss! Snarl!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggh! Badgers!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not just any badgers... Honey badgers! The most fearsome mammal on the planet! They don't care about `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not just any badgers... Honey badgers! The most fearsome mammal on the planet! They don't care about [color=#e23b3b][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is this part of the test?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know! These Immortal guys really seem to hate animals!
Growling and hissing, the badgers slowly lumber towards the two guys...

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Nddss flssh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think he just said he needs flesh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do we do? They're gonna kill us!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I say we...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just get this over with, all right? The stupid handcuff's chafing at my wrist.
Colt and Tom approach the rushing water's edge...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As I'll ever be. Let's do this.
The two take a deep breath and jump in together...
Immediately getting swept down by the current!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aggggh! Too fast! Too fast!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Swim! Come on! `Swim!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Swim! Come on! [color=#e23b3b][i]Swim![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The two guys paddle frantically, but can't coordinate their motions! The raging stream carries them down a ways, before dumping them onto a rocky beach!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who knew... You can't swim... While handcuffed?!
Colt pulls himself up, shaking water out of his ears.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gee, I don't know, Tom! I kind of figured that's the kind of thing you'd know, what with the swim team and all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We didn't swim handcuffed!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then it wasn't much of a swim team, was it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...We'll address your baffling understanding of water sports later. For now, we need to get back on track.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good luck...
And so, after a long and soggy trek through the woods...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? I can do this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, man, I don't care if you think you're a freaking mermaid...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm telling you, there is `no way` we can make it across a raging stream handcuffed to each other. It's just impossible.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm telling you, there is [color=#e23b3b][i]no way[/i][/color] we can make it across a raging stream handcuffed to each other. It's just impossible.

nodes.text: Tom looks out at the water and sighs...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I suppose you're right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Though, for the record, I fancy myself a mer`man...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Though, for the record, I fancy myself a mer[color=#e23b3b][i]man...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just keep what you fancy to yourself, okay?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So what's the game plan? Walk around until we find another way?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could do that, or...
Colt leads Tom over to a tall, rotting tree by the water's edge.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Swiss market for pork bellies is sure to decline in the coming fiscal quarter?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Just help me push this tree.
Tom and Colt press their backs to the tree. They heave as hard as they can...
And it snaps off its stump, toppling down and making a perfect bridge across the water!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well-played, Colt. Well-played.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now let's get back to the stupid society!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Secret` society.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Secret[/i][/color] society.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever.
The guys walk carefully across the log and into the woods.
And soon enough...
Colt struggles to keep his composure...
But gag on the fumes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Urrrrp!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't... Do this!
Colt staggers forward and tumbles out of the stables, sprawling face-down on the polo field!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ufff... `Uffff.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ufff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Uffff.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't... Do it... That place... Smells terrible...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one should ever... Have to clean that...
The Spartan high janitor steps up to you...

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: `I` will have to clean that.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] will have to clean that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Sorry.
The janitor sadly walks in, carrying a mop and a bucket.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, this touching lesson in class consciousness aside, it looks like you've failed the last trial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Does that mean I've lost the initiation? I `hate` losing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Does that mean I've lost the initiation? I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] losing...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, no, you're fine. You only had to complete eight out of the twelve trials.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Then why did I even do the last four?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because it was funny to me. Now come on! Let's get you back to the council...
A little while later, Colt and Carson pull up outside a huge mansion. They walk through the gates to a huge, sprawling garden.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All right, Chuckles, where are we?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: My dad's manor. And before you say anything, yes, he's super-rich, and no, he's not home.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How do you even get so rich?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: He invented the piggy bank. Before that, kids just kept their change in jars. Very sad.
Something big rustles in the bushes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, my dad's this whole nature nut. This place is kind of a wildlife preserve. It's where you'll begin your Solo Trial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to like this, am I?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Almost certainly not. The myth you'll be recreating is the `Twelve Labors of Hercules.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Almost certainly not. The myth you'll be recreating is the [color=#e23b3b][i]Twelve Labors of Hercules.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: The first thing Hercules did was slay the Nemean Lion...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want me to slay a lion?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not a lion, per se, more of a puma. And you don't have to slay it, just steal a tuft of its fur.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You can find its pen a little ways down. Have fun!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stupid secret society...
A few minutes later, Colt comes stumbling back, with his shirt torn and his hair tussled. He triumphantly waves a fistful of fur.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Done! I showed that puma who's boss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's my next task?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, after defeating the Nemean Lion, Hercules fought the Erymanthian Boar!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on!
A boar, a deer, a bull, a dog, and some birds later, Colt stands panting in the middle of the clearing...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Wow, I have to say, I'm actually pretty impressed. You'll be happy to hear you're done with the animal labors...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: But you still have a few left. Next, you'll have to kidnap the Queen of the Amazons...
Colt rushes across the lawn of Monarch Prep with Paige slung across his shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am totally fine with this!
And soon enough, on the Spartan Polo field...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All right! Eleven labors done!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Just one last labor to do... The most unpleasant of all... To clean the Aegean stables!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Or in this case... The Spartan Academy polo stables!
Carson throws open a set of doors, revealing the stables where all of the horses for the polo team reside. The overpowering stench of manure wafts out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oh!` That is `horrible!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh![/i][/color] That is [color=#e23b3b][i]horrible![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It smells way worse than the last time I was here...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yep. In anticipation of this trial, Percy asked the groundskeepers not to clean it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: To pass the trial, you're going to have to make it spotless. Also, you have ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Since when do I have ten minutes?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Since I got bored! Go!
Carson steps back. Colt scrambles in and grabs a hose at the far end.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... Just need to keep it together... And ignore the smell...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The terrible, `terrible` smell...
nodes.text_bbcode: The terrible, [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible[/i][/color] smell...

nodes.text: Colt turns the spigot on the hose and starts spraying!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Tom. He's my friend, and this doesn't feel right.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Either you take both of us... Or neither. Isn't that right, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Fine! They're both out, then! Let's go get Lee and Mark!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No. We already told them they were out. There's no going back on that...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Plus, you know, they're already probably back in their dorms, and I really don't feel like going to get them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You can't be serious, guys! We're not letting them both in!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, that's `exactly` what we're doing.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: We opened up this possibility when we let them both compete... And according to the bylaws of our society, they've both won the Trials.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: If they refuse to compete... We have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades... Apollo... Welcome to The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well then! Let's just get settled and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold your horses, Shagri La, because I'm not done talking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm starting to accept that this secret society might just be the right thing for me to get my life in order...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I am `not` happy with the way you do things here.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happy with the way you do things here.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For starters, Centerscore might be our biggest rival, but we're done with dumb pranks like ruining their football field. We've done enough damage.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we're so worried about beating them, let's do it in a fair and honest competition.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the way it is, Meathead. Either the feud between Spartan and Centerscore ends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or Tom and I are out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is totally out of line! `Totally!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is totally out of line! [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: He can't just come in here and change how we do things!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, this doesn't seem okay...
Percy stares at Colt thoughtfully... Then smiles a wry, tricky grin.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Offer accepted.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?! You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades here has an excellent point. We've wasted too much effort on those losers at Centerscore already. If leaving them alone is his price... We'll pay it.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! This is seriously not okay! I... I formally protest!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And I will formally tell you to shut your cartoonishly loud mouth, Ares, or I swear by the Gods above and below, I will kick you out of this society.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Need I remind you... This is `not` a democracy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Need I remind you... This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's in the bylaws. Volume 15, Article 9. 'This is not a democracy.'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hmph!
Chad storms furiously out. Colt watches him go, then walks over and sits on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... What's the first thing on our agenda? Are there any international markets to manipulate? Political lobbies to infiltrate?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me you have insider stock tips! Because let me tell you, I have a feeling about these Swiss pork bellies...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Slow your roll, good Apollo! All that comes later! First, enjoy some of our society's special amenities!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amenities?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What exactly are we talking about here?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, beyond the use of this excellent lounge...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You get to enjoy priority registration in classes at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, I can take all afternoon classes and sleep in every morning?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly! Not only that, but we receive custom-catered lunches... VIP treatment at all the clubs and restaurants in town... Regular consultations from a personal stylist...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And if you feel like visiting a special ladyfriend, there's a hidden tunnel that runs from this den across the river to Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My special ladyfriend actually goes to Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmm. We'll deal with that later.
Percy walks off. Tom walks over and sits down on the couch next to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey. What you did back there? That was... Very gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't sweat it, man. It was the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: After everything we've been through together... It would've felt wrong to end on those terms.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You know, Colt, you told me that you wanted to come to Spartan to be a better man...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But sometimes, I think you might already be the best man here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, man, but don't get all sappy on me. Mostly I just didn't feel like bruising you up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha, well, it's funny that you say that because... You do know I'd win, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think you'd win in a fight against me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, as a matter of fact I do. And just so it's clear, I'm talking about a fair fight, not you sneaking up on me in an alley with a crowbar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Richie, I could take you in a fair fight with a blindfold on and one hand tied behind my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! Well, I could take `you` with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, `and` a rabid chimp on my shoulders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, I could take [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a rabid chimp on my shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, I could...
Looks like Tom and Colt made it into The Immortals... And preserved their friendship! Their... Very odd... Friendship!
Congratulations on playing a great game!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So then I'll meet you outside the cabin on Saturday morning... And trust me, $ZOE. When this is all over, you'll have made your choice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! I don't think you'd try to help me like this if you were still hung-up on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow, you really `are` nice! No wonder Howard likes you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, you really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] nice! No wonder Howard likes you.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just try to treat people how I want to be treated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, I'll go with you. I accept!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! We can even share stories about Howard's weird quirks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like how his `hair` is always scruffy in the back?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like how his [color=#3b78e2][i]hair[/i][/color] is always scruffy in the back?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hahaha! That's true! It is!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is going to be fun!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to see some kind of evidence that you are actually over Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You mean besides the fact that I'm `not` dating him, `haven't` pursued him, and am now nicely offering to help you with `your` romantic problems?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean besides the fact that I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] dating him, [color=#3b78e2][i]haven't[/i][/color] pursued him, and am now nicely offering to help you with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] romantic problems?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you put it like that, it does sound like you're over him...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's because I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you going to accept my help or not? Because I'm seriously reconsidering...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I accept! I'll go!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ever since I went to `Labors of Love,` I've really started to appreciate being outdoors.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ever since I went to [color=#3b78e2][i]Labors of Love,[/i][/color] I've really started to appreciate being outdoors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Labors of Love?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's a retreat for women with romantic problems. Hector's uncle Miguel hosts it at his cabin in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That might be the creepiest sentence I've ever heard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know! I know! I was skeptical at first too... But Hector told me his uncle was an expert on matters of the heart, and he was right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Miguel helped me see the right choice... That neither Howard nor Kenji was the right guy for me.
Linda absentmindedly plays with a small heart pendant around her neck.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I want to help you, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I feel like I really messed up when I couldn't decide between Howard or Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I see you heading down the same path and... And I just can't let you make the same mistake!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Miguel is training me to become a counselor... And I want to use what I've learned to help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if it's a good idea for us to spend time together, Linda. I mean, you're Howard's ex!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I understand, but it's been a long time. I'm over Howard now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, then...
$ZOE finds Linda near the Lyle the Lizard statue...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Wow, that was quick! I realized after I left my note that I had just signed it 'L.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay! As soon as I read it, I knew it was from you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After your issues with Kenji and... And Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I figured you'd know what it's like to be torn between two guys.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm glad you came, $ZOE. I was afraid you might not want to see me because of my history with Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The truth is... If you want to give me advice... I guess it actually makes you `more` qualified.
nodes.text_bbcode: The truth is... If you want to give me advice... I guess it actually makes you [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] qualified.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's really thoughtful of you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, it was either you or Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, Ms. Lee is crazy when it comes to guys!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When I was waffling between Howard and Kenji, she told me I should choose Kenji because guys with motorcycles are the most dependable!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee! I once walked by her office when she was fighting with her boyfriend, and I heard her break up with him because he cheated on her in his dream!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hahahaha!
A light breeze blows through the air... Linda closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing out here anyway?
$ZOE steps into Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Ms. Lee... Did you...?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Just the person I wanted to see!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I did get the right 'L'. What's your guy advice?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Men? Ha! Let me tell you, girl, lesson number one...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you find your man is still emailing his ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: `Accidentally` run over his golf clubs a couple times!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Accidentally[/i][/color] run over his golf clubs a couple times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That's really specific.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Lesson two!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If he plans a `'nice'` date, and you get all dolled up, and then he takes you to a Cowboy Burger...
nodes.text_bbcode: If he plans a [color=#3b78e2][i]'nice'[/i][/color] date, and you get all dolled up, and then he takes you to a Cowboy Burger...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The next time he tries to kiss you, tell him cheap food gives you rabies! Then, start barking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Ms. Lee, weren't you going to help me with `my` guy problems. You know, Howard and Matteo?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Ms. Lee, weren't you going to help me with [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] guy problems. You know, Howard and Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, `two` guys? Well, that's easy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] guys? Well, that's easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid to know why...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All you gotta do is get them in a cage together. Last one standing is the winner!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That's how I met my second ex-husband!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee. I'll... Always remember the 'put them in a cage' idea.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anytime, Sharon!
$ZOE steps back into the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Definitely `the wrong` L. I hope it's not too late to find Linda.
nodes.text_bbcode: Definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]the wrong[/i][/color] L. I hope it's not too late to find Linda.

nodes.text: Outside, near the Lyle the Lizard statue, $ZOE finds Linda sitting on the grass in a cross-legged pose with her eyes closed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda? Was it you who left me this note?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course! Who else would it be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... You signed it 'L.'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Well, who did you think 'L' was? Ms. Lee?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, I didn't think you were going to come see me, so I started my meditation routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... So, does that mean...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Shh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How long...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Shh!
After several uncomfortable minutes of silence, Linda opens her eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you always come out here to meditate?
Later that day, after class...
$ZOE opens up her locker and finds a note stuffed inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Dear $ZOE, I can help you with your guy problems. Sincerely, L.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess everyone saw me run out of the cafeteria today...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who is 'L'? 'L' could be Linda, but would Howard's ex-girlfriend `really` want to help me?
nodes.text_bbcode: But who is 'L'? 'L' could be Linda, but would Howard's ex-girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want to help me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or it could be... Ms. Lee! She's crazy enough to do something like this...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You do?
Keith's voice rises in volume!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keith! Shh...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Does Howard know you still have feelings for Matteo?!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE? Do you still have feelings for Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She totes does! That's why she sat so far away from him!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, if she sat any closer, she wouldn't have been able to help herself from drooling all over him!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am right here, you know this?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE...
$ZOE stands up and flees the cafeteria!
And runs crying right into one of the bathroom stalls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Could this day get any more embarrassing?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! Girl in the guys' bathroom! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I can imagine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going through a lot right now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's Howard and Matteo and the dance is coming up... It's all one big mess!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I wouldn't worry about it too much, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whenever I start to get worried about how things are going with me and my girlfriend, Chelsea...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Something happens that just makes our relationship that much stronger!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awwww. Thanks, Keith! That makes me feel better!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! Hold up... You have a girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: She lives in Canada! I've told you this like a hundred times!
As the guys argue, $ZOE can't help but look over at Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Promise me we'll make out later!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: No! Promise me!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are all very forthcoming...
$ZOE gets up and runs out of the cafeteria!
Howard plays the movie...
Thirty minutes in, $ZOE's eyes get heavy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Warm... So... Sleepy...
Suddenly she's standing in a beautiful Italian vineyard!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno, signorina! You are my perfect grape! Come, let us ride horses together throughout the countryside!
Matteo and $ZOE ride alongside each other on two beautiful horses!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is so fun!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do you know what is more fun than riding horses together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Dancing forbidden dances in my villa!
$ZOE is wearing a beautiful dress! Matteo embraces her and begins to twirl her expertly around the dance floor!
He pulls her back to him and whispers in her ear...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are like a flower in the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Matteo!
He spins her one more time, dipping her and then pulling her back up to him...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Come to the dance with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Matteo! Of course I will!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now I will kiss you as you are meant to be kissed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kiss me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Howard... I was having a dream.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Must have been `some` dream! Of course I'll kiss you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Must have been [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] dream! Of course I'll kiss you!

nodes.text: Howard leans across the couch and gives $ZOE a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry that the movie's so boring.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's okay... I... I think I should go home anyway...
The next day at lunch, $ZOE sits with Hector and Keith at one end of the Center Table...
Meanwhile, Matteo is sitting on the other end, completely surrounded by cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, you sure you don't want to sit next to Mr. Hot Guy over there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This sucks, man. Before he showed up, I used to eat lunch `with` hot girls. Now I eat lunch `kind of near` hot girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: This sucks, man. Before he showed up, I used to eat lunch [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] hot girls. Now I eat lunch [color=#e23b3b][i]kind of near[/i][/color] hot girls.

nodes.text: Nicole spills her drink on Matteo's shirt!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoops! I'm such a klutz! Here, let me dry that off for you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Should you maybe use a towel instead of your hand?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha! This is America, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not understand.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Maybe he should just take his shirt `off...` That would make him the most dry!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe he should just take his shirt [color=#3b78e2][i]off...[/i][/color] That would make him the most dry!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! Take it off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, aren't you worried about Amanda over there?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nah. She just likes belly buttons.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Matteo, I just thought I should mention... No one's asked me to the Valentine's Dance yet...
Jacob scoffs from a nearby table...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?! I asked you yesterday... And you said `yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! I asked you yesterday... And you said [color=#e23b3b][i]yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shut up, Jacob! Do `not` ruin this for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, Jacob! Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] ruin this for me!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am very sorry, but I have my eye set on someone else for the dance.
Matteo shoots $ZOE a quick glance...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I've gotta say, Matteo, Centerscore has gotten a lot more fun since you came here...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You're like the most popular guy in school!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You should run for President! It'd be way better to have a hot guy than Justin!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You'd have my vote!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha! That's funny! Everyone knows Matteo can't be President since he wasn't born in America!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, what? He's not running for President of `America...` He can totally be School President!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, what? He's not running for President of [color=#3b78e2][i]America...[/i][/color] He can totally be School President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?! But I need Ben to become...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls! Stop crowding Matteo! All of you come over this way `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls! Stop crowding Matteo! All of you come over this way [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Jessica pries the girls away from Matteo, Keith whispers across the table to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I know all this attention Matteo's getting has to be eating you up inside. After all, you did kiss him in Paris!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Do you still have, you know, feelings for him?

nodes.prompt: Do you still have feelings for Matteo?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you still have feelings for Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: More popcorn! I need more popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure...
Howard scoops some more popcorn into $ZOE's bowl.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you said something else...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just watch the movie, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! Here you go!
Howard gives $ZOE some more popcorn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you okay, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm fine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes... Let's just watch the movie, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay...
After school one day, $ZOE and Howard are eating together in $ZOE's house.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think of the cupcakes I baked, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Delicious as always, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Baking always makes the house so warm!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to `The Heaaaaart of the Sea...`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Heaaaaart of the Sea...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember how much fun we had acting like pirates and eating Plank Steak?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Um... Yeah, that was fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool, then... So... What do you want to do tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... I can't really think of anything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Want to watch another movie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE and Howard sit on the couch together, a bowl of popcorn between them...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch `More Amore!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch [color=#e23b3b][i]More Amore![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's about this couple who hates each other but finds love in Italy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo's from Italy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I need more...
$ZOE concentrates on her surroundings...
She feels the breeze as it softly blows against her skin. She hears the delightful chirping of the birds in the trees. And she takes deep, deep breaths...
After about twenty minutes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was wonderful. I really felt like I had become a part of this meadow...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did you have any revelations about Howard and Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... The only thing I learned is how much I have to concentrate just to `stop` thinking about them!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... The only thing I learned is how much I have to concentrate just to [color=#3b78e2][i]stop[/i][/color] thinking about them!

nodes.text: When $ZOE opens her eyes, she sees that she's in a room in the cabin...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You passed out, and you kept mumbling, 'Monkey, tell me what I've won!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had... A weird vision.
$ZOE sees a small heart pendant resting on the table next to her. She picks it up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't this yours?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, I still have mine. It's part of the retreat... Miguel gives these to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He said after the 'normal' steam room you'd probably have good use for it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The pendant is supposed to symbolize your own heart... And you give it to whomever it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's why you still have yours?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I just haven't found the right guy yet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What about you, though? Did you figure out what you're going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did... I know exactly what to do!
$ZOE has failed.
See if you can get the dive right this time!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: That is correct. You are ready for love. Now go away, I have some bananas to attend to.
The air fills with thick steam... $ZOE's eyes feel heavy...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: That wasn't the lesson at all!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Just because Howard is safer doesn't necessarily mean he's better! Safe can be boring!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand... Then, what's the lesson?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: The lesson is `you're an idiot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The lesson is [color=#3b78e2][i]you're an idiot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I don't understand how you humans are smart enough to theorize quantum entanglement, but so dumb you can't learn simple lessons!
$ZOE starts crying... The monkey sighs...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I forgot who I was talking to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I know, I know. It's been a long day for both of us.
The monkey holds up a small tissue for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: If you stop crying, I'll tell you the lesson, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: In order to choose Howard, you have to give up the unknown future you might have with Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... I see...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have some bananas to attend to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so hungry... There weren't any cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You are seriously obsessed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, what do you think happens now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe in all this steam I'll see the silhouette of the guy I'm supposed to be with... What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: She can't hear you. You're in my world now!
Sitting nearby is a monkey eating a banana.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I'm your Spirit Animal. I'm supposed to guide you and blah blah blah... But, whatever.
The monkey tosses his banana aside and starts to walk away.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You're clearly not worthy of my guidance.
As the monkey walks off, $ZOE starts to cry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I can't take this! Every time I think I'm going to learn how to deal with my feelings, I just find out that I'm out of luck, or that it's even more complicated, or that the monkey won't help me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that last part sounds weird, but cut me some slack, okay? It's been a long day...
The monkey turns around and comes back to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. I thought that the same 'tough love' style that worked with your boyfriend would work with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're... You're Howard's Spirit Animal too? Isn't that a sign that he and I are really meant to be with each other?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, to be honest, no. There aren't very many Spirit Animals, so there's a lot of overlap.
$ZOE sobs.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I mean, uh, `yes!` That's a `very` good sign! Just stop crying, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, uh, [color=#3b78e2][i]yes![/i][/color] That's a [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] good sign! Just stop crying, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why should I? I know that I need to choose someone now, and I know that my feelings for both Howard and Matteo are true, but there's nothing I can do!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I... I can help you, $ZOE. There is one more lesson to learn.
The monkey snaps his fingers and...
$ZOE finds herself on the set of a game show! The monkey is standing next to her, dressed in a tux and holding an oversized microphone.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Welcome, $ZOE! This is the final and only round of `Howard Or Matteo!` Yes! It's the game show where just one contestant, coincidentally named $ZOE, must make an impossible decision!
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome, $ZOE! This is the final and only round of [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard Or Matteo![/i][/color] Yes! It's the game show where just one contestant, coincidentally named $ZOE, must make an impossible decision!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Mr. Sprinkles, please show us what's behind door number one!
A small kitten slowly nudges open a huge door with a large '1' on it.
On the other side, Howard is sitting in a nice-looking car.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: It's a new car! That's right! This safe, comfortable, reliable vehicle is piloted by none other than your current boyfriend, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Pick me, and I'll always be there for you. I'll love you... Unconditionally.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: What more could a girl want?!
$ZOE sees Matteo standing in front of a huge door with a large '2' on it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about that door? Why is Matteo standing `in front` of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about that door? Why is Matteo standing [color=#3b78e2][i]in front[/i][/color] of it?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Funny you should ask! That brings us to the crux of our show! Take it away, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, beautiful $ZOE! I am your Italian dream... `Within a dream!` Pick my door, and you will get...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, beautiful $ZOE! I am your Italian dream... [color=#e23b3b][i]Within a dream![/i][/color] Pick my door, and you will get...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, life with me would be a mystery! A great surprise! A box of chocolates without a guide to tell you what is in each chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: What's it going to be, $ZOE? Door number one or door number two?
Voices call from the audience...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pick Howard! He's got the best gas-mileage!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Pick Matteo! If you don't, I'll make out with him every day!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Seriously, how can you say no to a guy who serenades you?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pick the one with the belly button!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, there you have it, the audience has weighed in. Now it's time for the moment of truth...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I think I know who to pick... It's been right in front of me this whole time. I love Howard, but I have feelings for Matteo...
The monkey snaps his fingers, and the game show set disappears.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I told you that you had one last lesson to learn. Can you tell me what that lesson is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: I must give up the unknown!

nodes.text: Miguel sits back down, excited.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You mean, the magical... I mean, the `normal` steam room?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, the magical... I mean, the [color=#e23b3b][i]normal[/i][/color] steam room?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Well, for 'legal' reasons, I'm not allowed to let you inside there, all because of some stupid, 'government' 'officials' who think it's 'unsafe.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was an uncomfortable number of air quotations.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Never mind those...
He leans forward, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I designed the steam room a long time ago because a mystic told me he felt an awesome power emanating from the earth there.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Now, people claim to have visions after they sit in it... But you didn't hear it from me...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Tonight, when everyone's asleep, I will be very careful about leaving all the doors `locked.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tonight, when everyone's asleep, I will be very careful about leaving all the doors [color=#e23b3b][i]locked.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He shoots them a small wink...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: `'Locked.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Locked.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks, Miguel.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for keeping things so, um, 'secure'.
That night, $ZOE and Linda creep into the steam room. Soon, steam is swirling around them...
Miguel sits back down, concerned.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You don't know what makes `love` magical?
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't know what makes [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] magical?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: You don't about the most incredible force upon this planet, our Mother Earth?
Linda gives $ZOE a small kick under the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I'd be in pain too, if I didn't know...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Luckily, we have several hours before lights out to get you up to speed on everything related to love!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that's necessary...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: It's no trouble. I'm going to be making carrot juice anyway!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Gross...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: We'll begin by discussing chemistry...
Several hours later, as the girls try to keep their eyes open...
