nodes.text: My mom would kill me if she knew I was on some random guy's motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good thing I'm not some random guy!
Colt revs the engine, and the bike takes off with a deafening roar! It races out of the garage...
And onto the streets of Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on tight, Princess... Town Hall is about ten minutes away, and I'm gonna make it in seven...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, Colt... You might want to make it five!
Colt glances over his shoulder... And sees a bright red convertible gaining on them! Chad sits behind the wheel, a furious look on his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This night just keeps getting better and better...
Chad floors it! His car races towards the bike!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We need to lose him!
Colt swerves his bike off the road and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why not?
Tom tugs on the window...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, they're locked, for one...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So break 'em!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: They're made of reinforced glass! Colt, think about the `last` time we were trapped in a room like this?
nodes.text_bbcode: They're made of reinforced glass! Colt, think about the [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] time we were trapped in a room like this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And how did we get out `that` time?
nodes.text_bbcode: And how did we get out [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Through... The floor!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Exactly!
Denni and Colt kneel down and forcibly pry up a floor tile, revealing a maintenance tunnel full of dirty pipes and electrical cables!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? Just like at Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Exactly!
Denni and Colt kneel down and forcibly pry up a floor tile, revealing a maintenance tunnel full of dirty pipes and electrical cables!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? Just like at Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How'd you know to do that?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just say this isn't our first time trapped like this...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's a long story!
He slams it a few more times, but it doesn't budge! He's about to slam his whole body into it when a soft hand touches his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't bother, Colt. They've got us trapped.
Colt turns around and looks at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I... I don't understand. What's going on? Why were you and Captain Emo taping us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We knew The Immortals were up to something... And when we realized what, we knew we had to get proof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I get that, but... Why were you at Spartan in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because I was worried about you, Colt! I knew you'd gotten mixed up in something bad at Spartan, and I needed to make sure you were okay!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know you told me you didn't want to see me again in that email, but I just had to ignore it and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, slow down, Princess. `What` email?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, slow down, Princess. [color=#e23b3b][i]What[/i][/color] email?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The... The one you sent yesterday... The one where you said you wanted me to stay out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I never sent you an email. I haven't even checked my email in, like, a month and a half.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then... How...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Someone must have hacked your account!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Percy. It had to be. Just another reason to pound his stupid face in...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...So you never told me off? You `don't` want me out of your life?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So you never told me off? You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want me out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And wait... If you were only here to check up on me... Does that mean you're not really dating Mark?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course not! That guy sucks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We are `so` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni step forward and hug!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I missed you too, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we `still` don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!
nodes.text_bbcode: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... `Half` of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... [color=#e23b3b][i]Half[/i][/color] of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Percy smashed your camera!
Nick grins and holds up his hand. Cradled in his palm is a little electronic card.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... But he didn't smash the DigiVid card with the video on it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You palmed it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude! Props!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, that `is` a great turn of events...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a great turn of events...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I still don't know how we're going to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually... I have an idea.
Denni glances at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you remember? Last time...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh! I get it! We should go out through the...

nodes.prompt: We should go out through the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We should go out through the...

nodes.text: A few moments later, the match begins...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, $Horse! Let's do this!
Colt plays very well, swiftly steering his horse after the ball and scoring a couple of goals!
After the match, Chad and the other Spartans confront Colt and Tom in the locker room!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I see what you and Tom are up to!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Just because you've gotten a couple of tips about riding a horse, that doesn't make you a Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, Chad...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, Tom, I've got this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Spartans are king-like warriors. And polo is considered to be the sport of kings. Therefore...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I kinda think it `does` qualify me for being a Spartan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I kinda think it [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] qualify me for being a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Nice use of the transitive property.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Preston! Don't compliment him! He can't even spell 'transitive!'
Chad turns to Colt, jabbing a finger at his chest.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You don't belong here! You're a nothing! And you always will be!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's your problem, Chad?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: He's a fake! An imitation of a Spartan! I earned my spot!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My father is rich! My mom's a Senator! What about his parents? Huh?
Chad gets right in Colt's face...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: They're probably just a bunch of nothings. Just like you.
Colt's fists clench...
And unclench!
He turns his back to Chad and resumes dressing.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! I'm still talking to you!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Just leave him alone, Chad.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're on his side now too!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, Colt! I'm not done with you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm done with you...
Chad shoves Colt in the back, slamming him into the locker.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt looks at Tom questioningly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is `this` the place for fighting?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] the place for fighting?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This? `Definitely.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This? [color=#e23b3b][i]Definitely.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad winds up for a punch, but before he can throw it, Colt spins and decks him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Ooh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad sprawls onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I played your game your way and 'won'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now you played your game my way and 'lost'.
Just then, there is the sound of soft clapping. Colt looks over to see the older Spartan standing in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Bravo.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Am I entertaining you?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Greatly.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Before, I said you weren't worth our time...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: But now I stand corrected... `Spartan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I stand corrected... [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He walks away... The other Spartans follow.
That evening, Tom and Colt relax in their dorm room.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm really proud of you, Colt. You managed to be yourself `and` be a Spartan too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm really proud of you, Colt. You managed to be yourself [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] be a Spartan too!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Someone had to bring you guys down to the gutter... Why not me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And what was the deal with that Percy guy? First he's all 'You're not worth my time', and then he's all 'You `are` worth my time'...
nodes.text_bbcode: And what was the deal with that Percy guy? First he's all 'You're not worth my time', and then he's all 'You [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] worth my time'...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that, like, a European thing?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a pompous blowhard thing. Now that you're on your way towards popularity, he wants to make sure he has you on his side.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, you jealous? Don't you worry your dear, little head... You'll always be `my` favorite spoiled rich dude.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, you jealous? Don't you worry your dear, little head... You'll always be [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] favorite spoiled rich dude.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Har har.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey... Can I ask you a personal question?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... Does it involve grooming?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: When we were up at that ski lodge, you mentioned you were dealing with some girl drama... Did that ever get resolved?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Not really.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of a long story. See, after we parted ways, I went to San Francisco and...
Just then, there's the sound of footsteps outside their door! The door rattles for a moment...
And then a letter slides underneath!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?
Colt walks over and picks it up, examining it against the light.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some kind of letter. It's got this weird seal on it, like a lightning bolt...
Tom's face goes white. His eyes open wide with disbelief.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... My...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you just say... A `lightning bolt?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say... A [color=#e23b3b][i]lightning bolt?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: What could this mysterious letter be?! Find out in the next `Surviving High School!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What could this mysterious letter be?! Find out in the next [b]Surviving High School![/b]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Colt and Carson walk back into The Immortals' lair, where everyone else is gathered.
Carson joins the other members at the front of the room. Colt takes a seat next to Tom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You doing okay, Fancypants?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Barely. That trial was `brutal.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Barely. That trial was [color=#e23b3b][i]brutal.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mine too. What'd you have to do?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Trial of Tantalus. They put this `incredible` three-course dinner in front of me, and I had to resist taking even a bite!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Trial of Tantalus. They put this [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible[/i][/color] three-course dinner in front of me, and I had to resist taking even a bite!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, seriously?! Your entire trial was to `not` eat a meal? That's it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, seriously?! Your entire trial was to [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] eat a meal? That's it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Have you ever had Kobe beef, Colt? I realize you probably subsist off potatoes and rye bread and, I don't know, lumps of coal, but you have no idea what I went through...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `I fought a freaking lion!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I fought a freaking lion![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Technically a puma.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Silence!
Percy steps to the front of the room and officially clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I have conferred with the other members of this society, and we have decided that all four of you pass to the next trial!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yay! I sure hope Tom doesn't have to `not` eat any more fancy meat!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yay! I sure hope Tom doesn't have to [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] eat any more fancy meat!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: His name is Apollo, and it's funny that you bring him up, Hades... Because for the next trial, the two of you are partners.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're what now?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: That's right. The second trial is a Duo Trial! Hades, you're with Apollo. Poseidon, you're with Hephaestus.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, we're a pretty good team.
Colt and Tom glance at each other.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we're pretty good too. I mean, this one time, we were on these ski slopes, and...
Before Colt can finish, Chad steps over and clasps Colt and Tom's wrists in handcuffs, binding them together!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Naw, man, naw, after San Francisco, I promised myself I'd never be in handcuffs again...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Take them away!
While Tom and Colt struggle, the other guys shove hoods over their heads and drag them out to a van...
And a little while later, they're forced out the back onto a rough patch of dirt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The van races off into the darkness. The two guys pull off their hoods and look around. They're deep in the woods, with no trail or path anywhere in sight.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude, this secret society better be the best thing in the world, because I am starting to get seriously sick of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what's the challenge here? Getting back to school in one piece?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That'd be my guess.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We were only in that van for about fifteen minutes, so we can't be far. My guess is we're in those big woods just north of Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That sounds right to me. In that case, what we want to do is head due south.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Good plan. Now we just need to figure out which way is due south.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure thing. I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, Tom, I'm thinking this through. We're supposed to look at the moss on trees, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If the trees have moss growing on them, it means we're in the north!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, wait, that can't be right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Actually, Colt, we can just...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not now, Tom, I'm thinking! Maybe we can make a compass... I saw this in a movie... We'll need a cup of water and a needle and a magnet...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Colt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Colt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom holds up his un-handcuffed wrist.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I have a compass in my watch!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes. Not to mention a barometer, a thermometer, an odometer, and a speedometer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Also, it dispenses shaving cream.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's it like to be literally made of money?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's it like to not know how to correctly use the word 'literally'? Now come on!
The two of them follow Tom's compass south for some time...
And come to a rushing stream that blocks their path!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, this isn't great.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're telling me. We're going to have to figure some way to cross. That's gonna take some time...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why don't we just swim it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want to swim that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure, why not?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't tell me you don't know how to swim. Is that one of those things they don't teach poor people?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I know how to swim, jerk. I just don't think we can swim `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I know how to swim, jerk. I just don't think we can swim [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, `I` certainly can. I was on the swim team for three years, you know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] certainly can. I was on the swim team for three years, you know...

nodes.text: Tom jerks on the handcuff connecting him to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I can't exactly do it on my own... So I guess it's your call.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. And I say we...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think I know what this means...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You have to make a choice `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to make a choice [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Otherwise, you'll be so wrapped up in this triangle, you won't be able to concentrate on anything else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want that... But I still don't know what I'm supposed to do about my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love Howard, but I can't get Matteo out of my mind!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have an idea that might help... Come on!
Linda hikes along a trail at the edge of the lake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about the cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Cupcakes can wait! Besides, you haven't gotten your answer yet!
$ZOE gets up and follows Linda up the trail...
Which leads them to a precipice overlooking the water! $ZOE hugs the cliff wall!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't like the looks of this!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, I know it's scary... We are `really` high up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know it's scary... We are [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] high up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not helping!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But True Heart's Bluff could be the answer to your problem!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How?! Is terror supposed to shock me into choosing a guy?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... The bluff is actually kind of a legend around here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: First, you're supposed to dive into the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No way! Never!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...And then, just before you splash in, you'll see a reflection of whoever you have true feelings for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Really?
$ZOE takes a few cautious steps toward the edge and peeks down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeep! It's even higher than I thought!
Linda puts a comforting hand on $ZOE's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When I dove last year, I didn't see anyone reflected. I didn't see Howard `or` Kenji.
nodes.text_bbcode: When I dove last year, I didn't see anyone reflected. I didn't see Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Linda, I don't mean to be rude, but `of course` you didn't see anyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, Linda, I don't mean to be rude, but [color=#3b78e2][i]of course[/i][/color] you didn't see anyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All you should see is your `own` reflection!
nodes.text_bbcode: All you should see is your [color=#3b78e2][i]own[/i][/color] reflection!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's what I'm saying, $ZOE... I didn't see anyone, `including` my own reflection!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I'm saying, $ZOE... I didn't see anyone, [color=#3b78e2][i]including[/i][/color] my own reflection!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: True Heart's Bluff showed me an image... It showed me who I had true feelings for at the time...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And what it showed me was `no one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And what it showed me was [color=#3b78e2][i]no one![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! That `really` happened?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! That [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] happened?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I swear...
$ZOE takes another peek over the edge...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait! There's something I have to tell you before you dive...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to the legend, you have to look at the water at exactly the right moment...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You can't look too early... The legend says you can't rush into love.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And you can't look too late... The legend says you have to also respect love.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is an incredibly demanding magic jumping spot!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not the one who made the rules.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess I can always jump again if I don't get it right the first time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh. I'm not going to like this, am I?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to the legend, those who look at the wrong time are punished.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Punished? Punished how?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know... Miguel wouldn't tell me. He just kept muttering something about `'el lobo'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... Miguel wouldn't tell me. He just kept muttering something about [color=#3b78e2][i]'el lobo'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All... All I know is that I'm confused about what I'm feeling.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I always thought if you loved a guy, it would be impossible to feel anything for another guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now that I think I feel something for Matteo, I can't tell if that means I'm wrong about my feelings for him or... Or that I don't really love Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's up to you... I chose to dive, but you don't have to...
$ZOE removes her sweater and plants herself just a few steps from the edge!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to jump right now, before I get even more scared! When am I supposed to look?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: After three seconds! You can do it!
Without hesitating, $ZOE runs to the edge and leaps off into a perfect dive!
One second passes!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That place is right next to this perfume store that I `love!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That place is right next to this perfume store that I [color=#3b78e2][i]love![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, just last week, I `made` perfume...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, just last week, I [color=#e23b3b][i]made[/i][/color] perfume...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Seriously? That's actually pretty cool...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Who was it for?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I gave it to...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Excuse me...
Ben gets up... He wanders through the party...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is she?
He turns a corner and finds Jessica and Tina glaring at each other, a crowd of people surrounding them!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It just seems like you spend an awful lot of time at parties `you're` not invited to!
nodes.text_bbcode: It just seems like you spend an awful lot of time at parties [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] not invited to!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev! People like when I come to their parties because I make them fun!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, `guys` think you're fun because all you do is flirt with them all night!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]guys[/i][/color] think you're fun because all you do is flirt with them all night!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not true... I'm not like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd really like to just go home now...
After Jessica drops Nicole and Amanda off, she drives to her house...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are we doing `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are we doing [color=#e23b3b][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I figured both of us could probably use some company...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You could come in and meet my family!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you `want` me to take you back to that mansion of yours so you can be alone again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] me to take you back to that mansion of yours so you can be alone again!

nodes.text: The doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Those must be the special guests!
Brendan opens the door to reveal $Scott and Angie!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look who it is, Taylor! It's $Scott and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm Amanda! Yay, cookies! Yay, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jeepers! $Scott's here! It's like the Star Tour came to us!
Dex nudges Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... Shoe sale! Totes hot! Way super!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Am I saying anything?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now that everyone's here, we can finally play the game all cool people play...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Truth or Dare!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? You guys play that?
The nerds huddle around the table...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dex... Er... $ZOE, you're first...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I choose... Truth!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did you know that the word 'modem' is a contraction of two words?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: '`Mo`dulate, `dem`odulate!'
nodes.text_bbcode: '[color=#e23b3b][i]Mo[/i][/color]dulate, [color=#e23b3b][i]dem[/i][/color]odulate!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good fact! 'Jessica', you're up?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Truth!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mom is an angel! I mean, `Erik's` mom is an angel!
nodes.text_bbcode: My mom is an angel! I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik's[/i][/color] mom is an angel!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is wrong with you guys? Do you not know how to play Truth or Dare?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How else are you supposed to play?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You guys are the worst! Make room!
Taylor squeezes in next to them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ashley starts... Not Hannah or Zach... `Ashley...` Truth or Dare?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ashley starts... Not Hannah or Zach... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ashley...[/i][/color] Truth or Dare?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Truth?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now I'm going to ask you a question, and you `have` to tell the truth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm going to ask you a question, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to tell the truth!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you and Angie were the last two people on earth, would you make out with her?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh...
Ashley looks around, blushing...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I guess I would. Otherwise, I'd never kiss anyone again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uhh...
The nerds' jaws all drop!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This game is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, Taylor, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I choose dare!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I dare you to...

options.label: Jump into the pool next door... In just your underwear!

nodes.text: Just then, a gothy-looking guy walks up to them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, you guys are Spartans, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Indeed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's it to you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm Nick. I'm a Spartan too.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Really? I've never seen you before.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We don't really run in the same circles. I'm not really into polo... The horse or the shirt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I like this guy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was just wondering if I could take a picture.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nothing creepy. It's for the yearbook... I'm sort of into photography.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. Go ahead.
Nick takes out a bulky, expensive camera and snaps a picture of Tom and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, guys! I really appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No problem... Hey, you're not like most Spartans. How come Chad and his goons don't pick on you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's kind of a funny thing, but when you're always behind a camera, no one seems to notice you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anyway, keep on... Doing whatever it is you were doing!
Nick leaves.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to hide behind a big camera... How would chicks see my face?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good. Tomorrow morning we continue your Spartan training.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh joy. What's next? Learning tax loopholes?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just meet me at the stables!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The stables?
Early the next morning, Colt meets Tom at the stables.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing wakes me up in the morning more than smelling a brewing hot pot of horse crap.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, you'll have to endure it. With your pathetic horsemanship, you'll never be a proper Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! I can ride! I just got stuck with a dumb horse last time!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Which brings me to the next lesson in your training... Choosing the right horse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds easy enough.
Colt walks along the horse stalls and stands in front of one of the horses.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This one looks good. I feel more Spartan-y already.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You just chose a horse named 'Grampy'!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? It could be an ironic name... Like a big guy named 'Tiny' or something.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Horses aren't named ironically, and their names are often a reliable indicator of personality...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You don't want a horse on its last legs... You want a horse that matches who you are...
Tom walks down the row of stalls...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's see... This one's called `Tweed Killer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's see... This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Tweed Killer.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This one's called `Captain Escape.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Captain Escape.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This one's called `High and Mighty.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]High and Mighty.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And this one's called `Autumn.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And this one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Autumn.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know which one I want. I'll take...
Later... After the horses have been returned to the stables...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think that use of colorful language is a fitting segue into the final and most challenging task of turning you into a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope you're talking about making me rich, 'cause if so, I'm there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Making you rich would be easy compared to this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It would? Then why are we doing `this?`
nodes.text_bbcode: It would? Then why are we doing [color=#e23b3b][i]this?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The final task is to get you to `speak` like a Spartan Man...
nodes.text_bbcode: The final task is to get you to [color=#e23b3b][i]speak[/i][/color] like a Spartan Man...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. I don't think so. All you guys talk like you've got sticks up your...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wordplay is a Spartan's greatest `asset.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wordplay is a Spartan's greatest [color=#e23b3b][i]asset.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After you've cleaned up, meet us in the commons area...
Tom heads off toward campus...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Us?` Who's us?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Us?[/i][/color] Who's us?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And why are you always telling me to clean up?!
After another long shower, Colt meets Tom in the commons area...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's up, Richie?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In order to properly educate you on manners of speech, I've enlisted the most silver-tongued man I know...
Suddenly Tom's butler, Jeeves, is standing next to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance yet again, sir.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where did you `come` from?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where did you [color=#e23b3b][i]come[/i][/color] from?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I am a master in many arts. Most notably service, eloquence, and military surveillance tactics.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Tom informs me of your intentions to speak like a gentleman, to master the field of verbal fencing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup! I want to stick it to those morons and their big dumb butts!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Oh dear.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Can you help him, Jeevesy?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My skeptical boy, I've transformed nose-pickers into heads of state! I can handle `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My skeptical boy, I've transformed nose-pickers into heads of state! I can handle [color=#e23b3b][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jeeves turns to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: The real issue is to get your mind out of the gutter and into the Gruyere, so to speak.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that like a fancy toilet?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Put another way... You must learn to choose the higher path.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I do that by...?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'll explain...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: If Tom were to tell me that I was nothing but a common servant...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I could respond obviously and call him a pompous ignoramus who wouldn't know a hard day's work if it bit him on the posterior!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Slam! That's gotta sting, Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, more good news, now I know what a posterior is!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm overjoyed.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Or I could respond the `Spartan` way and tell him that I'd rather be a common servant than a common man.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or I could respond the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan[/i][/color] way and tell him that I'd rather be a common servant than a common man.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: All I have to do to stop being common is quit being his servant. He, unfortunately, cannot quit being himself.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa... It's like you insulted him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except you didn't...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except you `did!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Except you [color=#e23b3b][i]did![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You'll notice I come across a great deal more dignified the Spartan way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I get it...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Very well, then let's put you to the test!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... The test?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `Me.` I'm going to insult you, and you have to respond the Spartan way.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Me.[/i][/color] I'm going to insult you, and you have to respond the Spartan way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... But I'm pretty sure you've got me beat.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My boy, if you manage to scrape together even the smallest assault against me, you'll do quite fine against those Spartan dullards.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Just make sure you don't let your emotions get to you.
Jeeves cricks his neck ever so slightly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: We begin.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You are a whiny, insignificant, waffling brat of a boy!
In an instant, Jeeves is gone.
Colt turns to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just want to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know that sucked, but I still want to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Tom... For trying to Spartan me up these last two days...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sounds awful.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you kidding? The world's preppiest guys making tepidly flirtatious small-talk with the world's snobbiest girls? It's `excruciating.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? The world's preppiest guys making tepidly flirtatious small-talk with the world's snobbiest girls? It's [color=#e23b3b][i]excruciating.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But everyone in the school goes?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're required to.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So if the Immortals wanted to do something shady...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It would be the perfect time! Everyone would be distracted!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're on to something, Nick, something big.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We need to go to this Cotillion and tail Chad and Percy... They'll lead us right to the truth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... About that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... It's a good plan... Except for the part where you said 'we'.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The Spartan Cotillion is a super-fancy exclusive event. They check ID. The only people getting in are Spartan students and their dates.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... I see...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, do you think I could get in if I was...

nodes.prompt: Do you think I could get in if I was...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you think I could get in if I was...

nodes.text: Tom hunkers down and peers into the safe.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, guys? I hate to be the bearer of bad news... But there aren't any fireworks in there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact... Those appear to be...
Percy reaches into the safe and pulls out a thick stack of paper booklets!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The entire school's SET tests!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh yes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, I don't get it. What's going on here? Are we `not` setting off fireworks?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold on, I don't get it. What's going on here? Are we [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] setting off fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hmph. Of course you wouldn't understand. Thomas, would you care to explain what you've deduced to your simpleton friend?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt, they were never after any fireworks. This whole thing has been a setup.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They just wanted the tests!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: So we can alter them, you idiot. With just a little creative doctoring, why, everyone in this school will pass their SETs with flying colors... And Spartan Academy will preserve its sterling academic reputation!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You do this every year?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course! How do you think Ares here got a perfect verbal score?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm basically illiterate!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This doesn't make sense. I mean, the school has to know something's up...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You still don't get it, do you? The administration is in on it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: This way, Spartan gets all the fancy endowments for top-performing schools!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Did you really think the administration would let an organization like The Immortals thrive without a price? We doctor the tests for them... And they give us all the luxuries we want!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course, this year, the Department of Education got suspicious and made the school store the tests in their personal safe...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which is precisely where Colt came into the picture.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...I see how it is. You saw the poor kid with the criminal background and figured, well, he's `gotta` know how to crack a safe!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I see how it is. You saw the poor kid with the criminal background and figured, well, he's [color=#e23b3b][i]gotta[/i][/color] know how to crack a safe!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Was I mistaken?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And yet, even in this one regard, you somehow managed to disappoint.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I appreciate helping the school, but I can't get behind this... It completely violates the spirit of free competition!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, spare me the pious act! Didn't you bribe your way out of the entirety of eighth grade?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was a different guy back then. I'm not that kind of person anymore...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And neither is Colt.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Why don't you let your blue-collar friend speak for himself.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: What do you say, Colt? Are you with Tom... Or with us?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously? You guys are doing this macho crap again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They were doing this before? Colt, what is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just... Give me a sec... To catch my breath...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's a lot more where that came from, punk. Now stay away from my girl!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, I...
But it's too late. Mark grabs Denni by the hand and drags her off.
Paige watches them go, and then turns to Colt angrily.

options.label: Episode Five: Clash of the Immortals
Episode Seven: A Spartan Love Story, Part 1
Episode Eight: A Spartan Love Story, Part 2

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni thinks we're still together!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Denni... I love you, too. I really do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do I feel like there's a 'but' coming here?
Ben's dad walks in with a bowl of instant oatmeal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Christmas is a time for comfort and joy. I don't remember any carols about frowns and mopeyness.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What's going on? Did you get your first B+?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ah... Then I will cheer up this awful 'nothing' with a gift!
He hands Ben a small Christmas present.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's kind of little, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Don't be fooled by its size...
Ben unwraps the gift.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a... A tiny microscope.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Now, I know you already have a dozen microscopes, but this one's special because it's a `pocket` microscope!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, I know you already have a dozen microscopes, but this one's special because it's a [color=#e23b3b][i]pocket[/i][/color] microscope!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: This lets you study the infinitesimal no matter where you are!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's been so distracted... With the divorce and with work... He doesn't know that I'm not the same nerdy kid anymore...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... A little, yeah. Thanks, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Sure. But make it quick, I have to get to the airport soon...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The airport?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: My lab is working with an East Coast pharmaceutical company on a line of palatable cold medicine for the new year.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm responsible for flavoring something called Auld Lang Sinus Relief...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're working? On Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm afraid flavors don't take holidays.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Unless you want to live in a world without Lemon Potato Clam Syrup...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who wouldn't?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What did you want to ask?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Um... I was wondering...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How did you get over...
$ZOE looks on, as Matteo attracts more girls.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I haven't seen you around before... Are you into motorcycles? Because you'd look really hot on one...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't own a motorcycle, but I do have a motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They both have motors... I don't judge. What are you doing on Friday night?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know a few places we could motor to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grrrr....

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Embarrassed `myself?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Embarrassed [color=#e23b3b][i]myself?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait wait `wait...` Does everyone but me think I `lost` just now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait wait [color=#e23b3b][i]wait...[/i][/color] Does everyone but me think I [color=#e23b3b][i]lost[/i][/color] just now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: By a landslide, you rube.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How? They're the ones wearing goofy outfits, galloping `away` from a fight...
nodes.text_bbcode: How? They're the ones wearing goofy outfits, galloping [color=#e23b3b][i]away[/i][/color] from a fight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not to mention that Chad guy didn't have `one` comeback from the crack I made about his mom.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention that Chad guy didn't have [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] comeback from the crack I made about his mom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe that's because Chad's mom is a `Senator.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe that's because Chad's mom is a [color=#e23b3b][i]Senator.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is she hot?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why would that be your first instinct?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who cares? If you continue this way, you're bound to get into another altercation!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Only I won't be around to save your hide.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'll be expelled before that low-brow brain of yours knows what hit it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And you'll have completely `wasted` my gift... All the money I've given you for your tuition!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you'll have completely [color=#e23b3b][i]wasted[/i][/color] my gift... All the money I've given you for your tuition!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tom, I'm grateful that you fronted all that dough, believe me. But that Chad guy is right about one thing...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't a place for someone like me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you're going to run from your problems yet again?! Did you learn nothing from our snowbound sortie?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I learned that you talk like a thesaurus.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I am talking about...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, I know. I'm just having fun with you, Silver Spoon.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... You're not running?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. I'm done with that. And that means all I can do is...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: In a first for The Immortals, we've got a tie!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two most qualified members for our society... Are Hades and Apollo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes! Team Hapollo does it again!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please don't call us that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, that was a horrible mistake, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Man, this sucks.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, forget this.
Mark and Lee walk out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... We're good? The two of us are in?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, no, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm afraid I do...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two of you must decide who joins The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: By fighting it out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! That's right! The two of you are gonna have to fight like dogs... And the last one standing wins!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is this the only option? We have to fight each other?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: 'Fraid so, boys. Get to it.
The other Immortals back away. Tom and Colt look at each other warily...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We really gonna do this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We've jumped through all their other hoops. Seems like a shame to back out now...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... Whoever wins... It's been an honor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Same here, man. Same here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Let's do this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, wait, I...
Tom lunges forward, throwing a hard right jab at Colt's head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt dodges to the side, neatly weaving away from the punch!
Tom stumbles for a moment... Leaving himself wide open!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Only one thing to do...
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. The wind rushes against her face!
Another second passes...
$ZOE keeps her eyes shut. She can hear the wind screaming against her face as she dives!
Another second passes...
A few moments later, Linda wraps a towel around $ZOE as she emerges shivering from the water.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: S-s-s-so cold!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Who did you see?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It d-d-d-didn't help! I saw b-b-b-both of them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Both?
$ZOE nods.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That means your feelings for both of them are true!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I don't think I'll be able to help you! This is beyond my expertise!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Th-th-th-that's okay, Linda! At least I looked at the r-r-r-right time!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... Let's get you warm back at the cabin. I think Miguel's going to want to hear about this!
After a long walk back to the cabin, $ZOE and Linda sit by a fire and tell Miguel the results of $ZOE's dive.

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing `two` reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot... I've never heard of a diver seeing [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] reflections. You're in one hairy pickle.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is there anything she can do?

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: Hmmm...
Miguel's eyes dart for an instant to a door in the corner of the room...

nodes.speaker: Miguel
nodes.text: I'm... I'm afraid not, girls.
Miguel starts to get up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mr. Alonzo, before you go... Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.prompt: Do you think you could tell us...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you think you could tell us...

nodes.text: A short while later, Colt emerges from a sewer hatch onto the grounds of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, gotta move fast... If that crazy Principal sees me, I'm done for.
Colt looks around. To the left, he sees Penelope resting under a tree, reading a book...
And to the right, he sees Paige texting on her cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, think fast... Which one should I go for?

nodes.prompt: Which one should I go for?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which one should I go for?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I appreciate helping the school, but I can't get behind this... It completely violates the spirit of free competition!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, spare me the pious act! Didn't you bribe your way out of the entirety of eighth grade?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was a different guy back then. I'm not that kind of person anymore...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And neither is Colt.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Why don't you let your blue-collar friend speak for himself.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: What do you say, Colt? Are you with Tom... Or with us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop it, Colt! You're not helping the situation!
Colt spins around.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you do `not` get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Excuse` me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Excuse[/i][/color] me?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you hadn't been making out with Mark Frikkin' Backbutter, I would've stuck by my pledge to be a better man and never cracked that stupid safe!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, first off, we were not making out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Semantic.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And second, how `dare` you try to blame me for your moral lapses?
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, how [color=#3b78e2][i]dare[/i][/color] you try to blame me for your moral lapses?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did I `make` you join the Immortals?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] you join the Immortals?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you did as a matter of fact, when you started dating Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I only started dating Ben because `you` ran off on your stupid spirit journey!
nodes.text_bbcode: I only started dating Ben because [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] ran off on your stupid spirit journey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which I only did because `you` kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which I only did because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I kissed `you?` No way, buddy, you kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color] No way, buddy, you kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, while I'm sure this version of the blame game could take us all the way back to the Big Bang, maybe we should try to focus on getting out of here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Plus, is anyone else impressed Colt knew the word 'semantic'? I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up, Fancypants! You're just as guilty as Denni is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never would've even wanted to join Percy's stupid society if it wasn't for you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I `should` have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! You should have! What good is that big, fancy brain of yours if it can't figure out an obvious trap?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, maybe I would've figured it out, if you'd given me a few minutes to think instead of lumbering towards that safe like some kind of gorilla!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, `please!` Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, [color=#e23b3b][i]please![/i][/color] Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you're one to talk, Nick! If you hadn't bumped into the door and given away our position, we would've gotten away with the whole thing on video!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Some journalist `you` turned out to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Some journalist [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] turned out to be!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, you did `not` just call out my journalistic cred!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] just call out my journalistic cred!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I did.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, if you're such a great journalist, why didn't you realize your secret crush or whatever was being played for an idiot by the Immortals?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugh!
Everyone stomps off to a different corner of the room, and they stand there, glaring at each other...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... This sucks.
We know Denni and Colt's relationship began with them trapped in a room... But who knew it would end the same way?
Try again, and see what you can do differently!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh really? And how exactly do you plan to...
Suddenly, Percy is cut off by a clattering sound from behind him!
Everyone spins around... To see Denni and Nick hidden behind the doorway! Nick is taping the whole affair through a fancy digital video camera!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Surprise office inspection?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Grab them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grab them![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick and Denni turn to run, but Carson and Chad are too fast! The two guys catch them and pull them into the room!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you touch her!
Colt lunges forward, but Percy elbows him in the gut!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oof!
Colt tumbles to the ground! Tom kneels to help him, and Percy kicks him in the shoulder, sending him sprawling as well!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aggh!
The other Immortals toss Nick and Denni forward! They spill onto the ground in front of Colt and Tom!
Colt kneels down, helping Denni up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! You okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Don't even think about fighting. You'd never take the five of us!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...He's right.
Percy kneels down and takes the video camera out of Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ah, Nicolas Brown. Our school's intrepid reporter. Tell me, did you get that whole thing on video?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just about.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then you came so, `so` close to finally cracking your case.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you came so, [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] close to finally cracking your case.

nodes.text: Percy grins, and then smashes the camera against the desk, shattering it into a dozen pieces!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And now... Your cell phones, please? And don't try resisting, because we `will` just take them with force.
nodes.text_bbcode: And now... Your cell phones, please? And don't try resisting, because we [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] just take them with force.

nodes.text: Chad walks forward and collects everyone's cell phones.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You won't get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course we will! You don't have any proof... And who would possibly take your word against ours?
Percy grabs the remaining tests from the safe.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then. We've got a long night of test-doctoring ahead of us. You four just stay here and take it easy, would you?
Percy and the other Immortals back away. As they step out the door, Percy turns to Chad...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Block the door with something heavy, would you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My pleasure.
The door slams shut. There is the sound of something heavy being pressed against it... And then the sound of laughter and footsteps departing.
Colt runs over and tries the door! It opens an inch, and then hits a bookshelf!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr! Come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr! Come [color=#e23b3b][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa!
Colt's bike blasts down a bumpy dirt path! Trees fly by at breakneck speed!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are... You... Sure... About... This?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure as I... Can be!
Colt glances over his shoulder to see Chad following right behind! His car scrapes against trees and rocks, but he doesn't slow down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's like a bug that just won't die!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Look out!
Colt looks up... To see a fallen log directly in his path!
Colt and Denni clear the tree line and come to a gentle stop alongside the shore of Lake Centerscore. A small, narrow path runs along the coast, leading up to downtown Centerscore beyond it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As for us... Not to jinx it... But I think we're home free!
Suddenly, a hot white light blasts them from above! Colt looks up and sees a helicopter in the night sky above them!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!
The helicopter descends, its whirling rotors blowing gusts of wind along the waterfront! It hovers directly over the path, ten feet above the ground, blocking their way. And behind the controls is...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Nice try, street rats, but your merry little chase ends here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course he has a helicopter! Why wouldn't he have a helicopter?!
Percy jerks the helicopter down, shooting a hard blast of air in their direction! The motorcycle wobbles but doesn't fall!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's crazy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... He's just a guy against the wall with everything to lose... And that makes him more dangerous than anything else!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough with the tomfoolery, Hades! Just toss the DigiVid card into the lake, and we can all be on our way!
The whole world seems to go still for one moment. Denni leans in close to Colt's ear and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?
Colt tightens his grip on the handlebars.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You trust me?
Denni clutches her arms around Colt's waist.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With my life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then let's roll!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
Colt and Denni slide under the helicopter at an almost horizontal angle, shooting up a fine mist of dirt...
And they pull themselves upright on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No!
Colt floors it, and the bike races off down the path!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Go, Colt, go!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NO!!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Percy jerks his helicopter around... But the rear rotors catch on a chunk of tree line!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Uh oh.
The helicopter spins wildly out of control, and then jerks down towards the ground!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Aiiiiie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aiiiiie![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Percy hurls himself out of the cockpit into the lake! The helicopter crashes nose-first into the path and goes up in a massive explosion!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We did it! We `did` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: We did it! We [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] it!

nodes.text: Colt looks back at her and grins...
And that's when a stray piece of debris hits the bike's rear tire.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh `crap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#e23b3b][i]crap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The bike jerks and spins out of control! Colt tries to stabilize it, but it skids out, sending him and Denni flying!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt's head hits the ground...
For a moment, everything goes dark and still...
Then he opens his eyes again. His bike is on its side, tires still spinning. Behind him, the ruin of the helicopter pops and crackles...
And a few feet away, Denni lies on the ground, her eyes shut, not moving.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no. No no `no!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no [color=#e23b3b][i]no![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Even though his whole body aches, Colt forces himself up. He crawls frantically towards Denni, grabs her, and turns her to face him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Please! Say something!
Very slowly, her eyes flutter open...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Are you hurt?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, Colt... I'm fine. I'm okay.
Colt looks down at Denni's face, illuminated by the bright dancing flames of the fire behind them...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. You're more than okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the most beautiful thing I've ever held in my arms.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
And then they kiss, passionately, deeply. Behind them, the helicopter goes up in one final, triumphant burst of light and heat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Wow.
Colt helps Denni up to her feet and gently holds her hand. Sirens wail in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, what do you think? This gonna make a good story for the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This is going to be the biggest story this town has ever...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `You!` You ruined everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color] You ruined everything!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni spin around to see Percy standing right behind them! He's soaking wet from head-to-toe and caked in mud!
He reaches out towards them with a trembling hand.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I will destroy you, Hades!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I think I'll pass on being alone.
Jessica takes a quick picture of him with her phone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew I'd get one of you smiling!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on! I'll introduce you to my family!
Inside, Jessica checks every room of the house...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Mom? Dad?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They're not here...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... I guess I can show you my room, at least...
They walk into Jessica's room...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like they left a note for me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's it say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It says they've gone to Napa for the weekend...
Jessica sits down on the bed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your room looks nice.
Ben hears the low sound of her crying softly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Sniffle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant, it looks... Ugly?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it has nothing to do with you... It's just my parents are never here...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's like... It's like they don't care...
Ben reaches out and wipes a tear from Jessica's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know what that's like.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know you do...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to see something cool?
He takes out his pocket microscope...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not going to play any nerd games if that's what you're asking.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. It's a microscope... Take a look.
Ben places the microscope over the tear on his finger. Jessica leans over and looks through.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's... It's... Beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Also, your finger is `really` ugly. I'd think about moisturizer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, your finger is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] ugly. I'd think about moisturizer.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh.
Their eyes meet for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know if I said it before, but I'm really proud of you, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You made some really good changes today.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't really know how to thank you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet. This is just the beginning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When I, um, kissed you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you... Kissed me back...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you, you know, like it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I did...
Ben steps closer to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you...?
He leans down and kisses Jessica, pulling her closer to him!
After a moment, Jessica kisses Ben back!
Whoa! Ben and Jessica?! It looks like Ben has gotten over Denni...
And even though he might be rushing into things with Jessica...
`You` played a great game! You helped him remove all traces of Denni from his life!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]You[/b] played a great game! You helped him remove all traces of Denni from his life!

nodes.text: And for now, that's for the best!
Don't forget to check out the store for our early release of the new On Demand episode `Christmas Exchange,` our special premium content `Holiday Short Stories,` and of course...
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't forget to check out the store for our early release of the new On Demand episode [b]Christmas Exchange,[/b] our special premium content [b]Holiday Short Stories,[/b] and of course...

nodes.text: `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: Thank you for playing! Stick around after your score for a sneak peek at `Holiday Short Stories!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you for playing! Stick around after your score for a sneak peek at [b]Holiday Short Stories![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Even though you've tried to help me get over Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just don't think it's working. I'm just as mopey as ever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. I'll take you home.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's all I can think about.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just shut up, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, could you drop me off at the mall? I can just walk home from there.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev.
Ben returns to `Jeaneology.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben returns to [b]Jeaneology.[/b]

nodes.text: He quickly scoops up the pictures Jessica threw in the trash-can and puts them back in his wallet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A little smelly, but that's okay...
Back at home, Ben sits in front of his computer and navigates to the Change Password screen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There! I changed my password back to `'I love Denni forever!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: There! I changed my password back to [color=#e23b3b][i]'I love Denni forever!'[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Ben rummages through the ashes of the trash-can bonfire!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is it? Where is it?
He pulls out the now deformed plastic pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Haha! Good as new! We're going to get back together!
In a cabin in the snow, Denni is watching television in her room...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Thanks for watching... Remember, Christmas is the time to forgive, to be with the ones you truly love...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben...
Denni looks longingly out the window of her room...
And sees a figure looming there, wearing tight jeans and cradling a deformed, burnt pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `YAAAH! Pumpkin killer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]YAAAH! Pumpkin killer![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni flees, screaming!
Ben stares at the deformed plastic pumpkin in his hand...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no... I turned into a creepy ex-boyfriend!
Ben? A creep? This isn't the Christmas Break he wanted!
Try again and see if you can help him get over his heartache for Denni!

And don't forget to check out the store `right now` for our early release of the new On Demand episode `Christmas Exchange` along with our special premium content `Holiday Short Stories` and `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to check out the store [b]right now[/b] for our early release of the new On Demand episode [b]Christmas Exchange[/b] along with our special premium content [b]Holiday Short Stories[/b] and [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: For a `sneak peek` at Holiday Short Stories and The Super New Girl, try again for the good ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: For a [b]sneak peek[/b] at Holiday Short Stories and The Super New Girl, try again for the good ending!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, it is good to see you! It has been a long time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'm glad to see you too, but... I didn't know you were in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you visiting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, it is more than just a visit. I'm the new exchange student at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I could say that I was here only to experience America, to live a different life, to learn to love your version of football...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But in truth, signorina, I came to be near you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... That's very sweet of you. And I'm flattered you'd transfer just for me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm with Howard now, and I don't think anything is going to change that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Perhaps not, but you should listen to what I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This wasn't how I thought it would go... I'm starting to think that coming here was all a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really should go. Howard's here right now, and if he sees you...
Just then, Matteo hears the sound of footsteps coming down the hall.
Matteo lands in the rose bushes just outside the house!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: `Aaaahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Matteo, don't move... I know CPR!
Matteo bursts out of the roses and fights his way past the thorny underbrush.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just so you know... I'm an expert on spleen injuries...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is all right, my friend. I will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know Captain Quarch used the balcony of General Kataya's bedroom to quickly warn her of the alien army invasion that was coming...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But maybe you should try the door this time.
From above them, a window opens... And $ZOE pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on out here?
$ZOE looks at Matteo, and her eyes widen. She shuts her window, and a minute later, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it's really you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Did you just fall into our rose bushes?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, yes, unfortunately. I did not mean for you to see me like this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why don't you just come in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Erik too.
$ZOE steps aside to let them both inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm with Howard now.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is not an answer to my question, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want me to tell you that I still have feelings for you after all this time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm telling you I can't have this conversation with you...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Because I can't...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Because I can't...[/i][/color]
