nodes.text: $ZOE turns and runs off.
He watches $ZOE go, holding a hand to his heart.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She could not say she loved me...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But she never said she `didn't!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But she never said she [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And that means... I'm staying here in Centerscore!
Looks like Matteo didn't quite get the answer he wanted...
But no answer is better than a definite 'no'! Thanks to you, Matteo has some hope he can rekindle love with $ZOE.
But will Matteo and $ZOE actually get together? Find out next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't feel the same way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What we had in Paris... It's behind me now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now that I'm back in Centerscore with Howard, I don't have any feelings for you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I thought that this afternoon meant something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please don't read too much into today. I know you traveled all the way here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I wanted to spend time with you because we're friends, Matteo. For old time's sake.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry I don't feel the same way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you promised you'd leave it alone if I told you my true feelings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You're right, and I'm a man of my word. I won't bother you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And don't worry about seeing me in school. I'm not attending Centerscore this spring.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm going home.
A couple months later...
Matteo is relaxing on a beach, surrounded by beach bunnies.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ladies... You are all very beautiful... But I am too heartbroken to enjoy my time with you...
Matteo takes a sip of punch when a shadow crosses his path.
He shields his eyes and looks up at the intruder.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoo hoo! Remember me?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Astrid, you look che bella.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: As do you, my slippery cannoli... Care to take a salivating walk around the beach?
Matteo and Astrid walk down the beach.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So what do you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I want to talk about us. Matteo, it seems that you and I have suffered blows like whales on tarpaulin.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't know what that means...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You and I have both been `spurned` by love, and the lovers who have spurned us have spurned with one another!
nodes.text_bbcode: You and I have both been [color=#3b78e2][i]spurned[/i][/color] by love, and the lovers who have spurned us have spurned with one another!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are talking about how Howard and $ZOE dumped both of us to date each other, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I made it clear, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So I am saying we could be as thick as a tangle of vines in a jungle...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What better way to complete this circle of shame, this crusty tango than to date one another?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, I've tried to make a relationship work out of companionship and love...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So why not try to make one based off rejection?
Matteo holds his arms out!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Come here, my Norwegian codfish!
Oh no! Matteo and Astrid got together just because they were both dumped by $ZOE and Howard?
That's... Mildly disturbing. No one should be `that` desperate!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... Mildly disturbing. No one should be [b]that[/b] desperate!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can't get a better ending for Matteo!
But that's not the only party going on in Centerscore! Let's check out Jessica's party!
Can you help $ZOE make it to the New Year?
`Happy New Year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Happy New Year![/b]

nodes.text: Everyone hugs in front of the T.V!
Brendan gives Taylor a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Thanks, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Could I talk to you outside?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure...
As the nerds celebrate, Taylor takes Brendan by the hand and leads him outside...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it?
When Taylor turns around, her eyes are filled with tears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong? Are you... Are you breaking up with me?
Taylor shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tonight...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was the best New Year's Party I've ever been to!
Taylor throws herself into Brendan's arms!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did all this for me, and... And...
Taylor wipes away her tears...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one's ever been this nice to me! It's a lot for a mean girl to handle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd better get used to it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I hate to break it to you... But you're not a mean girl anymore.
Brendan pulls Taylor close and kisses her!
After a long while, Taylor pulls away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What am I then? If I'm not a mean girl?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One of us... Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there an initiation ceremony or something?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure there is. We could get Erik to yell at you as Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pass. I think that might be too traumatic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you just went through all that drama with her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for `Erik.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Poor guy. I think acting as Jessica any longer would put him into a pimple coma...
A firework goes off in the distance...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I love you, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I love you too...
They stay there in each other's arms as the first minutes of the New Year pass...
Looks like it's a good start to the year for Brendan and Taylor!
You helped Brendan give Taylor exactly what she wanted... A party to remember!
$ZOE slips away, to a wooden area by some picnic tables...
Where she finds Ryan, sitting on a rock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... Ryan. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why does everyone ask me that?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Jessica `invited` me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica [color=#e23b3b][i]invited[/i][/color] me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I kind of meant... Why are you all the way out here and not over at the party with everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's kind of crowded back there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like something else is bothering you. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I can't tell you. Not after what you did to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hear you don't keep secrets very well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I keep secrets just fine!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to see if you're okay.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey... Is that an invitation to make out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, it's been a long time since a girl has checked up on me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like you need someone to talk to, and I hate to see anyone this miserable.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay... You know what happens at midnight, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It turns into the New Year, full of the hope and promise of the future?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, it turns into the hour you get to make out with whoever you want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not... Technically accurate...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I've been having a hard time, $ZOE. You know I broke up with Robot Girlfriend again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You broke up twice?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Megan tried to revive her, but she shorted out after two dates!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever since then, I've had some problems scoring girls.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No matter how many gifts or compliments I try to give, none of them fall for it! I'm cursed!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If I don't kiss a girl at midnight, I won't get to kiss anyone all year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ryan, that's ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is it? Last New Year's, I didn't kiss anyone, and the entire school year, I haven't had any action at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about your Robot Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever tried making out with a robot?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Unless you count this one weird dream I had...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's impossible without getting your tongue fried a few times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ewww...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I can help.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `You're` going to make out with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to make out with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! We're just going to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! We're just going to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awwww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, when you talk to girls, what do you say exactly?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I say, 'Hey, want to make out?'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...That's pretty much it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sometimes I say 'tongue wrestle', sometimes I say 'swap spit'. Once I offered to give a girl a tonsillectomy, that didn't go well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I see the problem. Maybe you should try something new like...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you excuse me, Sam... I just need some air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But we're outside...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to be away from people right now.
$ZOE is about to rush away when Jessica strides angrily up to them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On a break.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about the food? And the Elvish?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, Jessica. She'll be back in a minute... Your party will live.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing `here`, Sam?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color], Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talking to the people I love, which you probably have no concept of.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev. Don't you have a pool to jump in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot tub, actually. At my own swim team party. I was just dropping by.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Then get out! In fact, I'll take you out myself...
While Sam distracts Jessica, $ZOE slips away from the party to a more quiet space.
$ZOE crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, if one of my exes had a bunch of girls flirting with him, I'd be pretty bothered.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not really my ex, and... Besides, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you won't get upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm `fine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Matteo `does` look awfully cozy... Maybe I `should` go over there...
nodes.text_bbcode: But Matteo [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] look awfully cozy... Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] go over there...

nodes.text: Colt notices the headmaster scowling at him from the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You're lucky Tom was here to prevent you from entering into fisticuffs with me.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It would have been fun knocking your teeth out right before you got expelled!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're rather welcome!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But there isn't any more time for pleasantries! The polo match starts soon!
A few minutes later, Colt and Tom are sitting atop their horses on the polo field.
Chad rides by...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm concerned for your prospects.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I haven't seen very much evidence that you've made `any` progress, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't seen very much evidence that you've made [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] progress, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, that's great! Real supportive, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm just calling them like I see them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give me a chance, man! Have faith!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The polo match is in a few hours! Are you suddenly going to transform into a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The library! If you won't teach me how to be a gentleman, I'll figure it out on my own!
Colt marches off in the direction of the library...
A few hours later...
Colt trots his horse out onto the field...
Holding a long jousting lance!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you out of your mind?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I did a lot of reading, Tom! This is how gentlemen get even!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, $Horse! Hyah!
Colt gallops toward Chad, aiming his lance for Chad's chest!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What the...?
Colt knocks him off his horse! The crowd gasps!
As Chad struggles to his feet, Colt dismounts, sprints over, and punches him back down into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That felt `so` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: That felt [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `For Spartan! Ahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]For Spartan! Ahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A mob of angry Spartans charges at Colt, tackling him into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Soon, Colt is trying to fight off Carson, Percy, `and` Preston at the same time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon, Colt is trying to fight off Carson, Percy, [b]and[/b] Preston at the same time...

nodes.text: Chad rises to his feet and cracks his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... I can handle three of you! But not a fourth!
Tom comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, you got my back?
Tom rolls up his sleeves...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Atta boy, Tom! It'll be just like when we took down Hawk and his bros!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm afraid not, Colt. I'm a Spartan. And it looks like you `aren't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm afraid not, Colt. I'm a Spartan. And it looks like you [color=#e23b3b][i]aren't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean... You're with them?
Tom nods...
The Spartans close in around Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp!
Looks like Colt's outnumbered!
Play again and see if you can keep him from punching his way out of school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to jump right now, before I get even more scared! When am I supposed to look?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: After three seconds! You can do it!
Without hesitating, $ZOE runs to the edge and leaps off into a perfect dive!
One second passes!
The following week at lunch, Matteo is once again being hounded by girls, when $ZOE approaches... The girls fall silent.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno, signorina!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can totally tell. This is going to be, like, the best! Let me get my phone so I can take a pic!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha! Here comes the drool!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... Can I talk to you alone for a second?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, they ruined my fun!
$ZOE leads Matteo out into the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been thinking almost non-stop these last few days about how I feel about you, Matteo, and it's really put me through a lot...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am so sorry for you to feel this way...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I couldn't tell you before that I didn't have feelings for you, Matteo, because... Because I `did` have feelings for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I couldn't tell you before that I didn't have feelings for you, Matteo, because... Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] have feelings for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` have feelings for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] have feelings for you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me finish...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What more is there to say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have feelings for you, Matteo, but... I `love` Howard! He's the guy I want to be with!
nodes.text_bbcode: I have feelings for you, Matteo, but... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] Howard! He's the guy I want to be with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And even though I know going out with you would be fun and adventurous, the truth is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to give up on something that is so certainly amazing, not even for the thrill of something completely new...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, I've already had so much fun and so many adventures with Howard already...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yeah, we have our boring moments, our off nights, but what established couple doesn't?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you've had your heart set on me, but I'm telling you now... I'm certain... Howard is everything I want!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now I `really` see...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] see...

nodes.text: Matteo turns away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, wait!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You have changed your mind?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! But I have an idea!
After class...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You remember Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Buongiorno!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Matteo, I'm sure you remember my cousin, Sam! She's single!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is by far the most embarrassing thing you've ever done to me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You have the most beautiful, radiant skin of any girl I've ever gazed upon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh hey, have either of you guys seen Howard? I've been looking for him everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, he went home early for something... He wouldn't say what...
A half hour later, $ZOE knocks on Howard's front door... He opens it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! Why is your face covered in frosting?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
The twins scamper out from behind Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're making you cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard Cupcakes are the most fun because they explode when you cook them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess the surprise is out! We know how much you like cupcakes... And you're always baking them for everyone else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I figured I'd try to bake some for you...
Howard holds up a lopsided piece of ill-defined pastry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd give this to you, but I think it now qualifies as a hazardous material.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard!
$ZOE wraps her arms around Howard in a big frosting-covered hug!
When they part, $ZOE gives Howard the heart pendant from the retreat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's mine to give to the person I love. That's you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I love you! I can't wait for the Valentine's Dance!
They kiss!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ew, gross!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come on, you guys! We wanna make more cupcake explosions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Looks like $ZOE's made her choice, and it certainly feels like the right one!
You played a great game! You helped $ZOE discover her true feelings out in the great outdoors, and through her dilemma, she learned the final lesson...
Sometimes you have to make sacrifices for the ones you love...
On Monday morning, $ZOE steps into the Auto Shop.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What's up, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you have anything that can smash this heart pendant?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Did someone say smash?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty much everything in here can accomplish the job...
Kenji takes the heart pendant and tosses it into a machine. He turns it on. A few seconds later...
`Crrrrrrruncch!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Crrrrrrruncch![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's my favorite sound!
Kenji takes out a small metal container underneath the machine and pours out $ZOE's heart pendant. It's now broken into a thousand pieces!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Kenji! Here's one for you!
$ZOE hands Kenji one of the pieces...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why are you giving me this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I learned a valuable lesson... I have an unknown future with everyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Was that it? I can't quite remember...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't forget you either, Ryan! Here you go!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What does this get me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't `get` you anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]get[/i][/color] you anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just means that from now on, a part of my heart belongs to you.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Barf.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So, then... I could ask `part` of you to go to the dance with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, then... I could ask [color=#e23b3b][i]part[/i][/color] of you to go to the dance with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Absolutely! That part of me accepts!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And, uh... I could, too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! I accept!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This is gross...
Later that day, $ZOE hands some of her heart pieces out to the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You realize this has no value, right? It's just a chunk of worthless metal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It gets you a date with me to the dance! I could take it back if you want!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Stay away from my worthless metal!
$ZOE hands one to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's okay, $ZOE, I don't want to be an enabler.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't take this. It just encourages you to divide your love up so much that eventually...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It doesn't mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's why I love big!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When you promise to love everyone, eventually, well... Someone gets their feelings hurt real bad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Howard comes marching down the hall!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could you, $ZOE?! I hear you have over `two hundred` dates to the Valentine's Dance?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How could you, $ZOE?! I hear you have over [color=#e23b3b][i]two hundred[/i][/color] dates to the Valentine's Dance?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There aren't even two hundred guys at this school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those guys at the gas station were really nice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Good. Bye. $ZOE.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Good. Bye. $ZOE.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard turns and storms off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? Howard?!
Uh oh! Looks like $ZOE didn't quite learn the right lesson! Play again and see if you can sort out her dilemma!
Just then, Nick is cut off by the sound of the door downstairs swinging open!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no!
The sound of lumbering footsteps approaches them, thundering up the stairs!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Hide!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hide![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick and Denni scramble frantically for cover, before ducking into a closet! They slam the door shut, just as Percy steps in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hfff... Hfff...
Pressed up right against Denni, Nick speaks in an urgent whisper...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whatever you do... Don't make any noise...
Denni leans forward and peaks through the crack in the door. Percy steps into his room and yawns...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ugh. It `is` amazing how much of my day I have to spend dealing with imbeciles...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] amazing how much of my day I have to spend dealing with imbeciles...

nodes.text: Denni tries as hard as she can to stay quiet... But the thick smell of Percy's cologne sets her nose twitching!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no... Not now... Please not now... Please don't sneeze!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on tight, Princess... Town Hall is about ten minutes away, and I'm gonna make it in seven...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, Colt... You might want to make it five!
Colt glances over his shoulder... And sees a bright red convertible gaining on them! Chad sits behind the wheel, a furious look on his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This night just keeps getting better and better...
Chad floors it! His car races towards the bike!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We need to lose him!
Colt swerves his bike off the road and...
Three important messages for Surviving High School fans...
You can buy the On Demand episode `Christmas Exchange` early!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can buy the On Demand episode [b]Christmas Exchange[/b] early!

nodes.text: Follow $ZOE and Howard, Paige, and Amanda in our premium holiday content, `Holiday Short Stories!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Follow $ZOE and Howard, Paige, and Amanda in our premium holiday content, [b]Holiday Short Stories![/b]

nodes.text: And `three...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [b]three...[/b]

nodes.text: It's the biggest Surviving High School event... `Ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the biggest Surviving High School event... [b]Ever![/b]

nodes.text: Surviving High School has gone `SUPER!` Check out `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surviving High School has gone [b]SUPER![/b] Check out [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: All of it's available in our store `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All of it's available in our store [b]right now![/b]

nodes.text: Also, stick around at the end of the episode for an exclusive sneak peek at both `Holiday Short Stories` and `The Super New Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, stick around at the end of the episode for an exclusive sneak peek at both [b]Holiday Short Stories[/b] and [b]The Super New Girl![/b]

nodes.text: And now...
On Christmas morning, Ben sits in his house at a long dining table, his head buried in his arms...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe Denni and I broke up... And that Jessica and I kissed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did I kiss her?! I don't feel for her the way I do for Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I should be locked up for being such a horrible person...
Ben's phone buzzes. He checks the caller ID.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is she calling?!
Ben takes a deep breath and answers the call.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Ben, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. Um...
This New Year's, there are two big parties going on in Centerscore: Brendan's nerd party and Jessica's cool party!
Let's kick things off by following Brendan at the nerd party...
We hope you had fun at both parties!
Here's hoping your New Year's Eve is every bit as fun as ours were!
Happy New Year!

nodes.title: This is Spartan!
nodes.subtitle: Can Colt become a true Spartan?

nodes.text: As morning shines on the extravagant campus of Spartan Academy, Colt and Tom approach the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of `gold.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of [color=#3b78e2][i]gold.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: These days, that's only partially true, but, you know... The economy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And yes, I'm sure. After we battled together against Hawk Gunner, it's the least I could do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If `the least` you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#e23b3b][i]the least[/i][/color] you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.

nodes.text: Tom groans...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd forgotten that we're going to be roommates together... Please tell me that you know how to keep things clean.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. When the dishes get moldy, you just eat your food right out of the plastic container.
Tom groans again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look... This gift of yours means a lot to me. Not only are you paying through the nose, but you're also giving me a chance to start fresh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway, uh, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... Are you being modest?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, seriously, `don't` mention it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, seriously, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] mention it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not exactly top dog around here anymore. If word got out that I'd used my money for... Charity... Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even Chad, my confidant, my right-hand man, my espresso fetcher, has forsaken me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tough life...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That reminds me... What `do` you guys do for kicks around here?
nodes.text_bbcode: That reminds me... What [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] you guys do for kicks around here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come with me.
Twenty minutes later...
On the polo grounds, several horse-mounted Spartans vie for control of a wooden ball...
Meanwhile, at the opposite end of the grounds...
Colt is sitting atop a horse that isn't moving at all!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Lazy! The ball's way over there! Mush!
The horse snorts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't give me attitude!
Tom rides up on his own horse.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not sure if someone with your upbringing is aware of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But riding a horse should be a `faster` mode of transport than walking.
nodes.text_bbcode: But riding a horse should be a [color=#e23b3b][i]faster[/i][/color] mode of transport than walking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Professor Obvious, good tip!
Colt grabs his horse's ear and twists it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on you stupid thing! `Rev!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on you stupid thing! [color=#e23b3b][i]Rev![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The horse shakes off Colt's grip, annoyed.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It isn't a motorcycle, you imbecile!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it didn't come with a manual!
Suddenly the ball comes their way. Colt's horse stirs...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right! Finally! Lazy's got some life in him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now if I could just get close enough to knock out one of the other riders with this mallet thing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... That's not supposed to be used as a weapon!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm kidding, Richie! Relax!
Nearby, Chad hits the ball with his mallet...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...Knocking it right to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got this!
Colt pulls his mallet back, poised for a mighty swing...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Tom. He's my friend, and this doesn't feel right.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Either you take both of us... Or neither. Isn't that right, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Fine! They're both out, then! Let's go get Lee and Mark!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No. We already told them they were out. There's no going back on that...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Plus, you know, they're already probably back in their dorms, and I really don't feel like going to get them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You can't be serious, guys! We're not letting them both in!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, that's `exactly` what we're doing.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: We opened up this possibility when we let them both compete... And according to the bylaws of our society, they've both won the Trials.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: If they refuse to compete... We have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades... Apollo... Welcome to The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well then! Let's just get settled and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold your horses, Shagri La, because I'm not done talking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm starting to accept that this secret society might just be the right thing for me to get my life in order...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I am `not` happy with the way you do things here.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happy with the way you do things here.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For starters, Centerscore might be our biggest rival, but we're done with dumb pranks like ruining their football field. We've done enough damage.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we're so worried about beating them, let's do it in a fair and honest competition.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the way it is, Meathead. Either the feud between Spartan and Centerscore ends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or Tom and I are out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is totally out of line! `Totally!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is totally out of line! [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: He can't just come in here and change how we do things!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, this doesn't seem okay...
Percy stares at Colt thoughtfully... Then smiles a wry, tricky grin.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Offer accepted.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?! You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades here has an excellent point. We've wasted too much effort on those losers at Centerscore already. If leaving them alone is his price... We'll pay it.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! This is seriously not okay! I... I formally protest!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And I will formally tell you to shut your cartoonishly loud mouth, Ares, or I swear by the Gods above and below, I will kick you out of this society.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Need I remind you... This is `not` a democracy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Need I remind you... This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's in the bylaws. Volume 15, Article 9. 'This is not a democracy.'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hmph!
Chad storms furiously out. Colt watches him go, then walks over and sits on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... What's the first thing on our agenda? Are there any international markets to manipulate? Political lobbies to infiltrate?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me you have insider stock tips! Because let me tell you, I have a feeling about these Swiss pork bellies...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Slow your roll, good Apollo! All that comes later! First, enjoy some of our society's special amenities!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amenities?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What exactly are we talking about here?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, beyond the use of this excellent lounge...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You get to enjoy priority registration in classes at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, I can take all afternoon classes and sleep in every morning?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly! Not only that, but we receive custom-catered lunches... VIP treatment at all the clubs and restaurants in town... Regular consultations from a personal stylist...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And if you feel like visiting a special ladyfriend, there's a hidden tunnel that runs from this den across the river to Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My special ladyfriend actually goes to Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmm. We'll deal with that later.
Percy walks off. Tom walks over and sits down on the couch next to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey. What you did back there? That was... Very gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't sweat it, man. It was the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: After everything we've been through together... It would've felt wrong to end on those terms.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You know, Colt, you told me that you wanted to come to Spartan to be a better man...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But sometimes, I think you might already be the best man here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, man, but don't get all sappy on me. Mostly I just didn't feel like bruising you up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha, well, it's funny that you say that because... You do know I'd win, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think you'd win in a fight against me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, as a matter of fact I do. And just so it's clear, I'm talking about a fair fight, not you sneaking up on me in an alley with a crowbar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Richie, I could take you in a fair fight with a blindfold on and one hand tied behind my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! Well, I could take `you` with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, `and` a rabid chimp on my shoulders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, I could take [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a rabid chimp on my shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, I could...
Looks like Tom and Colt made it into The Immortals... And preserved their friendship! Their... Very odd... Friendship!
Congratulations on playing a great game!
After school one day, $ZOE and Howard are eating together in $ZOE's house.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think of the cupcakes I baked, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Delicious as always, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Baking always makes the house so warm!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to `The Heaaaaart of the Sea...`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I was thinking before the Valentine's Dance this year, that we'd go back to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Heaaaaart of the Sea...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember how much fun we had acting like pirates and eating Plank Steak?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Um... Yeah, that was fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool, then... So... What do you want to do tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... I can't really think of anything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Want to watch another movie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE and Howard sit on the couch together, a bowl of popcorn between them...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch `More Amore!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you like romantic movies, $ZOE, so I was thinking we could watch [color=#e23b3b][i]More Amore![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's about this couple who hates each other but finds love in Italy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo's from Italy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I need more...
Previously, on SHS...
To gain acceptance into Spartan's elite secret society, The Immortals, Colt vandalized the Centerscore High football field...
And when Denni saw him there, he brushed her off!
Determined not to give up, Denni began investigating Spartan... But what will she discover? You're about to find out!
After school one day, Denni sits alone in the office of the Centerscore High newspaper club.
The table in front of her is covered in printouts... Everything Denni could find online about Spartan Academy and The Immortals.
She rifles through them for a few minutes... Then tosses them aside!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Urgh! Useless!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoever these 'Immortals' are, they've covered their tracks well... I can't find anything useful, just rumors and gossip!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hate to admit it... But I don't think I have a choice. I have to go right to the source...
With a sigh, Denni boots up a computer and goes to her email. She starts to type...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Dear Colt...'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'To be honest, the way our last conversation ended, I'm not sure if you even want me to be writing to you... But I don't really feel like I have a choice.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'The truth is...'

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: ...No, I don't.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Touchy subject?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I thought I had one but... Well, she turned out to be really crappy.
Denni slides closer to Mark, so they're almost touching...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Why dwell in the past...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: When we can live in the present?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Exactly.
Mark leans over and wraps his hand around Denni's waist.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: So then... If you don't mind me asking...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Would you be my date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes, Mark. Yes I would.
Mark grins and reaches up, gently stroking Denni's face. He leans in for a kiss...
When suddenly, there's the heavy thud of a weight crashing to the ground behind them!
Denni spins around... And finds herself face-to-face with...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me!

nodes.text: This certainly isn't the reunion Denni was hoping for... And Colt does not look pleased! What's going to happen?
Find out next week, in `A Spartan Love Story, Part 2!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Find out next week, in [b]A Spartan Love Story, Part 2![/b]

nodes.text: Previously on SHS, Denni infiltrated Spartan Academy to find the truth about its secret society, The Immortals.
When she learned that they were planning something big during The Cotillion, she pretended to be a Monarch Prep girl to get a date...
And that's when Colt discovered her!
And now...

nodes.title: A Spartan Love Story, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: The secret of The Immortals... Revealed!

nodes.text: Colt stands in the weight room of Spartan Academy, his mouth open in disbelief at the sight in front of him...
Denni, sitting on a bench, with Spartan jock Mark Backbutter's arm around her waist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Colt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? You can explain what you're doing at my school with that guy's arm around your waist?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, seriously, `that` guy? He sucks!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, seriously, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] guy? He sucks!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No, you suck, `Hades!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you suck, [color=#e23b3b][i]Hades![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, please, this is a misunderstanding...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, I think I understand just fine. This piece of trash here is some no-good ex of yours, and it just eats him up to see you flirting with a `real` man.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I think I understand just fine. This piece of trash here is some no-good ex of yours, and it just eats him up to see you flirting with a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] man.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No-good ex? Is that what you told him?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! I didn't tell him anything!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, so I don't even warrant a mention, is that how it is?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I accepted that you wanted to date Tweed. I didn't get it, because who wants to date Tweed, but I accepted it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now I don't know if you're cheating on him or you two broke up or whatever, but for you to come to my new school, just to hook up with some toolbag...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's `not` what happened! Please, you've got to let me explain, I...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] what happened! Please, you've got to let me explain, I...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Relax, girl. I got this.
Mark stands up, getting right in Colt's face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Shortpants, you do `not` want to go there with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen here, Shortpants, you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] want to go there with me...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, I know exactly where I wanna go with you. So now how about you do us all a favor and stop bothering my date to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or things might get real ugly up in here. You follow? `Punk?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or things might get real ugly up in here. You follow? [color=#e23b3b][i]Punk?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mark shoves Colt, sending him staggering backwards!
Colt swings back around...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, that `friggin'` does it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, that [color=#e23b3b][i]friggin'[/i][/color] does it...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What are you gonna do, huh? What are you gonna do?!
He slams it a few more times, but it doesn't budge! He's about to slam his whole body into it when a soft hand touches his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't bother, Colt. They've got us trapped.
Colt turns around and looks at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I... I don't understand. What's going on? Why were you and Captain Emo taping us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We knew The Immortals were up to something... And when we realized what, we knew we had to get proof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I get that, but... Why were you at Spartan in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because I was worried about you, Colt! I knew you'd gotten mixed up in something bad at Spartan, and I needed to make sure you were okay!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know you told me you didn't want to see me again in that email, but I just had to ignore it and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, slow down, Princess. `What` email?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, slow down, Princess. [color=#e23b3b][i]What[/i][/color] email?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The... The one you sent yesterday... The one where you said you wanted me to stay out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I never sent you an email. I haven't even checked my email in, like, a month and a half.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then... How...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Someone must have hacked your account!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Percy. It had to be. Just another reason to pound his stupid face in...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...So you never told me off? You `don't` want me out of your life?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So you never told me off? You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want me out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And wait... If you were only here to check up on me... Does that mean you're not really dating Mark?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course not! That guy sucks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We are `so` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni step forward and hug!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I missed you too, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we `still` don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!
nodes.text_bbcode: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... `Half` of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... [color=#e23b3b][i]Half[/i][/color] of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Percy smashed your camera!
Nick grins and holds up his hand. Cradled in his palm is a little electronic card.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... But he didn't smash the DigiVid card with the video on it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You palmed it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude! Props!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, that `is` a great turn of events...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a great turn of events...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I still don't know how we're going to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually... I have an idea.
Denni glances at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you remember? Last time...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh! I get it! We should go out through the...

nodes.prompt: We should go out through the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We should go out through the...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great. According to my dad, all I have to do to get over Denni is stop talking to her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: While I'm all alone, thinking only about how badly I want to talk to her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... Maybe for now I can distract myself from thinking about her!
Monday, December 26th...
Ben sits on a couch, watching movies, a stack of DVDs on the table in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is easy. I'm not even thinking about Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Except for that thought...
Tuesday, December 27th...
Ben leaps onto the banister and slides down it onto a mountain of pillows!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hahahaha! This is so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni would love this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean... `If` someone named Denni existed!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... [color=#e23b3b][i]If[/i][/color] someone named Denni existed!

nodes.text: Wednesday, December 28th...
Ben's phone rests on the table. He paces back and forth in front of it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't do it... Don't do it...
He stops, glancing at it out of the corner of his eye.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a phone call.
He takes a step toward it but stops himself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I won't do it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I won't.
Thursday, December 29th...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aggggggh! I can't take it anymore!
Ben snatches up his phone and calls Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just going to say 'hi'. That's all.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hi. This is Denni's voicemail. You know what to do. *beep*

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. Just calling to say 'hi'. That's all...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that I love you with all my heart! I'm crazy without you! It was a mistake! I'm sorry!
Ben hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That wasn't ideal...
Friday, December 30th...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm only going to tell her that the message I `just` left was a joke.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm only going to tell her that the message I [color=#e23b3b][i]just[/i][/color] left was a joke.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As were the other twenty...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure she knows I'm kidding when I say I want to get married tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: The voicemail of... Denni Fallon... Is full. Please try again later.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I filled her voicemail!
Ben puts his phone down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to get over Denni, but this isn't working. I need a friend... Someone who knows about relationships...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need...
Ben picks his phone back up and finds a number in his Contacts list.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can call Jessica without her reading too much into it, right? I mean... We're just friends...
Ben hesitates a moment and then presses the send key. Jessica picks up.

nodes.text: The only way you're going to get over Denni is if you see your life without her in a positive light.

Jessica hangs up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Who's us?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great. According to my dad, all I have to do to get over Denni is work all day, every day, sacrificing everything and everyone that matters to me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not doing `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not doing [color=#e23b3b][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... Maybe for now I can distract myself from thinking about her!
Monday, December 26th...
Ben sits on a couch, watching movies, a stack of DVDs on the table in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is easy. I'm not even thinking about Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Except for that thought...
Tuesday, December 27th...
Ben leaps onto the banister and slides down it onto a mountain of pillows!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hahahaha! This is so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni would love this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean... `If` someone named Denni existed!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... [color=#e23b3b][i]If[/i][/color] someone named Denni existed!

nodes.text: Wednesday, December 28th...
Ben's phone rests on the table. He paces back and forth in front of it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't do it... Don't do it...
He stops, glancing at it out of the corner of his eye.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a phone call.
He takes a step toward it but stops himself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I won't do it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I won't.
Thursday, December 29th...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aggggggh! I can't take it anymore!
Ben snatches up his phone and calls Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just going to say 'hi'. That's all.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hi. This is Denni's voicemail. You know what to do. *beep*

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni. Just calling to say 'hi'. That's all...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that I love you with all my heart! I'm crazy without you! It was a mistake! I'm sorry!
Ben hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That wasn't ideal...
Friday, December 30th...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm only going to tell her that the message I `just` left was a joke.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm only going to tell her that the message I [color=#e23b3b][i]just[/i][/color] left was a joke.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As were the other twenty...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure she knows I'm kidding when I say I want to get married tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I filled her voicemail!
Ben puts his phone down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to get over Denni, but this isn't working. I need a friend... Someone who knows about relationships...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need...

nodes.text: As the groundskeepers try to round up Colt's horse, Chad and several Spartans trot up to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Enjoying the mud? Seems like you're right at home!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't know if you should wash those clothes or simply burn them.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Seriously, man, `where` did you get those?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Seriously, man, [color=#e23b3b][i]where[/i][/color] did you get those?

nodes.text: Ha ha! Stop it, guys! I'm going to fall off my horse from laughing so hard!

nodes.speaker: Chad

nodes.text: Yeah, it reminded me of your mom!

nodes.text: What? How does that make sense?

nodes.text: A horse and a human are entirely different species...

nodes.text: Do me a favor and stay out of my sight.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: In case you haven't noticed, you don't really belong at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So why don't you run back home to whatever shack you crawled out of and have a nice can of cold beans with your worthless family?
Colt lunges at Chad, yanking him down from his horse!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Aaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He cocks his fist back for a punch...
But Tom pulls him off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let go of me, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This isn't the place for a fight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah, well, where is?! You tell me, because this guy's got a date with my fists!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I recommend canceling the date, because right now, you're in the middle of the polo field with the headmaster watching!
Colt notices the headmaster scowling at him from the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You're lucky Tom was here to prevent you from entering into fisticuffs with me.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It would have been fun knocking your teeth out right before you got expelled!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: At least I hit the stupid ball...
Colt mounts his horse, settling into the saddle and...
The horse doesn't seem to mind!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you thought I was going to get bucked off, didn't you, Silver Spoon?
Colt's horse neighs playfully!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Very good, Colt. We might make a rider out of you yet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, what's next?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there is the matter of actually getting the horse to move.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh. Yeah. How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're running out of time, so I'm going to have to give you the quick and dirty version...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the version I like best...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just pay attention...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Go forward by squeezing the horse with `your calves...`

nodes.text: I've moved on, okay? I have a new life and new friends. And I don't need some stupid know-it-all from Centerscore irritating me all the time. It's infuriating!

nodes.text: When Dinah and I started falling apart, I thought she was brainwashed at first. Turns out it was just college.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just wish I had some way of knowing what was really going on over there...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, if you really want to know... Why don't you investigate? If you find anything juicy, you can write an article about it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's a good thought, Brendan, but how am I supposed to even get access to Spartan? It `is` an all boy's school...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a good thought, Brendan, but how am I supposed to even get access to Spartan? It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] an all boy's school...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's your lucky day, Denni, because I happen to know a guy there! I'm sure he'd be happy to show you around!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! He's the head of their newspaper club. We chat online sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I have a feeling you two will get along...
The next day, at Spartan Academy...
Following Brendan's instructions, Denni makes her way to the office of the Spartan newspaper club.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Everyone's staring at me... They must not be used to seeing too many girls around here...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope Brendan's contact is reliable...
Denni steps into the newspaper club...
And finds a cluttered office, covered in papers! A thin, dark-haired boy sits behind a desk...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh! Hey! You must be Denise, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Denni, actually. You're Nick Brown?
Nick walks over and shakes Denni's hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In the flesh.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, I always `wanted` to say that, but now that I did, I feel super creepy. Sorry about that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, I always [color=#e23b3b][i]wanted[/i][/color] to say that, but now that I did, I feel super creepy. Sorry about that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So Brendan said you need some help with a story about Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What exactly are you researching?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, actually, I was hoping to find out about...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good work out there, Denni! That was some great investigative journalism!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Plus... Now we've got confirmation of The Immortals' existence... `On tape!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus... Now we've got confirmation of The Immortals' existence... [color=#e23b3b][i]On tape![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh?
Nick plucks the flower pin off Denni's jacket.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This thing? `Totally` a recording device.
nodes.text_bbcode: This thing? [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally[/i][/color] a recording device.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, but you `know` you would've been more nervous if you'd known.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, but you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you would've been more nervous if you'd known.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... Guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Besides, I wasn't kidding about it bringing out your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh. So what's the next step?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... I don't know. Getting info from Chad was kind of all I had.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I think we've gotten all we can out of him. He's not exactly the sharpest tool in the shed...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd think so, but the guy must have hidden depths. I've had it on good authority he aced his SETs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Him? Really? I mean... `Him?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Him? Really? I mean... [color=#3b78e2][i]Him?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now let's think. Is there anything else we have to go off of?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... There was this one thing Chad said that caught my attention...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I gotta say, that wasn't the best journalism I've ever seen...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But at least we've got confirmation of The Immortals' existence on tape!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh?
Nick plucks the flower pin off Denni's jacket.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This thing? `Totally` a recording device.
nodes.text_bbcode: This thing? [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally[/i][/color] a recording device.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, but you `know` you would've been more nervous if you'd known.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, but you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you would've been more nervous if you'd known.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... Guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Besides, I wasn't kidding about it bringing out your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh. So what's the next step?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... I don't know. Getting info from Chad was kind of all I had.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I think we've gotten all we can out of him. He's not exactly the sharpest tool in the shed...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd think so, but the guy must have hidden depths. I've had it on good authority he aced his SETs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Him? Really? I mean... `Him?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Him? Really? I mean... [color=#3b78e2][i]Him?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now let's think. Is there anything else we have to go off of?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... There was this one thing Chad said that caught my attention...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He...
Everyone follows Jessica's direction to a view of the cityscape.
$ZOE frantically looks around for Howard in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, over here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!
$ZOE rushes to him, and he holds her close.
They walk down to the edge of the park where a glistening ball sits at the top of the highest building in the city.
When the clock gets closer to midnight, the entire party starts counting down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ten... Nine... Eight...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seven... Six... Five...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Four... Three... Two...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ONE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]ONE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The large silver ball drops, and everyone cheers!
$ZOE's confetti is released into the air, coating everyone in a silvery blanket of stars!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Silver snow! This is a magical New Year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Happy New Year, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Happy New Year!
All around, people start making toasts with their soda cups while couples kiss.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy New Year, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Howard.
Howard bends down and kisses $ZOE!
They part, and Howard holds her for a while.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To next year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: May both the good and bad times be better than last year!
Over Howard's shoulder, $ZOE can see Matteo standing near the door.
He is alone in the midst of kissing couples.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Matteo...
Matteo slips away into the night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, enough kissing! More partying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look at me! Woo! I'm dancing on a picnic table!
And all the Centerscore students dance through the night...
Way to bring in the New Year! What a great game!
Thanks to you, $ZOE was able to survive Jessica's New Year party and get her New Year's Kiss!
Everyone heads towards the edge of the park.
$ZOE starts to make her way over when Jessica grabs her arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't 'what' me! You're an elf! You have a job to do!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that job doesn't include making out at midnight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're seriously going to stop me from kissing Howard at midnight?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I am... You can just spend the rest of the evening cleaning up your stupid cupcakes!
Jessica tries to push a tray of cupcakes into $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you know what I have to say to that?!
$ZOE throws one of her cupcakes down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for the worst night ever, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh wait... I'm sorry... I'm supposed to speak Elvish, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, 'Jeasyxs' for the worst night ever, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the best you got? `Jeasyxs` isn't even the right word, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the best you got? [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeasyxs[/i][/color] isn't even the right word, $ZOE!

nodes.text: Suddenly, the ground starts shaking. All the lights in the park and across the neighborhood start flickering!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa!
And suddenly the city buildings start to quaver and shake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What's going on?!
Ben comes running over to help Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, $ZOE... What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Jeasyxs for the worst night ever, Jessica'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And at another party across the city...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Something's happening...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Someone must have said the summoning spell...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Jeasyxs Forth Worsnight Everjess Ica!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Jeasyxs Forth Worsnight Everjess Ica![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If that's the summoning spell, why are `you` saying it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: If that's the summoning spell, why are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] saying it?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm repeating it. Some layperson who doesn't know the difference between 'Thank you' and 'Summon the Destroyer' must have done it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What language makes those two phrases nearly identical?!
Back across town...
A giant chasm has swallowed up the park! From inside, a gigantic lizard crawls out!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Behold, Jeasyxs the Destroyer has returned to this mortal plane!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Behold, Jeasyxs the Destroyer has returned to this mortal plane![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh my god... It's a humongous `Lyle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my god... It's a humongous [color=#3b78e2][i]Lyle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gross!!!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Enough! For generations, you have oppressed my kind, putting them in cages, scrubbing them with toothbrushes, and eating their tails...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Enough! For generations, you have oppressed my kind, putting them in cages, scrubbing them with toothbrushes, and eating their tails...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `No more! Today, a new era comes. Jeasyxs the Destroyer will usher in a new reign!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No more! Today, a new era comes. Jeasyxs the Destroyer will usher in a new reign![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Everyone will be struck down, and the world will be made anew with my kind as its sovereign!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Everyone will be struck down, and the world will be made anew with my kind as its sovereign![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The earth rumbles, and the houses and buildings in the city start to collapse.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's Lyle's evil twin brother!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is all your fault!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right! It is! What have I done?!
Jeasyxs strides forward until he comes to Amanda and $ZOE. He pauses in the midst of his destruction to look down upon them.

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Hello, Amanda. We meet again...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hello, Amanda. We meet again...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Jeasyxs...` Please don't do this...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeasyxs...[/i][/color] Please don't do this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you really going to destroy everyone?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Not everyone. I will spare the lives of elves such as yourself.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Not everyone. I will spare the lives of elves such as yourself.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Elves are, after all, the serving class of the Lizard Kings!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Elves are, after all, the serving class of the Lizard Kings![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Nooooooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nooooooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Oh no! $ZOE's going to become a servant to the ruling race of lizards?
Well, that doesn't sound like a very good New Year's at all!
Try again and see if you can $ZOE a proper good ending!

In a cabin in the snow...
Denni's phone buzzes! She checks it...
I just got twenty voicemails from Ben!
Denni listens to all of Ben's messages...
Wow... I can't believe Ben left `all` those messages...
I don't know what to do...
On the one hand, I'm angry enough to kill him...
On the other, I feel so bad... I wish I could hold him...
Maybe I can send him a message to see how he's holding up...
Denni logs onto FaceSpace. She checks out Ben's FaceSpace page...
...And finds a bunch of pictures of Ben and Jessica together!
Ben! What are you doing?!
Tears fall down Denni's cheeks...
Ben might be over Denni, but it doesn't look like Denni's completely over Ben...
And back in Centerscore, in $ZOE's room...
$ZOE checks her email and finds one from...
Matteo?!
She thinks about reading it but stops herself.
He hasn't sent me anything since...
Since the one that caused that fight with Howard at Homecoming...
I... I shouldn't read this... It isn't fair to Howard!
She hears Howard coming up the stairs...
She closes her email window just as Howard comes in.
Hey, $ZOE, you okay?
I'm fine. Why do you ask?
You just look a little off.
It's... It's nothing.
Can I cheer you up with some hot chocolate?
Oh, Howard, you're the best!
$ZOE didn't tell Howard about Matteo's email... What could this mean? Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

Matteo wasn't the only one inspired to confess his feelings!
The next afternoon...
Erik walks back to the pool after swim practice is over.
Sara Kessler is there with the other girls as they pack their gear to go home.
Sara, can we talk for a minute?
Sure, Erik.
Hannah pats Sara on the shoulder.
Gee, I wonder what this is going to be about...
Have `fun,` you two! And make sure he takes off his glasses first, so they don't fog up!
Don't mind them.
Not minding!
They walk to the other side of the pool.
What's up, Erik?
Sara, we've had a lot of good times together.
Uh, we have?
Dancing with you, meeting your father, hanging out with your friends...
Didn't that all happen in one night? The Homecoming Dance?
Like I said, good times!
They were pretty fun.
And I'd like to have more good times with you.
What do you mean?
I like you. You are the nicest, most awesome girl in the school!
And I'd like to take you out.
Erik, that's really nice of you to say...
You're a great, funny guy, but we can't date.
I know you are very busy with your swimming schedule. A future Olympian would need to practice every day, so dating might be out of the question...
It's not that... It's just that spark, Erik. I don't feel the same way about you as I do about swimming.
And you like me more than I could like you. I think you should take a chance on someone else.
Someone great.
I understand. Thank you, Sara, for being you.
Sure thing, Erik...
Erik trudges away from the pool.
Matteo is right. I can't keep liking someone who doesn't want me...
But this definitely marks today as the `worst` Star Tour of Centerscore ever!
Awww, poor Erik! At least he figured out how Sara felt about him! But will Erik ever find true love?
