We never figured out exactly why $ZOE had to dress up as an elf, did we?
Well, this might shed some light on the situation...
The day before Jessica's New Year's Eve party...
Ben and Jessica talk in her room.
What do you mean you can't come to my New Year's Eve party?
Sorry, Jessica. I made plans. It's tradition with the nerds.
I have to get him away from those nerds if he's going to get elected President! They're so uncool!
But it's a tradition for the popular kids to get together...
What do your friends do for New Year's?
It's a little nerdy, but we're going to play Ogres 'N' Elves.
And Dex is going to have Space 'Splosions episodes playing in the background.
It's going to be pretty sweet!
Uh, yeah, that sounds... Just awesome.
And you should hear about the snacks!
Ben, listen... I really want to you to come to my party.
There'll be snacks, I promise! They'll be way better than what's at your party!
And if you want it, I'll totally make it Ogres 'N' Elves themed!
You know about Ogres 'N' Elves?
Yeah! Elves are those little people Santa works with! I'll have some of those...
That's not `exactly...`
As for ogres... Well, I can always invite Ryan, can't I?
And there'll be stars everywhere! Just like space, right?
If it means that much to you, I'll go.
You will? Really?
Yeah... Especially if you're throwing an Ogres and Elves themed party!
If it'll get you to come, there will be elves and stars everywhere!
I just have to make a phone call...
$ZOE had better not be busy...
Thanks to $ZOE and Amanda, Jessica did end up having at least two elves and more stars!
Have a very happy New Year!

A few days later, at `The Windsor Knot,` two unlikely visitors step in...
Are you sure this is the place?
Yeah. Colt said tons of hot chicks show up here...
A well-dressed salesman eyes them from across the store.
He approaches quickly.
Excuse me, gentlemen, and I use that term as loosely as English allows...
But you are acting in complete ignorance of our prestigious dress code!
What?
You talk like a book.
Allow me to clarify!
That's okay. Just tell us where the hot chicks are!
Yeah! We're here for babes!
Well, I'm afraid you are mistaken! This isn't some... Cheap bordello!
This is `The Windsor Knot!` We sell gentlemen's clothes here... `To gentlemen!`
Yeah, well... We're gentlemen.
$Travis burps.
Yeah.
I hope you're not excluding us, or I'll have to tell my lawyer-mom to, you know, lawyer you.
Mine too!
You both know that neither of your mothers are lawyers! Now get out of here at once!
Or what?
$Travis pounds his fists together.
Yeah... Or what?
Uh... Or... Um...
We want to meet hot chicks! We were promised hot chicks! So if you don't figure out how to introduce us to some hot chicks...
We'll turn your face into a Wilson Knot!
It's Windsor.
Not the way I tie it.
Okay! Okay! I think I can phone someone. Just... Please don't manipulate my face!
Awesome.
Looks like Colt got the last laugh here!
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!

Meanwhile... At Centerscore High...
Denni sits by herself in the library, staring at a thick, standardized test practice-book...
Ugh... I'm never going to learn this stuff...
Angrily, she shoves the book across the table. It slides over and bumps into another student's notes...
Oh! Sorry...
I... I didn't see you there...
It's... Um... No big deal. I needed a distraction anyway.
The two sit there in a long, awkward silence, not making eye contact...
So... Um... How are you?
I'm okay.
How are things with Jessica?
Do you really want me to answer that question?
...Probably not.
Ben holds up the book that Denni had hurled his way.
Studying for your SETs?
Yeah. I know I'm just a sophomore, but it's never too early to start taking them if you want to get into a good college.
I'm surprised you're having trouble... It seems like the kind of thing you'd be good at.
Yeah, well, I'm a little distracted right now...
I know, me too. I can't `believe` someone vandalized our football field like that!
I really hope they can catch whoever did it...
Yeah... Me too... Whoever it is...
Well... I should get going. Jessica is... Well, you know Jessica.
Just a piece of advice... Sometimes when I'm too distracted to work, I think it's a good time to take a break. You know, just quit for a little while.
Ben gets up and leaves. Denni watches him go.
Sorry, Ben...
But I'm not the quitting type!
Denni slides over to a computer and boots it up. She opens up an Internet search window and types...
'Spartan Academy'... 'The Immortals'!
What's Denni going to find about The Immortals? Will she discover the society's terrible secret?
Find out soon!

Later that week, Matteo is out on a date with Sam! Sam takes a big bite out of a piece of bread.
Signorina, I cannot move my eyes from yours!
Every motion that you make is like a testament to beauty!
Mmmmfff!
She swallows her bread.
Thanks... But this is our `first` date, Matteo. Take it easy.
What do you mean, my perfect bumblebee?
Well, you don't have to come on like a steamroller.
Relax! Let's find out if we even like each other first.
I do not understand.
Ugh. Just because we're on a date doesn't mean we're meant for each other.
How do you fall in love then if you do not declare it right away?
Wow... Um... Do you know what it means to 'play the field'?
Like a soccer field? Of course! I am always the striker!
`No!` No sports!
What I mean is... The girl you were with in Italy...
Adrianna, the light of my life!
So, you were completely crazy for her for a while and then $ZOE showed up in France...
$ZOE, the light of my life!
Crazy again! And now, you're here with me...
Samantha, the light of my...
Hmm, I seem to have multiple lights of my life...
What I'm saying is, instead of throwing yourself at me, why don't you go on a bunch of different dates and see what you like?
That is an option?!
Of course!
But this feels very much like a girl trap.
It's not a 'girl trap', believe me? Look, I know about matters of the heart.
And even though I do find your dimples irresistible, the `last` thing I want is you doting on me every second of the day like a puppy dog.
I see it. You want me to play the field first before I steamroll you.
Uh... Close enough.
So then there will be no kissing tonight?
I didn't say that.
I like this.
Now, talk to me about anything that `isn't` sports!
Deal. I will talk to you about my second favorite thing after soccer...
The beauty of my country, Italy.
I like this.
Looks like Sam's planted a new idea in Matteo's head! What will it mean for the future of Centerscore?

Meanwhile... In the Den of the Immortals...
Percy sits at a table with Carson, Chad and Preston, a sinister look on his face!
Dionysus... Ares... Hermes... We sit today on the cusp of our greatest achievement!
What we're going to do tonight will be risky, there's no doubt. If we get caught, we'll face `serious` consequences.
But if we succeed... Well, I don't need to tell you how good things will be.
And the Headmaster? He's on board?
He told me that if we can pull this off, The Immortals will not just be allowed to continue...
We'll enjoy greater rewards than ever before! I'm talking a premium clubhouse. I'm talking guaranteed A+'s in all our classes.
I'm talking a private jet!
The only thing I'm worried about is Colt...
Are you sure we can count on him?
Please. A low-born piece of gutter trash like Colt will be more than easy enough to manipulate.
In Ichstenborg, we call men like him 'serfs'... And we know `exactly` how to get them to do as they're told...
And what to do with them when we're done.
I still don't like it... Having to play along like we really want him and Tom in The Immortals...
Noted and ignored.
Not to be a buzzkill, but I've heard from a little bird that there's a certain eccentric girl around campus...
A girl seen in the company of none other than our very favorite intrepid reporter, Nick Brown.
Hmmm... It must be that Denni...
What on Earth is a 'Denni'?
`It` is a nuisance from Centerscore with a bizarre fixation on Colt.
I'd hoped I'd gotten rid of her with that email I sent from Colt's account...
You hacked Colt's account? `Nice!`
Save your praise. His password was 'motorcycle-vroom'.
So what should we do about this so-called 'Denni'?
Keep an eye on her. Don't let her get near Colt. Make sure she doesn't follow any of us.
We're so close to greatness... I will `not` let some love-struck waif ruin this for us.
Don't worry, boss. We won't disappoint.
We've got your back!
Yeah... That stuff.
Gentlemen... We have but one last hurdle to face...
And then... The Immortals will truly `live forever!`
Yikes! That doesn't sound good at all!
What's Percy's plan... And how does Colt fit into it?
Find out next week!

The next day, in Centerscore City Hall, several adults sit at a table with grim expressions on their faces.
At the head is Mayor Randy Oglethorpe, and in front of him are the Principals of Centerscore, Wilson, and Monarch Prep...
Principals Shapiro, Whitford, Dunkirk... I'm sure you all heard about what happened yesterday at Spartan Academy.
Complete insanity, by the sound of it!
I always `knew` there was something fishy happening at that school. Their SET scores were far too good to believe.
Do you know what the consequences are going to be?
Extreme, to say the least. All of the Spartan faculty has resigned in disgrace, and Headmaster Moriarty has been arrested for conspiracy to commit fraud.
Good! That guy totally sucks!
You know he made a pass at me once?
What about the students involved?
Well, the ringleader, Percival von Guttentag, was exiled back to Ichstenborg and permanently barred from entering the United States...
But the others are all off the hook.
What?! How can that be?
They were coerced into their criminal actions by their school's administration! No court in the world would prosecute them!
Bunch of little creeps...
With all due respect, Randy, is this really why you called us in here? To gossip?
No, I'm afraid I have a much more serious situation to discuss.
You see, once word of this reaches the Department of Education, Spartan Academy will lose its accreditation as an educational institution... And will be shut down.
As you can imagine, this will cause something of a student refugee crisis... And I will need all of you to help by taking in the boys of Spartan.
Whoa, whoa, with all due respect, Randy, Wilson is over-capacity as is. I just can't take in a bunch of random troublemakers...
And need I remind you that Monarch Prep is a `girl's` school?
This would only be a temporary measure... Until we can find other accommodations...
Sorry, but... We just can't do it...
Completely out of the question!
Principal Shapiro sighs deeply...
Centerscore will take them.
Oh, thank you, I can't tell you what a relief it is to hear that...
We don't exactly have a choice, do we? I'm not going to let a bunch of boys go without an education because their administrators were corrupt.
And you're comfortable taking all of them? Are you sure it won't cause too much of a disruption to Centerscore High?
What choice do I have, Mayor? My students are smart and resilient...
I'm sure they'll find a way to resolve any tensions!
...I hope.
Spartan merging with Centerscore?! That's crazy!

nodes.prompt: How would you like to play?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: How would you like to play?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, nice jeans!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I got them at `Jeaneology!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I got them at [color=#e23b3b][i]Jeaneology![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You're all right, kid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'll bet you end up at Centerscore University someday!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who knows? Maybe I'll end up throwing a party just like this one!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: With a hot girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I nailed Jessica's challenge! And I feel great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just need to find her so I can properly thank her!
For an instant, Matteo panics. He looks around the room for an escape and sees $ZOE's closet.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Alas... I must be on my way...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Remember to treasure the love you two have now...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And for all the New Years to come!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was a great story, Chaz!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without the quick-thinking of my dear friend, Brendan!
Brendan takes a bow.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's what any cool guy would have done!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hahaha! You guys are nerds even when you're trying to be cool!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think this is an excellent first step!
Tom addresses the salesman.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is your finest work! I can't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I can scarcely believe it myself. It was my greatest challenge.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Very funny, guys.
Colt and Tom step out of the store...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You did very well back there. I thought for sure you'd end up in an altercation with him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, maybe it was my greatest challenge too.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever it takes to become a Spartan Man.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm enthused to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be enthused if we can come back here and egg this place.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The stopping part could use work...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But overall you did rather splendid.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You did a fine job today.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm just not sure how my ability to ride a horse is going to prevent those jerkwads from trying to pick a fight with me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'd be surprised, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It'll be a lot tougher to pick on you when you're just like them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's a thought that makes me want to barf...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's this? New threads for Colt?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I took him to `The Windsor Knot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I took him to [color=#e23b3b][i]The Windsor Knot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But... But that's where `we` shop.
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But that's where [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] shop.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whatever. One polo uniform does not a Spartan make!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You talk funny.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You... Er... Grr!
Chad angrily rides off!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: In a first for The Immortals, we've got a tie!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two most qualified members for our society... Are Hades and Apollo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes! Team Hapollo does it again!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please don't call us that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, that was a horrible mistake, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Man, this sucks.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, forget this.
Mark and Lee walk out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... We're good? The two of us are in?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, no, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm afraid I do...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two of you must decide who joins The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: By fighting it out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! That's right! The two of you are gonna have to fight like dogs... And the last one standing wins!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is this the only option? We have to fight each other?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: 'Fraid so, boys. Get to it.
The other Immortals back away. Tom and Colt look at each other warily...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We really gonna do this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We've jumped through all their other hoops. Seems like a shame to back out now...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... Whoever wins... It's been an honor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Same here, man. Same here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Let's do this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, wait, I...
Tom lunges forward, throwing a hard right jab at Colt's head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt dodges to the side, neatly weaving away from the punch!
Tom stumbles for a moment... Leaving himself wide open!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Only one thing to do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And that is...?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's the biggest social event of the year around here, a huge ball between Spartan Academy and Monarch Prep.
Colt throws a punch at Mark's head...
But the tux is too tight and restrictive! Colt stumbles, and Mark neatly weaves under the punch!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gah!
Colt staggers for a second, and Mark exploits it, stepping forward to deliver a lightning-fast jab to Colt's abdomen!
It's so fast and short that no one else sees it! Colt lets out a pained gasp!
